name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"Stereo cassette deck with a design that can be stacked with amplifiers and tuners. The cassette tape is set at an angle of 30Ω� from the front, and the running condition can be confirmed with the naked eye.

MOTOR
In order to ensure low rotational unevenness under this condition, we have adopted an electronically controlled DC motor with large torque that is not affected by voltage fluctuations, and a high-precision capstan with roundness of 0Ω.1ΩÏ‰ or less. It is equipped with a peak indicator combining a light emitting diode (LED) and an electronic circuit. Reacts quickly to the instantaneous peak level of the recording source and lights up to warn you that the recording level is over. The lighting level is set at + 4ΩdB from the reference recording level (0ΩdB on the meter). Since there is a margin to + 10ΩdB, which is the maximum recording level at which sound is completely distorted, the recording level can be adjusted when it flashes. In the case of Dolby recording, setting the recording level with the peak indicator results in a slightly lower average level, allowing recording with a wide dynamic range at a low distortion rate.

NOISE REDUCTION
The built-in Dolby system greatly reduces noise without compromising the sound quality of the recording source. In order to bring out the taste of chrome tape, low-noise tape, standard tape, etc., it is equipped with an independent switching type tape selector with 2Ωlevels of bias and 2Ωlevels of equalizer.

EQUALIZER
For chrome tapes, a new equalizer circuit with a time constant of 70ΩÏ‰ s is used to improve the high-frequency SN. Duad Ferri Chrome When using a tape, switch the Bias Selector to Normal and the Equalizer Selector to Chrome, and record and play back the tape. This will bring out the tape.

HEADS
The head uses a ferrite solid head with less head wear. There is little magnetic loss at high frequency, which is advantageous for use of chrome tape. In addition, the contact surface is elaborately mirror-finished to obtain stable sound quality. Equipped with a recording level limiter. When you use this device, the limiter amplifier automatically adjusts the level of the overlevel during recording to prevent the sound from breaking. It has a built-in recording amplifier with a large dynamic margin and a high maximum allowable input. It has a built-in tape counter for repeated playback. If memory rewind is set to ON, it will automatically stop at the counter 999Ω, one point before the start point in the rewind operation. It has a built-in internal authentication switch that makes it easier to see the letters on the tape. Equipped with a skip button that can fast-forward at about twice the speed while monitoring the playback sound. Equipped with a large level meter. A memory marker device that stores the position of the knob for recording and playback levels. Parallel input / output terminal for simultaneous recording with other decks."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A front-operated stereo cassette deck equipped with a timer recording standby mechanism. By connecting a timer and setting the control lever to recording or playback standby (with the pause button pressed), the tape can be started at the desired time. Since the pinch roller is separated from the capstan during standby, there is no need to worry about damaging the mechanism or tape. A commercially available timer can be used. In order to make it easier to see the tape running, the mechanism is tilted by 30Ωdegrees.

MOTOR
In this condition, in order to under this condition, we have adopted an electronically controlled DC motor with large torque that is not affected by voltage fluctuations, and a high-precision capstan with roundness of 0Ω.1ΩÏ‰ or less. It is equipped with a peak indicator that combines a light-emitting diode and electronic circuit that quickly responds to + 5ΩdB level in several mmsec. This quickly reacts to the instantaneous peak level of the recording source and turns on to warn that the recording level is over.

NOISE REDUCTION
It has a built-in Dolby System that greatly reduces tape hissing without compromising the sound quality of the recording source.

NOISE REDUCTION
When the Dolby System is ON, the indicator lamp lights. In order to bring out the characteristics of each tape such as chrome tape, low-noise tape and standard tape, it is equipped with an independent switchable tape selector with two levels of bias and two levels of equalizer.

EQUALIZER
A new equalizer circuit with a time constant of 70ΩÏ‰ s that improves S/N by 4Ω.5ΩdB in the high-frequency range is also used for chrome tapes. When using general low-noise tapes, both the bias and equalizer are set to STD. When using chrome tapes, both the bias and equalizer are set to CrO.2ΩFor more information. You can enjoy recording and playback that demonstrate the characteristics of each tape in terms of frequency characteristics and distortion factor. It is equipped with a recording amplifier with a large dynamic margin, and is designed to use a professional standard microphone with a compatible microphone impedance, so it is very useful for live recording.

HEADS
The head uses a ferrite solid head with less wear and long life. Since the contact surface with the tape is made of a hard material unique to ferrite and carefully mirror-finished, sound skipping due to dust adhesion is less and stable sound quality can be obtained.

HEADS
In order to facilitate cleaning of the cassette compartment set at 30Ωdegrees, we have installed a maintenance skylight at the top of the bonnet where a large head eraser can be used. This makes maintenance of the head and travel system easy. It is equipped with a memory rewind switch. When this switch is turned ON, the start point [000Ω] of the tape counter is memorized, played and recorded, and rewound after that, the tape stops at the [999Ω] position. This mechanism is convenient when you want to repeatedly listen to the same music recorded in the middle of the tape. Equipped with a skip button that allows you to fast-forward at twice the speed while listening to monkey talk. The tape counter has a light lamp."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A multi-functional cassette deck with built-in electronic digital timer, capable of recording absence, sleep timer and alarm clock playback. It has a built-in high-precision digital timer to further develop the absence recording function. The digital timer section, which requires accuracy, employs an electronic system using newly developed MOS LSI (Ultra-Integrated Circuit). The start time can be set at one minute intervals and the error with respect to the set start time is also kept low. In addition, the amount of time light can be switched to two levels. With the Timer knob, you can set the time for recording your absence, playing an alarm clock, or operating as a sleep timer.59Ωminutes can be set with 1ΩH-ON, 118Ωminutes with 2ΩH-ON, and 59Ωminutes with SLEEP. When the set time ends, the power to the deck and AC outlet is automatically turned off. The DISPLAY knob is used to set the current time and recording start time. The ADJUST knob advances the timer to the desired time. It can be set quickly to near the time set by FAST, while it can be set slowly by SLOW. The sleep timer operates by SLEEP START. If the outlet is unplugged or there is a power failure, either AM or PM will flash to indicate the current time error when the power supply is restored after a lapse of time.

TRANSPORT
MOTOR
The drive section uses a DC-motor with a built-in generator with less torque ripple and vibration, and a capstan and flat belt with a precision finish to ensure stable tape drive. It is equipped with a tape selector with a built-in automatic switching mechanism for chrome tapes. When a chrome tape with a detection hole is attached, the bias and equalizer are automatically switched to chrome regardless of the position of the tape selector. Also, manual switching is possible for LH tape and Ferrichrome tape. In order to securely fix the cassette, a 6Ω-blade reel with less play between the tape and the hub is used. Equipped with a memory stop on-off switch that is convenient for tracking. Equipped with a tape mechanism protection device that prevents the mechanism from differentiating if the tape is not set correctly. Equipped with a back illumination lamp with a tape end marker line that shows the remaining amount of tape at a glance. Equipped with a full auto-stop mechanism that employs a Hall element."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A stereo cassette deck equipped with a third meter that can be used with three functions. Equipped with 3Ωindependent meters that can be used separately : dynamic level meter, bias meter and peak meter. The dynamic level meter is designed so that it fluctuates slightly in the low range and considerably in the high range. When recording, in general, the distortion tends to increase as the level increases in the low frequency band, and tends to saturate in the high frequency band. However, since conventional meters cannot read the frequency component of the input signal, recording at a higher level may cause high peaks in a source that contains many high frequencies, and distortion increases in a source that contains many low frequencies. The dynamic level meter allows you to set an appropriate recording level that matches the frequency component of the recording source. When the bias meter is used, the amount of bias can be checked with the meter, and the bias variable volume can be set to the proper recording bias suitable for the tape to be used. This can be used for various types of tapes and provides better recording characteristics. The peak meter acts as a peak meter (Lch + Rch) with a fast response speed during playback. The drive section is equipped with an electronically controlled DC-motor with a built-in generator with stable rotational performance. In addition, it is equipped with a large flywheel with large inertial mass.

TRANSPORT
The capstan with high roundness and high surface accuracy is driven by a flat belt. This improves the accuracy of the drive section thoroughly and ensures excellent rotational performance.

NOISE REDUCTION
The Dolby System is used as a noise reduction system. Equipped with a tape selector with automatic tape switching mechanism for CrO2Ωposition. When a CrO2Ωposition tape is attached to the Tape Selector, both the Bias / Equalizer switch automatically to the CrO2Ωposition, and the Bias switch to the standard value for each tape, allowing fine adjustment while watching the Third Meter. Equipped with a memory stop mechanism. It uses a timer standby mechanism that enables you to record your absence and play an alarm. Uses a large indicator. By using a separately sold rack mount adapter, it can be mounted on an EIA-standard rack."

"In addition to the functions of the top-of-the-line CD-980Ω, it is an auto-reverse deck with a Oatley berth at the Rokuon-ji temple. Equipped with a Oatley berth mechanism that employs LED sensors. The use of an LED sensor eliminates the loss of the leader tape (approximately 12Ω~ 15Ωseconds), which was the bottleneck of the conventional reverse method, and realizes a quick reverse. A ribbon sendust head is used for the head part. For the first time in the world, Sendust, which is hard and brittle and difficult to process, is made into a thin strip and multi-layer laminate. Equipped with timer standby mechanism, recording of absence and alarm clock playback are possible. Equipped with a REC mute mechanism that can create unrecorded portions between songs. It uses a new feeling operation key. Equipped with one touch recording button. By using the separately sold remote control unit, it can be operated from a remote location."

description:
## Description

"Stereo cassette deck with built-in Dolby system.

NOISE REDUCTION
It employs the Dolby System, which greatly improves the harsh tape hissing without compromising the sound quality of the source. The difference between the noise level and the signal level is small, and the recording level is automatically raised when a pianissimo is heard with a tape hiss, and when it is played back, it is returned to the same level as the source, and finally the tape hissing is lowered. This method improves the dynamic range and S/N ratio. Equipped with a high-sensitivity peak indicator that combines a light emitting diode (LED) with an electronic circuit. It responds quickly to momentary input overruns and lights up and warns. The lighting level is set to + 4ΩdB of the peak value. Since there is a margin of about 10ΩdB, which is the limit level of distortion, the recording level can be adjusted when it flashes.

NOISE REDUCTION
Also, when using the Dolby System, use the peak indicator to set the recording level slightly lower so that you can record with low distortion and a wide dynamic range. In order to take advantage of each tape such as chrome tape, low noise tape, standard tape, etc., a bias / equalizer independent switching type tape selector is adopted. In addition, a new equalizer (70ΩÏ‰ s) has been adopted for chrome tape to improve SN. It is equipped with a recording level limiter, which is convenient for live recording. When an over-level signal causes distortion, a limiter amplifier based on the same principle used in broadcasting stations works to prevent sound cracking. It is equipped with a tape counter with memory rewind. Even when recording or playing back from the middle of a tape, if the counter is set to 000Ωand the memory rewind is ON, the auto-stop will work at the counter position of 999Ωwhen rewinding. A ferrite solid head with excellent abrasion resistance is adopted for the head, and magnetic loss at high frequency is little, which is advantageous for use of chrome tape. In addition, the contact surface is elaborately mirror-finished so that the head touch is good and the sound jump caused by dust adhesion is reduced. Equipped with a contactless auto-stop mechanism that automatically opens when the tape is finished. Equipped with a tape travel pilot that rotates around the tape as it travels. It is equipped with a slide-type playback output control that can adjust the output level with one touch. Equipped with a convenient skip button that allows you to fast-forward at twice the speed while monitoring and to start the tape. Since the pinch roller is separated from the capstan during standby, there is no burden on the mechanism and there is no worry of deformation of the pinch roller. description:
## Description

"A stereo cassette deck with no vibration and no resonance by making full use of advanced analysis technology, and with high sound quality by introducing Pioneer's original technology.

TRANSPORT
The NEW Z mechanism has been adopted to improve tape tension fluctuation, tape meander, and running speed fluctuation. First of all, in order to obtain stable tape tension and head touch, we have adopted a resonance dispersion type closed loop dual capstan system in which left and right capstan and pinch roller are used as different diameter. We have also succeeded in reducing head vibration and improving tape running by mounting a head block with a zinc die-cast double structure, in which tilt / height adjustment is precisely performed by an optical jig so that the head can be matched without opposing the natural flow of the tape. In addition, it employs a capstan shaft with sub-micron order polishing accuracy and FS treatment (special processing technology that makes it difficult to slip without losing roundness of 0Ω.1ΩÏ‰ m or less) on the tape running surface, and a balanced flywheel with a large moment of inertia. This reduces the slippage of the tape and shaft and enables stable tape running with less uneven speed.

HEADS
The recording and reproducing heads employ a laser amorphous head that uses PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper) for coil winding. In addition, a double-gap ferrite head with a sendust guard is used for the erasing head. Nastran (NASA Structure Analysis Program) developed by NASA is used to analyze vibration of the cassette half in order to eliminate vibration of the cassette half. Based on the results of the analysis, we are refining our vibration-free and resonance-free design. In order to prevent resonance that occurs at specific parts of the half, it is equipped with special non-repulsion rubber and NEW cassette stabilizer that is effectively damped at high rigidity parts. In addition, it is equipped with a Motor Vibration Insulator (M Ï‰ V Ï‰ I) mechanism to prevent vibration caused by the motor. Between the motor and the mechanical chassis, there is a special reinforced resin motor bracket with air bubbles inside. Between the motor bracket and the mechanical chassis, there is also a grounded insulator made of non-resilient rubber between the motor bracket and the mechanical chassis. Thus, vibration energy generated by the motor is effectively absorbed in terms of both structure and material. In addition, in order to prevent vibration caused by sound pressure from speakers from being transmitted to the half, the door and cassette pocket are physically separated and equipped with an isorated door. The deck itself is also completely vibration-free and resonance-free. Honeycomb structures with excellent vibration damping, such as copper-plated honeycomb chassis, large honeycomb insulator, and honeycomb shield case, are used in each part to diffuse vibration in various directions and attenuate it. The bias oscillation frequency quality sound recording, the bias oscillation frequency has been increased to 210ΩkHz, which is twice the conventional frequency. By setting the frequency difference with the music signal to a large value, the generation of beat and intermodulation noise due to interference between harmonics and bias current is suppressed, enabling recording with less distortion. A direct construction design is provided so that the power supply, control, amplifier, mechanical and FL meter can be connected at the shortest distance. In addition, the volume is placed close to the input terminal and controlled by the shaft to minimize the wiring distance. In the case of a source that does not require balance adjustment with the line-straighter function, the signal is routed to the recording amplifier at the shortest distance by bypassing the balance volume. For each block of amplifier, control and FL indication, the transformer winding consists of four independent windings for exclusive power supply. In particular, a bifilar winding made of oxygen-free copper wire is adopted for the transformer winding of the amplifier system, which improves the balance between + and - power supply and contributes to improved sound quality. It is equipped with peak level calibration which microcomputer assists for accurate recording level setting. Once you hold the peak level of the recording source, the held peak level moves on the meter according to the increase or decrease of the recording volume so that it can be adjusted to the appropriate level. To get the most out of the characteristics of your tape, it is equipped with a bias level and recording level calibration function. It has a built-in oscillator for quick and accurate adjustment. The CD-DECK is synchronized with a Pioneer CD player. You can enjoy editing and recording with auto-linked operation such as synchronized recording start with one touch or auto trackback recording. Equipped with a meter range switching function, it is possible to switch between the wide range mode of -30ΩdB to + 8ΩdB in normal operation and the expanded range mode of -3ΩdB to + 12ΩdB which displays around 0ΩdB in 1ΩdB steps. In order to suppress noise generation from the FL part, the FL display OFF function is installed. The display can be turned off when there is no FL display such as after setting the recording level or during playback. Equipped with a normal tape counter, a time counter that displays the elapsed time of recording and playback, and a ????????? 3Ω-mode tape counter that displays the remaining time of the tape. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A three head cassette deck equipped with a digital processing system. A digital processing system is used for signal processing inside the deck. In this method, the music signal read by the playback head is converted into a digital music signal, and the subsequent signal processing is done by digital processing with little degradation, thereby suppressing degradation caused by high-frequency correction and level correction. In addition, it is equipped with a Legato link conversion, which is also installed in CD players. It reproduces music signals in the audible band above 20ΩkHz by estimating them from signals within the audible band and 1Ω/f characteristics, and realizes wide-band playback up to 40ΩkHz.

NOISE REDUCTION
Digital noise reduction is installed in the digital circuit. In this circuit, the audio frequency band is divided into multiple bands by a digital filter, and the hissing is separated and removed by increasing the level difference between the music signal and noise, thereby achieving an S/N ratio of 90ΩdB when the Dolby NR is on. This digital noise reduction does not need to be encoded at the time of recording, and is capable of high S/N playback on tapes recorded on other decks or in the past. Equipped with digital FLEX (Frequency Level Expander). This function is used for tapes that are muffled due to degradation of high-frequency sound quality. This function automatically adjusts the high-frequency level to the 1Ω/f characteristic so that even tapes with poor high-frequency characteristics can be played with clear sound. Equipped with a digital XD (Extended Dynamic Range) FLAT System. With this circuit, the recording and playback frequency characteristics can be tuned to a flat level by digital processing with one touch according to the tape to be used. By checking the high-frequency recording characteristics of the tape to be used with a computer and carrying out bias control that is optimal for the tape, higher precision correction capability and a wide dynamic range in the high-frequency range can be obtained. The digital input terminal allows recording from digital devices with an optical output at a sampling frequency of 44Ω.1ΩkHz. The T-D7Ωalso has a digital input terminal on the front. In addition, it is equipped with a digital sync function so that recording starts automatically when a music signal is input. Equipped with digital ALCA (Auto Level Control with Tape Analysis) function. When recording with digital input, the recording level can be automatically adjusted to the optimum level. The peak and initial recording levels are set based on the bias and sensitivity analysis of the FLAT SYSTEM and the high-frequency and high-level recording capability analysis, and the recording level is set according to the input signal. Thus, even tapes with different characteristics can be recorded at the appropriate recording level. Manual operation is required for analog input. The Z-concept has been adopted to reduce waveform distortion and pursue accurate signal transmission. The T-D7Ωemploys three technologies : a stayable detection based on the Z-concept, an accurate transmission, and a jitter-free conversion. A cassette stabilizer, digital tension servo and, and a wing chassis are used for Stable Detection. The cassette stabilizer is equipped with a special stabilizer of approximately 70Ωg on the receiver side of the main body to effectively hold the cassette half with a soft touch. This reduces the influence of motor rotation vibration, sound pressure, and external vibration, and realizes stable driving and clear sound with less modulation noise.

TRANSPORT
In the Digital Tension Servo, the microcomputer controls the voltage of the reel motor according to the size of the wound diameter of the tape, and the tape is wound at the appropriate tape tension. This improves the wow flutter at the beginning of the winding of the tape, which has tended to be unstable in the past. In the wing chassis, the shape of the bottom plate of the power transformer mounting part and the cassette mechanical mounting part is devised. By effectively releasing vibration to the outside from the insulator, the circuit board is isolated from the rotational vibration of the power transformer and motor.

POWER SUPPLY
The Accurate Transmission uses a high-speed active servo regulator that consists of a transformer winding dedicated to the amplifier in the amplifier power supply circuit. This high-speed servo stabilizes power supply voltage fluctuations caused by load fluctuations. It can also quickly follow sudden fluctuations in music signals, and record and play back sources with a wide dynamic range more faithfully. The jitter-free conversion employs a switched-capacitor filter in the DAC to attenuate out-of-band noise and improve accuracy due to clock jitter.

NOISE REDUCTION
The Dolby B/C type and Dolby HX-PRO are installed as noise reduction systems. Equipped with power loading / ejection and time counter (elapsed time of recording and re-recording) functions. Equipped with a 4Ω-digit electronic counter and tape remaining time display function. It is equipped with a function to select 15Ωsongs in front and back. It has a headphone port. Equipped with timer recording and replay function. Equipped with an auto tape selector. Equipped with CD-Deck synchro function and REC mute with auto space. Equipped with a last memory function, it records FLAT System data, main switch positions, etc. This allows advanced recording even during timer recording. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"This is a stereo tape deck with a Oatley berth function.

TRANSPORT
No idler is used at all, and both the capstan and reel stand are belt drives of the all-belt drive system. In addition, since it is a 1Ω-motor system, the generation of machine sound is cut off by an extremely simple mechanism. TRANSPORT

Oatley Verse works during playback. In addition to manual reversal by push button, automatic reversal is possible by attaching sensing tape to the tape end. In addition, auto-repeat, which repeats continuous long-time playback, is also possible by attaching it to both ends of the tape. A high-torque motor and an auto clutch are used for reversing, and the time required for reversing is only 0Ω.5Ωseconds. Recording is for forward direction only. H. tapes, it is equipped with a tape selector that can change the characteristics of the deck according to the tape. The built-in amplifier is a solid-state amplifier using carefully selected silicon transistors. The tape tension is stably applied and the optimum head touch is obtained. This motor generates less heat than the eddy current type commonly used for reels and can be used continuously for a long time. The head section has a 3Ω-head configuration to shorten the tape path and improve the stability of tape running.

HEADS
The recording and reproducing heads use a high-pressure-type permalloy head with excellent sensitivity, bias characteristics, and magnetization characteristics. This type has a good head touch. By using reel No. 10Ω, you can play for twice as long as reel No. 7Ω. The PLAY operation can be performed from the REW (FF) state by skipping the STOP button. If you do not need much timing time before play, such as when using No. 7Ωnormal size reel, you can start immediately by turning the PAUSE lever ON and then OFF. The operation buttons adopt a solenoid control type with feather touch, and since it can be push-locked, preset is possible even when the power is off. Low-noise silicon transistors are used in the microphone and recording amplifiers, and the dynamic range is widened by making full use of Pioneer's amplifier technology. In addition, we have succeeded in expanding the bandwidth of the playback amplifier by adopting a direct-coupled amplifier that does not use a capacitor for connecting each amplifier stage. In addition, we have adopted an electronic switch that uses semiconductors instead of conventional electronic switches with contacts, so that no click noise occurs. The 125ΩkHz bias oscillator is equipped with an automatic stabilizing circuit for temperature compensation. It is equipped with a tape selector that can independently select two levels of bias and two levels of equalizer. You can select the bias and equalizer according to the characteristics of the tape you are using. It has a built-in mixing amplifier for two microphone channels (stereo) and two line channels (stereo). Equipped with a PAUSE lever that can pause the tape for recording and regenerating condition. Equipped with a large level meter. Equipped with a recording mode switch. Built-in one touch type reel clamper. Equipped with playback level control. Uses a highly stable differential band brake. This case is a leather case with a handle, and the side plate of the deck body is removed the deck body."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A universal player developed as a reference player that brings out the potential of DVD audio to the maximum. For the D/A conversion, a 192ΩkHz / 24Ω-bit D/A converter developed jointly with Barr Brown is used for all channels. For the two main channels, two 192ΩkHz / 24Ω-bit D/A converters are used as differential mode to reduce common-mode noise by mutually canceling each other. A digital filter compatible with the 192ΩkHz high-sampling frequency of DVD audio was jointly developed with NPC and incorporated into the digital filter. In order to achieve high sound quality, it is equipped with a pure audio clock reference function that switches the crystal oscillator according to the sampling frequency of the disc to be reproduced. The crystal oscillator is switched between 44Ω.1ΩkHz (44Ω.1ΩkHz, 88Ω.2ΩkHz, 176Ω.4ΩkHz) and 48ΩkHz (48ΩkHz, 96ΩkHz, 192ΩkHz), and the non-selected oscillator is turned off to supply an accurate clock and improve sound quality. It is equipped with a CD Digital Direct function that transmits the CD via the shortest path without going through the DSP section when playing back the CD, preventing signal degradation completely.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses an R-core power transformer for audio circuits.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the layout is completely separate from the power supply section so that noise from servo circuits and digital circuits does not interfere with the audio section. The R-core transformer is characterized by low leakage flux, which is a source of noise in the player. High-bit ICs are used for all audio channels. Using a unique algorithm developed from wide-range technology, the smooth waveform of the original sound of digital signals recorded with 16Ωbits of quantization is estimated and re-quantized to 24Ωbits.

POWER SUPPLY
A low-impedance PX capacitor is used in the main unit of the digital section to reproduce clear, flexible, and high sound. In addition, a custom-designed power capacitor with thorough anti-noise measures is installed to eliminate minute noise from the power line. The video off function (Auto/on/off) is used to turn off the power and ground of the video circuit during non-visual source playback. By this function, fine noise generated by the video circuit is eliminated, and high sound quality playback is achieved. In addition, the multi-channel off function automatically cuts the power and ground of the multi-channel circuit when two channels are played back, and the digital out off function automatically cuts the power and ground of the digital out section. A built-in Dolby Digital or DTS sound decoder can process discrete 5Ω.1Ωch audio for DVD video. Equipped with a balanced output, a newly developed 192ΩkHz / 24Ω-bit D/A converter is differentiated into two channels, L and R, to realize a truly balanced output terminal that is resistant to electrical noise. The balance output off function also improves the sound quality of the pin jack. description:
## Description

"A CD player developed using Pioneer's digital technology. Uses an 8Ωx oversampling digital filter. The digital signal sampled at 44Ω.1ΩkHz is raised eight times to 352Ω.8ΩkHz to eliminate unwanted aliasing noise from the audio band. This makes it possible to use a low-order analog filter with loose characteristics in the final stage of the analog filter, thereby achieving low-distortion sound quality with less phase rotation in the high-frequency range. The D/A converter is equipped with a twin linear envelope D/A converter system that focuses on the generation of distortion due to bit error. In addition, since it is a glitch less type that does not require a deglitch circuit, it has excellent reproducibility of minute signals. It uses a magnetic clamp type disk stabilizer that is an improved version of Pioneer's original disk stabilizer that reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk. This reduces vibration generated by the disk rotation system and prevents vibration from being transmitted to the pickup. A ballast base is used to protect the optical system mechanism from external vibration. The center of gravity is lowered from the support part of the mechanism part to prevent unstable rolling and sound quality is improved by fixing it on the ceramic mechanism support. It uses a honeycomb chassis with increased structural strength by providing honeycomb ribs on the chassis. In addition, the use of a large insulator reduces external vibration. When a pit signal is read by a laser beam and converted into an RF signal, a slight time lag occurs between the preceding signal and the following signal of the four photodetectors, and a high-frequency phase difference is generated. In order to solve this problem, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system. By delaying the preceding signal and aligning it with the latter Yukinobu, we have improved the high-frequency characteristics of the RF-signal and obtained more faithful RF-signals. It is equipped with functions such as time fade edit, auto program edit, one touch fade, random play and auto space. Equipped with digital level control, volume can be adjusted by remote control. ## Description

"This is a CD player that inherits the high sound quality technology of the PD 3000Ωand further improves sound quality by thoroughly simplifying it. In order to minimize the power loss and prevent the influence of others, CD direct construction is adopted, and the layout is simple and straight along the signal flow from the pickup to the lineout. First of all, the printed circuit boards for digital / servo and analog circuits are separated independently. Moreover, with low impedance grounding, the sealed PCB (double-sided board), which provides an effective shielding effect against jumping from digital to analog, is used for digital, analog, and power supply. In addition, the analog board is designed to be as short as possible from input to output. At the same time, the symmetrical structure for left and right independence is adopted. This CD direct construction reduces the interference between signals.

POWER SUPPLY
In the power supply circuit, the transmission path is minimized and the � power supply is parallelized. The power supply board is directly connected to the power supply line of the analog board. The digital filter uses a 20Ω-bit operation 18Ω-bit output digital filter. The sampling frequency of 44Ω.1ΩkHz is increased eight times to 352Ω.8ΩkHz, and a Butterworth third order low-pass filter with excellent phase characteristics and frequency ripple is used in the analog stage. The D/A converter employs a real 18Ω-bit D/A converter with independent configuration on the left and right sides. It performs 18Ω-bit operation at all levels from large input to Oire power, eliminating interference and phase shift between channels. We have also adopted a linear envelope system (glitch less type), a unique technology of Pioneer, to improve the accuracy of D/A conversion and reduce 0Ωcross distortion by correcting the upper bit error to an appropriate value. In addition, by double and triple D/A conversion accuracy support such as exclusive winding for D/A converter, exclusive power supply, low impedance guard link, etc., minute level reproducibility is improved. The pickup is equipped with a clean laser pickup developed in-house by Pioneer. By reducing the number of optical components such as collimator lenses, the power loss of the optical system has been greatly reduced. Moreover, the aberration in the optical path has been reduced, making possible a clean and low-distortion pickup.

HEADS
In addition, by adopting a photodetector with a built-in I/V conversion head amplifier that amplifies small signals of several microamperes to approximately 200ΩmV, in combination with an Accu-Focus system, the occurrence of jitter due to reading errors and disturbance is suppressed. In addition, an engineering plastic pick-up body developed by dividing the pick-up body into approximately 1000Ωelements and repeating strength analysis has been adopted, enabling precise shape that was difficult with conventional die casting. An A-class push-pull FET buffer amplifier is used for two stages, the lineout of the analog stage and the I/V amplifier stage, enabling more accurate waveform transmission without being affected by the connected load. We have developed and installed a multi-resonance absorber (MRA), which is a vibration-free and vibration-free technology for dealing with unnecessary vibration frequencies over all bands from vibration isolation of pickup handling at minute levels to vibration isolation of PCB (double-sided substrate). As the second base after the honeycomb chassis, a float base was newly installed, and unnecessary vibration is suppressed by floating the circuit board and the pickup. This transformer employs a bifilar twist winding that improves the balance of output voltage, reduces noise and vibration, and reduces stray capacitance.

POWER SUPPLY

In addition, the audio circuit has a discrete push-pull regulator that exhibits excellent transient response characteristics against load fluctuations. This realizes a high-precision clean power supply. The power cord uses an OFC extra-thick 4Ω-core power cord with � polarity indication. It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that operates only when the operation key is pressed and prevents scanning noise. In addition, scanning noise when the display is off is taken into consideration, and a display off switch is installed to suppress noise generation."

description:
## Description

"A reference model CD player developed under the technical concept of Real Transmission Design with the theme of ""expressive power of music"". It is equipped with an 18Ω-bit 4Ωx oversampling digital filter. By calculating the sampling frequency and performing 4Ωx oversampling, unnecessary high-order noise is moved to the high-frequency range. It is removed with a low-order discrete analog low-pass filter with slow characteristics. As a result, excellent phase characteristics and low distortion audio characteristics are obtained. The D/A converter is equipped with a real 18Ω-bit twin D/A converter. By increasing the quantization level from 16Ωbits to 18Ωbits, we have succeeded in reducing quantization noise to 1Ω/4Ω. It is equipped with the Accu-Focus system, the pickup technology used in the Laser Vision Player LD-S1Ω. The photodetector is divided into four parts for focus servo control. The laser beam that hits the photodetector moves across the photodetector along the direction of the pit travel, causing a time lag between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu, resulting in a phase difference in the high-frequency range. The AcFOCUS system delays the preceding signal and matches the phase with the following signal to obtain an RF signal with less reading errors. Newly developed pickup is mounted on the pickup part. By using a high-magnification (7Ω.5Ωtimes) finite objective lens without the need for a collimator lens as in the past, we have achieved a stable optical path with a margin in the optical path length. In addition, by increasing the thickness of the half mirror as much as possible and designing the angle of incidence as large as possible, we minimize distortion caused by external forces, reduce harmful aberrations in the optical path, and improve the quality of the optical signal. The latest IC technology is also applied to the photodetector, and the buffer amplifier is integrated in the same IC to realize a signal system that is stable against disturbances. In addition, analysis technology using a large computer is utilized to mold the pickup body with resin to reduce the use of adhesive, which reduces reliability.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a twin power transformer that completely separates the servo / digital power supply and the audio power supply from the transformer itself. In addition, the OFC extra-thick 4Ω-core power cord that separates the core wire from the base of the power plug reduces the subtle influence (wraparound) from the servo circuit and the digital circuit to the audio circuit. In addition, the audio transformer uses OFC bifilar winding and silica sand resin impregnation that suppresses vibration.

POWER SUPPLY
For audio circuits, we have adopted a discrete push-pull power supply circuit that uses high-precision components such as constant current diodes to stabilize the power supply and suppress fluctuations in the power supply voltage.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, we have adopted a remote sensing method that detects changes in the voltage at the load end, feeds back the voltage, and controls the voltage, greatly reducing the effect of pattern impedance from the power supply circuit to the load end. The audio circuit uses a large circuit board of 140Ωx300Ωmm, on which parts are arranged in an appropriate pattern layout independently and symmetrically on the left and right sides. In addition, a double-sided circuit board is used to enhance the shielding effect, and the structure is completely separated from the servo system circuit to eliminate mutual interference.

POWER SUPPLY
An A-class FET buffer amplifier is used in the analog circuit to realize stable waveform transmission that is not affected by load fluctuation of the power supply, mutual interference of each circuit, load of the pre-stage and post-stage amplifier. The conventional digital signal circuit had separate clock circuits for the decoder, D/A converter, and system control microcomputer. However, in the PD 3000Ω, the D/A converter, digital filter, decoder, and system control microcomputer are synchronized by the clock. This prevents the generation of beats due to interference of multiple clocks. In order to protect the pickup from unnecessary vibration, non-resonance lamisert mechanical base is adopted. The mechanical base supporting the pickup is made into a double structure, copper plating is applied to the base of the pickup side, and it is molded with special resin. This greatly improves the vibration damping characteristics, and at the same time eliminates the effect of magnetic strain. In order to eliminate as much as possible the effects of unnecessary intermittent vibration and flux generated by the power transformer, an isolated transformer base is set outside the player. Ultra thick aluminum angle and solid brass insulator are adopted, and the transformer block is floating structure. The chassis has a honeycomb shape that greatly increases rigidity. The 1Ω.2Ωmm thick steel plate provides excellent vibration damping characteristics. The entire chassis is plated with copper to achieve the same effect as two metals bonded together with copper plating, greatly reducing unnecessary vibration and magnetostriction. Pioneer's vibration analysis technology vibration analysis technology, we have developed a disc stabilizer to improve sound quality by suppressing disc resonance. In particular, the PD-3000Ωuses a vertical clamp structure to further improve disc mounting accuracy, and a magnet catch system without mechanical contact between the disc stabilizer and the clamper that supports it to completely suppress unnecessary disc vibration. In order to protect the optical system mechanism from external vibration, it is floated from the chassis. It uses a low center of gravity coaxial suspension made of special rubber and spring with excellent damping characteristics. It is fixed by ceramic support columns with high rigidity and high internal loss. A large insulator with high vibration damping characteristics is used for the insulator, and the honeycomb shape is molded with resin to increase rigidity. The analog output terminal uses independent gold plated pin jacks on the left and right to minimize contact resistance and provide mechanical strength as well as the effect of the gold-plated terminal that is resistant to aging. We also use high-grade components for audio, such as resistors and capacitors, for repeated trial listening. The pickup is driven by a linear motor system with excellent response speed.

MOTOR
In addition, the spindle motor is equipped with a high-torque brushless D. D. motor with three times the starting torque of conventional motors. The tray section is made of special resin with high specific gravity to improve weight and accuracy. At the same time, the sliding section is made of metal bearing metal, combined with the wire drive system to realize smooth and quiet loading operation. Built-in functions include a memory backup function that stores the program when the power was turned off last time, a time fade edit function that automatically fades out according to the tape time, a music window that automatically plays specified phrases in and out, a one touch fade function, variable fade time, and auto space. Equipped with a changeover switch that stops the operation of unused circuits, it can cut off noise sources from unused circuits. In addition, the headphone circuit operates only when it is plugged into a jack. In addition, an FL off switch is also equipped to prevent scanning noise when the FL indicator is turned on."

description:
## Description

"A reference CD player developed by combining Pioneer's proprietary laser and digital technology, servo technology, and non-resonance technology. Equipped with 8Ωfs real 18Ωbit direct linear conversion. First, the 8Ωx oversampling digital filter uses a high-precision LSI with an operation word length of 20Ωx22Ωbit to improve the calculation accuracy. In addition to obtaining high-precision data, the sampling frequency is shifted up 8Ωtimes to 352Ω.8ΩkHz, increasing the density of quantized data and reducing the load on the analog filter. In addition, the D/A converter uses the handpicked Pioneer Super Version of the one package real 18ΩbitLSI one package real 18Ω, especially with regard to linearity and low-level distortion. In addition, by using the linear envelope method to adjust each bit to an appropriate value one by one, high-precision D/A conversion is achieved by converting not only MSB, which has a high importance of pit errors, but also 2Ωsb, 3Ωsb, and 4Ωsb to minimize errors. This greatly reduces the distortion caused by 0Ωcross distortion and bit error. In order to minimize the signal path, a CD direct conversion is adopted, and the signal path from the pickup to the output terminal is minimized and each circuit block is arranged properly. For this reason, the main circuit is laid out at the shortest distance along the signal flow, such as by placing the optical system mechanism in the center. Moreover, the wiring materials are also made as short as possible to minimize exposure. In order to make CD direct construction more thorough and effective, digital and servo, analog circuit board and power circuit board are separated independently. Moreover, analog circuit board adopts full monoconstruction of Lch and Rch from the digital data stage in pursuit of homogeneity of Lch and Rch, reducing interference between signals. In addition, it uses a sealed PCB (double-sided substrate) that achieves low impedance grounding and provides effective shielding against digital noise. In addition, low-impedance 70ΩÏ‰ m ultra-thick OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrates are used for Lch/Rch analog substrates and power supply substrates. The pickup is equipped with an in-house developed clean laser pickup with improved laser efficiency. By reducing the number of optical components such as the collimator lens, the power loss of the optical system is greatly reduced compared with conventional pickups, and the aberration in the optical path is also reduced, enabling more accurate signal pickup. A built-in I/V in I/V conversion head amplifier. The laser beam that bounces off the pit surface is converted into an electric signal of several microamperes by the photodetector. In the clean laser pickup, the photodetector has a built-in I/V amplifier and is amplified to approximately 200Ωmv order, so that a signal resistant to disturbance noise can be sent out. In order to obtain highly accurate RF signals from pit signals, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system. When a four part photodetector for focus servo receives a laser beam, a phase difference occurs due to the time difference between the preceding signal and the following signal, causing a disturbance in the synthesized RF signal. In the Accu-Focus system, a delay circuit delays the preceding signal to match the phase with the following signal. As a result, a high-output RF signal with few read errors can be obtained.

POWER SUPPLY
The power transformer is a twin power transformer configuration in which analog circuits and digital / servo circuits are completely separated to prevent mutual interference between analog and digital / servo circuits.

POWER SUPPLY
In particular, we have adopted bifilar twist windings made of OFC wire for the windings of transformers for audio circuits, increasing the balance of � voltage and output impedance of the power supply to the level of � 2Ωtransformer system, and improving driving performance in the low-frequency range. In addition, a 4Ω-core OFC cord is used for the power cord, and the analog circuit and digital / servo circuit are independent from the power plug to prevent the inflow of digital noise from the power supply. Moreover, to prevent vibration and induction noise generated by the power transformer from being transmitted to the main body, the transformer is mounted on an isorated base, which is an extremely thick aluminum angle separated from the main chassis. Moreover, the isorated base floats with the main body and is supported by special brass legs.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply unit uses a push-pull power supply system. Current control elements are installed in parallel so that the power supply voltage can be stabilized by controlling the current control elements when the load current suddenly changes. In addition, high stability is achieved by increasing the number of discrete components and introducing high-quality sound devices. This suppresses fluctuations in the power supply voltage and improves the transient response characteristics. In addition to realizing low impedance, the harmonic distortion of the power supply is also kept low. In addition, a 2Ω-transformer, 4Ω-part, 19Ω-regulator, low-impedance 70ΩÏ‰ m ultra-thick OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrate is used to prevent interference between blocks. A class A operation FET buffer amplifier is used in all stages after the D/A converter. By reducing the load of each stage and reducing the output impedance of the amplifier as a whole, the analog section is not affected by capacitance components such as low-pass filters which become the load of the amplifier. By using Class-A operation, fluctuation of power consumption during operation can be reduced, and low distortion factor is realized.

MOTOR
The spindle motor of the disk drive mechanism is equipped with a high-torque coreless D. D.

MOTOR
spindle motor with a starting torque of 65Ωg/cm. In addition, the spindle diameter is extremely large (4Ω.5Ωmm), making it resistant to load fluctuations and providing stable disk drive performance.

MOTOR
In addition, a high-speed linear motor with fast tracking response is used for the pickup drive to realize accurate tracing and high-speed access with an average of 0Ω.5Ωseconds or less. Taking note of the adverse effect of disc resonance on sound quality, we have adopted a vertical clamp type disc stabilizer that improves mounting accuracy with the disc. In addition, it employs a magnet catch system without mechanical contact between the stabilizer and clamper, which thoroughly reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk and ensures smooth rotation. Lamisert mechanical base is adopted as the mechanical base supporting the optical mechanism. This is made by molding two sheets of steel plate with special resin. Furthermore, by plating the steel plate on the pickup side with copper, vibration damping characteristics are improved and the influence of magnetic strain is eliminated. Also, this mechanical base is fixed to a ceramic support called ceramic mechanical support via a coaxial suspension, which is a special rubber and spring integrated coaxially, and blocks vibration from the chassis. The chassis uses a copper-plated hybrid honeycomb chassis, an evolution of the honeycomb chassis. First, the honeycomb chassis is plated with copper to achieve excellent vibration control and reduced magnetic distortion. In addition, superfine pile is electrostatically implanted on the floor side of the honeycomb chassis to suppress high-frequency reflection from the floor and minute vibration on the chassis surface. This enables total control from unwanted vibration with large amplitude to minute vibration. Large-size honeycomb insulators made of special resin molded into a honeycomb shape are used as insulators. It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that starts scanning only when the operation key is pressed to reduce noise. In addition, it is also equipped with a display-off switch that turns off the display when it is not necessary, paying attention to the slight scanning noise that occurs when the display turns on. In addition, it is equipped with a digital analogout change-over switch that stops the operation of unused circuits and prevents noise contamination. The front panel uses a lacquer style panel made of extra-thick extruded aluminum material. It is equipped with 2Ωsystems of digital out which is coaxial with light. It is equipped with a time location function that can locate in units of 1Ωsecond in a stop state."

description:
## Description

"A CD player with a new disc stabilizer. In order to prevent the slight vibration of the disc itself, which adversely affects the performance, the material and shape have been improved, and a new disc stabilizer with newly developed special resin has been adopted on the surface of the material. In addition, by using a ball-aligning disk stabilizer composed of four ball bearings, the rotational axis of the disk stabilizer is automatically aligned with the rotational axis of the disk table. This eliminates the misalignment of the rotational axis while maintaining the necessary play of the disk stabilizer.

MOTOR
A linear servo system has been adopted to further improve the basic characteristics of the pickup, eliminate unnecessary resonance and crosstalk of the actuator, and prevent sound skipping by appropriate servo characteristics and gain control. A newly developed small-size pickup is used for the pickup part. It uses a new type actuator and has a structure in which the lens base, which is measured while ensuring sufficient secondary moment of section, is supported by a beryllium copper spring with a special hardened surface. This spring has a waveform shape that takes into consideration the vibration dynamics. It efficiently drives the center of gravity of the movable part with a simple magnetic circuit and follows the pit together with the servo circuit. In addition, the magnetic circuit is supported by a base with high internal loss, making it resistant to external vibration. In order to achieve sufficient rigidity and compact shape, the body is box-shaped and thin-walled precision aluminum die-cast is used. A pure transmission system has been adopted in pursuit of high-purity transmission. The digital part reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk due to the disk stabilizer and eliminates the adverse effect of external noise on the digital signal. In the audio section, a low-noise low-output impedance regulator is placed close to the audio circuit on the PCB to supply each block circuit with reduced impedance rise. In addition, the use of IC common to L and R is eliminated, and L and R symmetrical straight pattern is adopted. High rigidity is achieved by incorporating honeycomb ribs in the chassis. In addition, in order to protect the optical system mechanism from external vibration, the center of gravity is designed to be lower than the support part of the mechanism. As a result, unstable lateral vibration is reduced and more stable signal reading is possible. It has a 6Ω-digit display that shows the performance status, track number and elapsed time. You can play 24Ωsongs in a program. It also has a repeat function for all songs / programs / one song. Equipped with track search and 3Ω-speed manual search. Mio LEDs will flash while moving in accordance with the mechanical movement for disc search. In addition, the disk number displayed on the FL display is counted at high speed, so you can check where the mechanism is moving now. The mechanism is equipped with Pioneer's newly developed Lorin Dreyfuss G. R. C. Mio system mechanism. This system was developed with the aim of good operability. By connecting the signal recorded on the disk with a function curve that is set close to the original signal, it is possible to reproduce the original waveform. In accordance with the 1Ω/f attenuation characteristic, the component of 20ΩkHz or higher can also be reproduced, which realizes more natural music reproduction. An Automatic Digital Level Controller (ADLC) is installed to reduce the difference in volume level between disks. In order to estimate the waveform of the original sound from the data recorded on CD, 16Ω-bit data in CD format is re-quantized into 24Ω-bit data. The dynamic range is expanded to 120ΩdB, the maximum amount that the human ear can completely recover, and quantization distortion is reduced to reproduce a smooth waveform closer to the original sound. It is equipped with Legato link conversion and reproduces music signals above the audible band of more than 20ΩkHz cut in CD format by estimating from signals within the audible band and 1Ω/f characteristics. DAC24Ωis used for the D/A conversion part. The DAC24Ωachieves 24Ω-bit resolution by providing eight levels in the amplitude direction. It faithfully converts data (24Ω-bit resolution, approximately 40ΩkHz frequency band) expanded by Hi-bit and Legato link conversion, and achieves a resolution of 120ΩdB or higher in the band up to 40ΩkHz.

POWER SUPPLY

## Description

"This is the first generation CD player using the turntable system. It uses a CD turntable system developed from a disk stabilizer. By installing the pickup and spindle motor on the upper part of the disc, it is possible to support the disc from the bottom to the entire surface of the turntable just like an analog player. As a result, the moment of inertia of the turntable has been improved to about three times that of the conventional one, and it is resistant to external vibration, sound pressure, warped disks, etc., so that unnecessary vibration of the disk can be suppressed. The D/A converter is equipped with an 8Ωfs digital filter and a left-right independent bit stream D/A converter. In principle, this D/A converter is free from non-linear distortion or 0Ωcross distortion caused by resistor error or operation timing difference like the multi-bit system. Moreover, the effect of the noise shaper is kept low by over-sampling as high as 192Ωfs based on the third order noise shaper. In the 1Ω-bit system, all operations are controlled by the system clock, and jitter in the system clock affects performance. To avoid this effect, the system clock is operated at the same low system clock (16Ω.93ΩMHz) as the conventional multi-bit system. We also pay attention to the application, and provide vibration and magnetic resistance processing such as an independent oscillation circuit. In order to transmit music signals pure, direct construction is adopted. By laying out main circuits simply and straight along the signal flow, the shortest signal path is realized. In addition to the center tray design with the pick-up mechanism in the center, the digital / servo and audio circuit boards are separated to prevent interference in each circuit. The analog circuit board is also connected from the input terminal to the output terminal by the shortest distance, making it symmetrical. This eliminates interference between circuits and noise caused by the routing of wiring materials. The pickup uses a clean laser pickup developed in-house, reducing power loss in the optical system by reducing the number of optical components such as collimator lenses, and reducing aberrations in the optical path, making it possible to pick up signals with less distortion. In addition, an engineering plastic body is used for the body, and by dividing the pickup body into approximately 1000Ωelements and performing strength analysis, a high-precision and precise shape is realized. In addition, the photodetector has a built-in I/V conversion head amplifier that amplifies the signal to the order of approximately 200ΩmV, enabling transmission that is resistant to disturbance noise. The audio circuit uses a class-A FET buffer amplifier to reduce the output impedance and the influence of the load of the connected amplifier. In addition, Class-A operation reduces fluctuations in power consumption during operation and realizes stable waveform transmission. A high-precision four section photodetector generates a phase difference between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu signal when it receives laser light. To solve this problem, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system. By delaying the leading signal with a delay circuit and matching it with the trailing signal, we can obtain an RF-signal with less reading error.

MOTOR
The spindle motor is equipped with a brushless Hall motor with a starting torque of 65Ωg Ï‰ cm. In addition, combined with a thick � 4Ω.5Ωmm shaft, it demonstrates stable rotational performance that is resistant to load fluctuations. Lamisert mechanical base is adopted to protect the optical mechanism from external vibration. This is made by molding two sheets of steel plate with special resin, and copper plating is applied to improve vibration damping characteristics and suppress the occurrence of magnetic strain. This mechanical base is mounted on a mechanical chassis via a coaxial suspension made of special rubber and springs, and the turntable base is also mounted via a coaxial suspension. Each of these mounts has a flow and structure to prevent external vibration from the chassis. A newly developed multi-layered honeycomb chassis has been adopted. It is based on a honeycomb chassis made of BMC (Bulk Molding Compound) with high internal loss and high rigidity. It is layered with steel plate and cushion material with excellent electromagnetic shielding. It reduces unnecessary vibration by excellent vibration control effect and reduces the reflection of sound from the floor. The fifth insulator is installed in the center of the chassis to provide vibration resistance and weight balance, and to support the center mechanism.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply is equipped with twin power transformers for digital / servo circuits and analog circuits.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, a bifilar winding is used in the transformer for the audio circuit to increase the balance of output impedance and inductance so that the power supply on the + side and the power supply on the - side can be supplied under the same conditions, improving transparency and driving feeling in low frequency range.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply circuit employs a 4Ω-part 11Ω-regulator, which independently rectifies four parts of servo / digital, servo drive and audio + and - to eliminate mutual interference. It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that operates only when the operation key is pressed, and it cancels the scanning noise. Equipped with a digital / analog logout selection switch. A display off switch is installed to prevent scanning noise when the display is turned on."

description:
## Description

"This CD player was the first to adopt a unique turntable system based on the concept of no vibration and no resonance disc developed in the development of disc stabilizers. In the CD turntable system, a pickup and a spindle motor are installed on the top of the disc to hold the entire disc from the bottom. Therefore, the disc is placed on the turntable with the pit surface facing upward. The disc rotates together with the turntable, and the pickup on the top of the disc reads the pit. This mechanism is not only affected by external vibration and sound pressure, but also by the large inertia unique to the CD turntable mechanism, it is possible to suppress unnecessary vibration even when the rotational state changes due to a disc with a sled. In addition, the moment of inertia of the turntable is approximately three times higher than that of the conventional one. It also works advantageously against torque ripple and cogging.

MOTOR
Combined with the spindle motor with a starting torque of 65Ωg Ï‰ cm, it is robust against load fluctuations and provides highly stable drive performance. As a result, the generation of jitter in the read signal due to vibration and surface blur is reduced by approximately 15Ω%. We have adopted an in-house developed Clean Laser Pickup. By reducing the number of optical components such as collimator lenses, the power loss of the optical system is reduced, and aberrations in the optical path are also reduced, making it possible to read a clean and low-distortion pit signal. In addition, it uses a photodetector with built-in I/V conversion head amplifier to amplify a weak signal of several Ï‰ A to the order of approximately 200ΩmV, enabling transmission that is less affected by disturbance noise. A high-precision engineering plastic body is used for the pickup body. By dividing the pickup body into approximately 1000Ωelements and performing strength analysis, a high-precision and precise shape is realized. The pickup drive is equipped with a silent linear motor servo mechanism with excellent response and low vibration.

MOTOR
In addition, in order to rotate the CD turntable with large inertia mass, the spindle motor is equipped with a large brushless hole motor with starting torque of 65Ωg Ï‰ cm. In addition, it is combined with an extra-thick shaft of � 4Ω.5Ωmm, so that the drive performance is strong against load fluctuations and stable against rotational speed fluctuations from the inner circumference to the outer circumference. In order to obtain high-precision focus servo, the photodetector is divided into four parts. However, when receiving laser light, a phase difference occurs between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu signal, causing a disturbance in the synthesized RF-signal. To solve this problem, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system. By delaying the preceding signal with a delay circuit to match the phase with the following signal, we can obtain an RF signal with less signal reading error. The D/A converter uses an 8Ωfs digital filter and a left-right independent bit stream 1Ω-bit DAC. New Bit Stream The 1Ω-bit DAC has only one electronic switch and one current source, and the analog quantity is expressed by the on/off of one electronic switch. This eliminates the problem of the error of the resistor and the difference of the operation timing unlike the multi-bit DAC. Therefore, it has excellent linearity and in principle, there is no non-linearity or 0Ωcross distortion. In addition, while multi-bit DACs express analog signals in terms of vertical amplitude width (pulse height), 1Ω-bit DACs express them in terms of horizontal time axis (coarse and dense waves of pulses), so it is called PDM (Pulse Density Modulation) method. In response to digital data input, pulses are generated at a high speed of tens of thousandths of a second, and analog signal waveforms are converted into coarse and dense waves of pulses. In the 1Ω-bit DAC, noise shaping is performed to reduce requantization noise caused by bit compression. In the PD-T07Ω, over-sampling as high as 192Ωfs is performed at the pre-stage, and the signal is sent to the third order noise shaper to suppress the influence of out-of-band noise. A system clock as low as 16Ω.93ΩMHz is used as the system clock necessary to control all operations of the 1Ω-bit DAC to suppress the effect of jitter. Attention is also paid to the application, and an independent oscillation circuit is provided, and anti-vibration and anti-magnetic processing are applied. Lamisert mechanical base is adopted to protect the optical mechanism from vibration from the outside. This is made by molding two sheets of steel plate with special resin, and copper plating is applied to improve vibration damping characteristics and suppress the occurrence of magnetic strain. This mechanical base is mounted on a mechanical chassis via a coaxial suspension with special rubber and springs, and the lower turntable base is also mounted via a coaxial suspension. The float structure prevents external vibration from the chassis. Using direct construction, each circuit block is laid out simply and straight along the signal flow, and the shortest signal path is realized. In addition, the digital / servo and audio circuit boards are separated to prevent mutual interference. In addition, a sealed PCB (double-sided circuit board) is used for the digital and analog circuit boards to provide an advantageous shielding effect against noise jumping from the digital to the analog circuit boards. In addition, the analog circuit boards are also connected at the shortest distance from the input terminal to the output terminal and have a symmetrical configuration. The audio circuit after D/A conversion uses a class-A operation FET buffer amplifier. By reducing the output impedance, the influence of the load of the connected amplifier is reduced. In addition, by using class-A operation, fluctuations in power consumption during operation can be reduced, the influence on other circuits is reduced, and a low distortion factor is realized.

POWER SUPPLY
The power transformer is a twin power transformer for digital / servo circuits and analog circuits.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the transformer for the audio circuit has a bifilar winding, and by increasing the balance of output impedance and inductance, the + side and - side power supply are supplied under the same condition, contributing to sound quality improvement. In addition, the four parts of servo / digital, servo drive, and audio + and - are independently rectified to eliminate mutual interference. In particular, the audio power supply uses a discrete push-pull power supply to provide a power supply with low output impedance and strong resistance to load fluctuations. In addition, the left and right independent power supplies are used for the DAC. The power supply for the servo drive is separated into one for the turntable and another for other drives. By stabilizing each power supply, the influence of motor and actuator operation is eliminated. Newly developed multi-layer honeycomb chassis is used for the chassis. This chassis is based on a honeycomb chassis made of BMC (Bulk Molding Compound), which has high internal loss and excellent vibration resistance and strength. Steel plates and cushioning materials with excellent electromagnetic shielding are layered to achieve high rigidity and excellent vibration resistance. In addition, the PD-T07Ωis plated with copper to reduce magnetostriction and improve vibration resistance. In addition to the large honeycomb insulator that absorbs external vibration, a fifth insulator is installed in the center of the chassis to ensure vibration control and weight balance and support the center mechanism. A cushion material with excellent damping properties is attached to the thick extruded aluminum bonnet to eliminate resonance. The power cord is a 4Ω-core cord that separates the core wire from the power plug for the servo system and analog system only. In addition, it uses OFC (high-purity oxygen-free copper). We use carefully selected items such as capacitors and resistors for audio. In addition, the circuit boards and parts are shielded so that high frequency waves do not escape from them and affect other circuits. In addition to the full-face sealed servo board and the use of glass-epoxy double-sided boards for audio circuits, capacitors and wiring materials are also treated uniquely to prevent noise. A balanced output terminal is provided so that it can be connected to an amplifier with a balanced input. It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that operates only when the key is pressed, and it cancels weak scanning noise. In addition, it is equipped with a display off switch that suppresses noise generation when lighting. Equipped with a digital / anlogout changeover switch."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"John Bamford, who wrote for Hi-Fi Answer (now Audio File) and edited for Hi-Fi Choice magazine, decided the sound of the UK series CD player. It is equipped with legato link conversion for more natural sound quality. This circuit connects the data of a music signal recorded on a disk with a smooth function curve suitable for reproducing natural sounds and the frequency components of musical instruments. This circuit makes it possible to reproduce a sound close to the original music signal with little ringing (waveform disturbance). At the same time, it makes it possible to reproduce a sound of 20ΩkHz or higher according to the 1Ω/f attenuation characteristics, resulting in smoother and more natural reproduction sound.

TURNTABLE
In order to eliminate unnecessary vibration of the disk, a turntable system is adopted as the mechanism. By supporting the disk on the entire surface of the turntable, it is resistant to external vibration and warpage, and suppresses unnecessary vibration of the disk. In addition, by the large moment of inertia, it is resistant to load fluctuation, and realizes stable rotational performance, and reduces deterioration of servo characteristics and jitters. The D/A converter employs a high-speed pulse flow D/A converter independently developed by Pioneer on the left and right sides to reduce interference between channels. This D/A converter takes advantage of the 1Ω-bit system, which does not in principle cause 0Ωcross distortion or glitch noise. In order to eliminate the influence of requantization noise on sound quality, the D/A converter performs noise shaping at an oversampling frequency as high as 384Ωfs. This enables detailed calculation and greatly reduces the noise in the audible band caused by requantization. In addition, the D/A converter uses a low-order noise shaper to minimize the influence of out-of-band noise. The effect of jitter is also reduced by operating the master clock at a low clock frequency of 16Ω.93ΩMHz. In pursuit of simplicity and high quality, it uses direct construction. The pickup mechanism is placed in the center of the chassis in a center tray design. In addition, the main circuits such as digital / servo circuits, audio circuits and power supply are laid out along the signal flow, and the pickup is connected to the output terminal with the shortest distance. This prevents interference between circuits and reduces noise.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply is equipped with two separate power transformers for the digital / servo circuit and for the audio circuit to prevent interference between the digital and audio circuits.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply circuit employs a 3Ω-part 7Ω-regulator, which independently rectifies three parts, digital / servo, D/A converter and audio, eliminating the influence between circuits. Honeycomb chassis is used for the chassis to suppress unnecessary vibration. We have also adopted a honeycomb structure insulator to absorb vibrations from the outside. It is equipped with computer program edit, time fade edit, auto program edit, peak search and memory hold functions. Equipped with a display off switch, it is possible to eliminate scanning noise when the display is on. Equipped with a digital / analog changeover switch. Equipped with CD-DECK synchro terminal."
