name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A DAT deck equipped with a broadband (HS : High Sampling) mode capable of 96Ωkhz high sampling. It uses a wide-band mode with a frequency of 96ΩkHz, twice that of conventional 48ΩkHz sampling. With this mode, the range is expanded to ultra-high frequencies and the smooth sound characteristic of the wide-band mode is obtained. In the wide-band mode, the signal processing LSI, capstan motor and drum motor operate at twice the speed of the standard mode, enabling recording and playback at frequencies exceeding 40ΩkHz. In the wide-band mode, the recording time is halved because the tape runs at twice the speed.(The wide-band HS mode has the same function as the WIDE mode of the D-07Ω, and the name has been changed.)In order to get closer to the original signal waveform, a legato link conversion is installed. This system performs digital signal processing based on the signal recorded on the tape and connects the data with a smooth function curve to obtain sound reproduction close to the original before recording on the tape. It also estimates the original signal before recording and reproduces sound of 20ΩkHz or higher according to the 1Ω/f attenuation characteristic to achieve more natural sound reproduction. The long duration (LP) mode allows twice the recording time of the standard (SP) mode for analog input recording and digital input recording with a sampling frequency of 32ΩkHz. This enables continuous recording for up to four hours on 120Ωminute tapes. Uses a high-output AT head. It is an all-track structure head with 20ΩÏ‰ m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. Glass is welded on both sides of the head to ensure abrasion resistance. In addition, a special polishing process is applied to the gap to realize a stable tape touch. The newly developed 1Ω-bit wide-range linear A/D converter and high-speed pulse flow 1Ω-bit D/A converter are used in the conversion section. The 1Ω-bit method has excellent linearity and is free from non-linear distortion and 0Ωcross distortion in principle. It reduces conversion errors in minute signals and improves linearity. It is equipped with a TOC function that records information such as program time and length of each song at the beginning of the tape. This function enables DAT to manage information such as the total number and time of songs, the song time of each song, the start time of each song, and the remaining time of the recorded part. It is equipped with high-speed AI search and subcode application functions. It reads subcode information recorded on the tape to learn the song number and the starting position of the song, and realizes high-speed AI search up to about 300Ωtimes (about 600Ωtimes for LP) by using this information. You can also record and erase various time information, a start ID that indicates the beginning of a song, a skip ID that is convenient for skipping a part you do not want to listen to, a pole number information, and an end ID that indicates the end of recording. At the beginning of each song (start ID part), you can store up to 60Ωcharacters of data such as the name of the song, the performer, and notes. The data can be recorded either on the remote control or on the console. The recorded information is scrolled on the counter display when each song starts. Equipped with a CD-Q code sync start ID recording function, start ID can be automatically recorded based on the track number and index in the CD-Q code data transmitted to the D-05Ωthrough the digital interface when recording digital input from CD. To eliminate adverse effects caused by clock signal fluctuations, we have adopted a clean clock circuit that separates the clock signal from both audio and digital signals. As a result, the oscillation itself of the clock that controls the system is cleared, and S/N and distortion factor are improved by driving independently. The chassis uses a honeycomb chassis with excellent vibration damping characteristics. The midship structure with the drive mechanism in the center improves the weight balance and suppresses vibration and resonance. It performs digital signal processing based on the signal recorded on the tape and connects the data with a smooth function curve, making it possible to reproduce sounds closer to the original before recording on the tape. In addition, by estimating the original signal before recording and reproducing the sound at 20ΩkHz or higher according to the 1Ω/f attenuation characteristics, more natural sound reproduction is achieved. ## Description

"Based on the D-07Ω, this DAT deck is equipped with Legato link conversion S and further improved sound quality. For recording and playback in the ultra-high-frequency range exceeding 20ΩkHz, it is equipped with a high-sampling (HS) mode in which the sampling frequency is increased from 48ΩkHz to 96ΩkHz, twice that of the conventional one, enabling recording and playback in a wide band up to 44ΩkHz. The maximum recording time in High Sampling mode is 1Ω/2Ωof the conventional Standard (SP) mode. It is equipped with Legato link conversion S. In the conventional Legato link conversion, the waveform of the original signal was estimated and reproduced based on the 1Ω/f attenuation characteristic for the component of 20ΩkHz or higher. However, in the Legato link conversion S, an independent harmonic generation circuit is added for overtones. The overtone component of 20ΩkHz or higher is generated from the attenuation characteristic based on the estimation of the original sound, and the reproduction band is expanded by adding it together with the time axis. When playing back digital sources such as CDs, it is equipped with a DAC mode that allows you to use only the D/A converter function with the newly developed Legato link conversion S. This mode converts the input digital source into an analog signal with a 20ΩkHz or higher component and outputs it. An 18Ω-bit multi-bit converter is used on the A/D side, and a dither circuit is incorporated to suppress non-linear distortion and 0Ωcross distortion. In addition, the D/A side employs a multi-bit DAC that eliminates the generation of 0Ωcross distortion by a unique method. In this method, two 20Ω-bit DACs with exactly the same characteristics are integrated into one chip, and + and - region waveforms are independently D/A converted. At that time, the conventional 1ΩLSB level difference is expressed by the presence or absence of 1ΩLSB compensation current, not by inversion of all bits including MSB. In principle, the generation of 0Ωcross distortion is eliminated, and reproducibility and linearity of small signals are improved. The head is equipped with a high-output AT head with precision technology for high-speed head rotation in high sampling mode. It is an all track structure with 20ΩÏ‰ m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. Glass is welded on both sides of the head to ensure high abrasion resistance. In addition, a special polishing process is applied to the gap to realize a stable tape touch. We take thorough anti-vibration and anti-vibration measures, including a panel stabilizer with anti-vibration rubber that suppresses microvibration around the front panel, a cassette stabilizer that securely holds tapes and prevents sound quality deterioration caused by vibration, a honeycomb chassis that supports mechanisms and circuits, and a large insulator and bonnet anti-vibration structure. Copper plating is applied to the chassis, mechanical base, and rear panel to reduce high-frequency impedance and noise. At the beginning of each song (start ID part) is equipped with a character recording function (character pack) that can record up to 60Ωcharacters of favorite information such as the name of the song, the name of the performer, and the title of the source. The recorded information is scrolled on the display at the start of each song and can be displayed again by pressing the button during the performance. It is equipped with a CD-Q code sync start ID recording function. When recording digital input from a CD, the start ID is automatically recorded based on the track number and index in the CD-Q code data transmitted by the digital interface. Even if there is no silence between songs, the start ID can be recorded reliably. It is equipped with a Table of Contents (TOC) function that records the number of recorded songs and time data of each song at the beginning of the tape. Equipped with digital faders, fade in and fade out functions for digital input recording / rerecording and analog input recording / rerecording. In addition, the operation functions during playback include random play and time skip using a microcomputer based on TOC information, one point memory which records points on the tape and plays them with one touch, and fine queue / review functions. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"In addition to the 4Ωfs18ΩbitA / D converter and 8Ωfs20ΩbitD / A converter, a dither circuit is installed on the DAT deck for high sound quality. A 4Ωfs18ΩbitA/D converter for the recording side and an 8Ωfs20ΩbitD/A converter for the playback side were installed for the first time in the DAT for high-precision signal processing. In addition, both the A/D and D/A converters are L/R-independent configuration, eliminating phase shift between channels and preventing distortion and noise. It is equipped with an A/D side dither circuit developed by a unique method applying the dither technology used in professional digital sound recorders. This circuit adds a dither signal outside the audible band to the analog input signal, performs A/D conversion, and then removes the dither signal with a digital filter to enable conversion with excellent linearity. It reproduces a more faithful signal by dispersing and averaging conversion errors caused by 0Ωcross distortion at a minute level. For high-quality source recording, a line-straight switch is installed. By turning the switch ON, the signal can be input to the A/D converter without passing through the input volume and the 5Ωth low-pass filter. This minimizes the signal path and reduces phase distortion. The audio circuit board uses twin monoconstruction for improved separation. The recording / reproducing and L/R circuit blocks are divided into four sections. The placement of parts and the length and routing of wires are symmetrical to eliminate interference between each circuit block. In addition, the spacing between the input / output pin jacks is taken into consideration in the terminal layout to improve channel separation. In order to achieve high sound quality, the printed circuit board for audio uses double-sided boards made of single-sided solid earth foils to provide shielding effect and greatly reduce noise. In addition, the ground line on the board uses bus bars made of 1Ωmm thick extra-thick oxygen-free copper plates to reduce the impedance of the ground and improve the rigidity and sound quality. In addition, it is designed with high sound quality to every detail, and selected capacitors and resistors are used. The head is equipped with a high-power AT head developed by integrating Pioneer's original advanced precision processing technology. This head features an AT (All Track) structure with 20ΩÏ‰ m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. In addition, glass is welded on both sides in order to improve abrasion resistance, and special polishing is applied to the gap which is the entrance of the signal to realize more stable tape touch. Furthermore, by increasing the playback output level by 2ΩdB to 6ΩdB, it is possible to read signals with high precision and low error rate. The mechanism uses a highly rigid flat chassis made of 1Ω.6Ωmm thick material. In order to prevent the generation of strain due to bending process, this steel plate has been specially processed into a flat structure to reduce unnecessary vibration generated by the mechanism. The mechanism and power transformer, which are sources of vibration, are fixed to an isolated chassis independent from the main chassis. In addition, the isolated chassis is grounded with a dedicated zinc die-cast insulator and mechanically separated from the audio unit mounted on the main chassis to eliminate the adverse effects of unwanted vibrations. In order to suppress vibration of the cassette half, Pioneer's original cassette stabilizer is mounted. By sandwiching the cassette half with special rubber at the top and bottom and pressing it with resin at two places on the left and right, the cassette half is firmly fixed and the double anti-vibration structure realizes the stable running of the tape. Large honeycomb insulators and copper-plated honeycomb chassis are used to prevent harmful external vibrations from being transmitted to the mechanism and each circuit.

POWER SUPPLY
The power transformer uses a large power transformer consisting of a bifilar OFC winding with separate windings for audio and digital circuits. The case is filled with epoxy resin to suppress vibration of the transformer body. Equipped with 2Ω-mode ON/OFF function of FL display which is a source of digital noise. In half-OFF mode, if the display is turned off due to something other than playback or recording, segments other than the pole number display are turned off. In full-OFF mode, if the display is turned off during playback or recording, all segments are turned off. By examining the material and shape of the gear belt, we have adopted a silent mechanism that reduces the operating noise when the tape is running or when the cassette is attached or removed. The quick response mechanism also reduces the amount of time between tape insertion and sound. Equipped with an intelligent peak monitor, you can easily record high quality by simply adjusting the recording level volume to -01ΩdB. The peak margin display shows the amount of dB remaining based on the maximum allowable level (full bit / 00ΩdB for digital signals), and displays the range from -50ΩdB to 00ΩdB in 1ΩdB steps. The over-level display shows the level exceeding the maximum allowable level in 1ΩdB steps up to + 8ΩdB. The recording volume attenuation display shows the recording volume attenuation in 1ΩdB steps from 0ΩdB to 36ΩdB. It is equipped with a TOC function that stores the program time and the length of each song in the first position of the tape. With an AI search of approximately 300Ωtimes (at the fastest time), more comfortable operation is realized. AI search by program number and AI search by TOC information are available. Wireless remote control is included."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"Pioneer's first DAT deck. In order to ensure that the input and output waveforms are identical, an oversampling re-independent double digital filter configuration, which was not used even in professional PCM recorders, is employed. By operating the D/A converter at twice the normal sampling frequency on the playback side, the digital filter reduces the load on the analog low-pass filter in the latter stage and improves the frequency characteristics, distortion factor, and group delay characteristics. In the conventional digital filter, only an analog low-pass filter with steep attenuation characteristics was used for A/D conversion during recording, so the distortion and phase delay of the analog filter caused considerable distortion and distortion in the music signal. The D-1000Ωis equipped with a digital filter on the recording side to achieve low-distortion sound quality with excellent phase characteristics up to the high frequency range. The D/A converter is equipped with an oversampling glitch less D/A converter. In conventional resistive ladder-type D/A converters, it takes time to stabilize the analog output after the digital data is input to the D/A converter due to variations in the response of each switching. As a result, a glitch, a type of noise, occurs in the output. The D-1000Ωsolves this problem by speeding up the operation of the D/A converter and improving the sound quality by realizing a simple signal path that does not go through the digricher by making it glitch less. In addition, the use of independent D/A converters on the left and right sides eliminates the phase difference between the channels. The audio circuit board uses twin monoconstruction. In this configuration, the recording / playback and L/R circuits are divided into four sections, and the arrangement of parts and the length of wires are symmetrical to eliminate interference between each block. In addition, noise is greatly reduced by grounding one side of the audio printed circuit board.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, bus bars made of 1Ωmm thick oxygen-free copper plates are used for power supply lines and ground lines on the circuit board to reduce ground impedance and increase the rigidity of the circuit board. All condensers and resistors are made of high-quality sound components. Metalized polyester film capacitors with non-inductive OFC lead wires are used as coupling capacitors for analog signal paths, and OFC lead wires and gold-plated brass cap mold carbon film resistors are used as signal resistors. In addition, oxygen-free copper wires are used for signal wiring. The slide volume is the same as that used in professional mixing consoles, enabling fine adjustment of recording levels and greatly improving the separation characteristics at high frequencies. A newly developed cassette stabilizer is installed to suppress tape vibration and ensure stable operation. In the cassette stabilizer, vibration is suppressed by sandwiching the cassette half with special resin material from above and below. In order to reduce vibration from the outside, a large solid brass insulator with excellent vibration damping characteristics is adopted. In addition, the insulator is firmly secured to the double chassis with oxygen-free copper washers and copper-screws to eliminate vibration. It uses a copper-plated chassis to greatly reduce magnetic distortion, which adversely affects sound quality, and shields the digital circuit to prevent unwanted interference from the digital circuit, creating a clear separation between the digital and analog circuits. The power supply is composed of 7Ωindependent 2Ω-transformer power supplies that separate the digital and analog systems, eliminating interference from the digital system to the analog system. The analog transformer has a 2Ω-winding power supply configuration that is strong enough to handle large load fluctuations, and oxygen-free copper wires are used for the windings and lead wires. The digital transformer also has a 5Ω-winding power supply configuration that uses oxygen-free copper wires for stable power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
The circuit board that makes up the entire power supply circuit is made of copper foil with a thickness of 70ΩÏ‰ m, twice as thick as the normal one, to reduce impedance. Pioneer's original linear skating mechanism is adopted for the deck mechanism part, and combined with high rigidity shaft and linear bearing, excellent quietness and reliability are obtained. In the linear skating mechanism, the deck mechanism is incorporated into the cassette and can be operated while monitoring the tape running condition. In addition, operability is improved by the auto lead-in function, which automatically mounts and skates just by inserting the cassette, and the auto lead-out function, which allows the cassette to be ejected with one touch. The motor section employs a 4Ωdd mechanism using two drum motors, capstan motors and reel motors. High reliability is achieved by a high-precision digital servo system and a highly stable tension speed control system. Equipped with a peak margin indicator, it is possible to make appropriate adjustments for digital recording that will cause sudden distortion when the level meter exceeds 0ΩdB (maximum quantization level). Equipped with a digital drive peak meter that displays digital signals directly as bars. By directly driving the meter with a digital signal, it enables accurate level monitoring during recording. The meter is Oatley set with a peak held for approximately 3Ωseconds. Both digital and analog inputs can monitor extremely accurate recording levels, and the maximum digital signal level can be read even when the signal is emphasized, so there are no recording errors. It is equipped with the easy operation function using subcode which is unique to DAT deck. Equipped with an auto ID recording function, you can automatically record the start ID and program number that indicate the beginning of the track during recording. You can also cancel this function. In addition, the manual ID recording function allows you to set or erase a start ID or skip ID anywhere you want. Equipped with a Oatley number function, you can record by adding to a tape that has been recorded up to a certain part, or automatically organize the number of songs after adding or deleting the start ID manually. Equipped with a program number setting function, you can freely set the program number at the start of recording. It is equipped with one shot direct music selection function, and you can play the desired music just by specifying the program number and pressing play button. Equipped with skip playback function, you can skip unnecessary parts and play (with cancel function)Equipped with a guiding operation function, the microcomputer detects and displays the ID mode and tape status, and by operating according to the display, the ID can be recorded or erased reliably. It is equipped with a blank monitor function so that unrecorded parts can be recognized during playback, fast-forward or rewind. Equipped with an emphasis ON/OFF function. Music signals generally have fewer high-frequency components than low-frequency components, so you can improve the dynamic range and S/N ratio in the high-frequency range by pre-emphasizing the high-frequency components during recording and de-emphasizing the high-frequency components during playback. On the D-1000Ω, you can record by turning the emphasis ON/OFF according to your preference, and playback is automatically switched during playback. Two types of digital input / output terminals are installed : coaxial and optical. The optical cable terminal can be switched ON/OFF. It is equipped with a music search function that enables you to skip songs, introscan that plays the beginning of a song every 10Ωseconds, Oatley wind, repeat, and a program playback function of up to 50Ωsongs. It is equipped with a time calculation function using the 60Ωdecimal system which is convenient for calculating the remaining time of the tape. Equipped with timer recording and replay function. In the REC/PAUSE and REC states, both analog and digital source monitors are available, so you can use it as an A/D converter or D/A converter. The REC/PAUSE state is released in five minutes, but the music signal is still output. If you input the digital output of a CD, you can monitor, but not record. You can play back tapes recorded at 32ΩkHz/16Ωbit. It comes with a wireless remote control with numeric keys that can perform almost all operations at hand."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"DAT deck equipped with Hi-bit and Legato link conversion S. The sampling frequency has been raised to 96ΩkHz, twice that of the conventional one, and it is equipped with high sampling (HS) mode which enables wide-band recording and playback of up to 44ΩkHz. The rotation speed of the tape-speed drum has been increased to twice that of the conventional one, eliminating unnecessary ringing. In order to achieve more faithful reproduction of the original sound, it is equipped with Hi-bit technology that focuses on minute level signals less than the number of quantization bits. By re-quantizing 16Ω-bit DAT data to 24Ω-bit data, the dynamic range is theoretically expanded and quantization distortion is proposed to reproduce smooth waveforms. It is equipped with Legato link conversion S which can reproduce the component over 20Ωkhz even in the standard mode. Based on the 1Ω/f attenuation characteristics, the waveform of the original signal is estimated and reproduced for the component of 20ΩkHz or higher. In addition, an independent harmonic generation circuit is added to reproduce the overtones, and the reproduction band is expanded by adding them together with the time axis. Equipped with DAC mode which can only use D/A converter function with Hi-bit Legato Link Conversion S. An advanced 1Ω-bit D/A converter is used for the D/A converter. It is equipped with a character pack function that can record information such as song name, performer name and source title up to 60Ωcharacters in the start ID part of each song. The recorded information is scrolled on the display at the start of each song. It is equipped with a one day timer recording function. By inputting the current time, start time and end time, it is possible to record without an external timer. It is equipped with a CD-Q code synchronized start ID recording function. When recording digital input from a CD, the start ID is automatically recorded, and even if there is no silence between songs, the start ID is recorded reliably, eliminating the recording error of the start ID. Equipped with a TOC recording / playback function, the number of recorded songs and time data of each song are recorded at the beginning of the tape, and the management, operation and operation of recorded information like CD are possible. Equipped with the last memory function, the settings of Auto ID, DAC mode and input switching are memorized when the power is turned off. Equipped with 96ΩkHz High Sampling (HS) mode, 48ΩkHz Standard (SP) mode, 32ΩkHz Long Duration (LP) mode and 44Ω.1ΩkHz Standard (SP) analog recording mode at the same frequency as CD. The head uses a high-output AT head, and the signal reading ability is improved by adopting an all-track structure, improving abrasion resistance by glass welding, and ensuring stable tape touch by special polishing processing of the gap. It is equipped with anti-vibration and anti-vibration measures such as panel stabilizer with protective rubber, honeycomb chassis, large insulator, bonnet anti-vibration structure, etc. Wireless remote control is included."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A carrier-type DAT recorder in which Pioneer's technology is condensed into an A4Ω-size compact body.

HEADS
A set of two 4Ω-head drums for recording and playback and for monitoring has been adopted in the head part from Shinkai. We have also developed a gate array LSI for signal processing timing control. The head uses a high-output AT (All Track Structure) head that can handle high sampling mode with a margin. Equipped with simultaneous recording and monitoring function. This function allows you to check the source sound and the tape sound in real time before recording with one touch switching to prevent mistakes in important recording. Equipped with 96ΩkHz high sampling (HS) mode.

HEADS
Compared doubling the tape speed, operating speed of the signal processing LSI, and bandwidth of the head amplifier, compared with the conventional 48ΩkHz sampling, recording and in the ultra-high frequency range up to 44ΩkHz, which is more faithful to the original sound, is possible. High-sampling mode recordings cannot be played back in conventional SP mode or LP mode due to the difference in the phase-mat, and the maximum recording time in HS mode is 1Ω/2Ωthat in conventional SP mode. It is equipped with Legato link conversion. Legato Link Conversion uses digital signal processing to connect the data of an audio signal with a smooth function curve so that the frequency component of the sound is closer to the original signal waveform. This makes it possible to reproduce the recorded sound closer to the original sound. This technology also reproduces the sound of 20ΩkHz or higher according to the 1Ω/f attenuation characteristic by estimating the original signal before recording, thus realizing more natural sound reproduction. A/D conversion section and D/A conversion section each use a 1Ω-bit method. Since the 1Ω-bit method does not generate non-linear distortion or 0Ωcross distortion in principle, the conversion error of small signals is reduced. Equipped with TOC recording / playback function. TOC records the number of recorded songs and the time data of each song at the beginning of the tape. With the check button, the contents can be checked with one touch. As with CDs, recorded information can be managed and manipulated, and TOC functions can be expanded. The LCD has a pop-up structure and a backlight, so that it can be used in a stationary state. In addition to the conventional modes of 96ΩkHz High Sampling (HS) mode, 48ΩkHz Standard (SP) mode and 32ΩkHz Long Duration (LP) mode, it is equipped with a 44Ω.1ΩkHz Standard (SP) mode with the same sampling frequency as CD. This makes it possible to produce sound sources such as CDs or master tapes. In addition to analog line input / output terminal (input is microphone / line switching type) and digital coaxial input / output terminal, optical digital input terminal is mounted.96ΩkHz digital output is also available. Comes with an AC adapter. This adapter is a 100ΩV, 120ΩV and 230ΩV switching type and can be used in foreign countries (Adapter plug for foreign countries is not included). Uses a dedicated � power source battery. Wide dynamic range of voltage is secured by � power supply, and continuous recording of approximately 2Ωhours in SP mode and approximately 1Ω.5Ωhours in HS mode is possible. With a built-in battery charger, you can automatically charge the built-in battery pack just by connecting the AC adapter and turning the power switch OFF. The battery can be charged in about 3Ωhours. It also has a battery refresh function. Equipped with auto (CD-Q code synchronized start) / manual ID recording function. Equipped with an A-TIME (absolute time) recording function. Equipped with functions such as Oatley number and end search, skip play, peak margin display, auto power off (when battery is used), and battery exhaustion display. Equipped with a key hold function that can fix the operation set as a safety function. Analog input with microphone / line input switching is installed. The built-in microphone input amplifier is equipped with an attenuator for excessive input, and a low-cut filter for recording vocals and conversations. Wireless remote control is included. Carrying case and belt are included."

description:
## Description

"An FM/AM tuner equipped with a band switching function in order to enjoy AM stereo with higher sound quality. The wide / Narrow Position function, which can be switched according to the reception condition, is installed in order to receive higher quality sound. When the reception condition is good, setting the Wide position to give priority to the sound quality greatly improves the frequency characteristics. In addition, when the input power is weak or when the noise radio wave is strong, the Narrow position, which gives priority to the selectivity, makes the reception easier to hear. It is equipped with 4Ω-row front end module developed in-house. Twin varicap is used for tuning element and MOS FET is used for RF amplifier to suppress intermodulation interference. In addition, it is equipped with an RF attenuator that suppresses distortion at strong input, and the IF stage is composed of three stages to suppress interference from adjacent stations. Equipped with FM/AM random 36Ωstation preset function. Use the tuning button to adjust the frequency of the broadcasting station you want to preset, press the memory button, and then set any button while the display is flashing to complete the preset. It uses a honeycomb insulator with excellent vibration absorption from the outside. In addition, we have adopted components such as acoustic condensers and resistors that were selected through repeated hearings. It is equipped with a mode memory that can store stereo / mono ON/OFF. It also has an RF attenuator that is effective for strong input, and an SR terminal that enables linkage with Pioneer systems."

description:
## Description

"FM/AM program timer tuner with built-in program timer. It has a built-in program timer that can preset programs up to 3Ωtimes a day, and high reception performance with quartz PLL system allows you to record messages and check air. The FM section uses a PLL method for stereo demodulation. It has a program timer that can reset the program of Everyday2Ωcourse and Once1Ωcourse. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"An FM/AM stereo tuner equipped with a digital direct decoder TypeII that digitally demodulates the FM signal itself at once and does not generate distortion or noise in principle. The digital direct decoder uses a pulse converter to convert the signal output from the IF section into a digital signal of 1Ω.26ΩMHz. The digital direct decoder then sends a multiplier for stereo demodulation at once and multiplies it by a 38ΩkHz subcarrier (sine wave). This is a simple method. Since FM signals are detected and demodulated as digital signals from the pulse converter to stereo demodulation, there is no need for an anti Birdie filter, which has been the cause of signal loss and distortion, and excellent characteristics are obtained by making maximum use of the characteristics of digital signals that do not generate distortion or noise. This D. D. recorder was selected as a monitor by the Swedish National Broadcasting Station due to its excellent characteristics. The F-120ΩD is equipped with a digital direct decoder TypeII, which is a further consideration of the waveform of the digital signal itself. A C-MOS IC is used in the pulse converter that converts FM signals into digital signals, improving the accuracy of the digital waveform itself, and realizing a further constant distortion rate and high SN ratio. The front end uses a linear front end to improve RF intermodulation characteristics. High reception performance is achieved by a high-performance twin varicap and a unique balance hold capacitor system. In addition to high stability achieved by the installation of a balanced mixer, various types of interference rejection capability are also greatly enhanced. In addition, in order to maintain a linear relationship between the frequencies of the antenna tuning stage and the antenna tuning stage and the local oscillator and to suppress the occurrence of distortion. In the IF section, the first stage amplifier uses a Darlington differential IC with a wide dynamic range, high gain, low noise, and high gain and high signal-to-noise ratio. In addition, we have adopted a highly reliable crystal oscillator circuit for the oscillator circuit of the frequency conversion section (1Ω.26ΩMHz), which is an important section for sending signals to the D. D. Decoder TypeII. In addition to improving stability and SN ratio, we have also reduced drift due to environmental changes such as temperature and humidity. In addition to these features, two stage switching of the IF band is also installed so that high quality can always be obtained according to the difference of reception conditions. In order to make the best use of the high sound quality of D. D. Decoder TypeII, the overall including parts is polished. After the pulse converter, there is no LC filter until the output part, and distortion and sound quality degradation caused by the LC filter are completely eliminated. In addition, we have further improved the semiconductor capacitor for the tuner used in the F-120Ω. By coating the exterior with an epoxy coating, vibration is suppressed and distortion factor is further reduced.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the power supply section has been thoroughly reviewed by installing a large power transformer similar to that of an amplifier, using a oxygen-free copper wire for power supply wiring, and using a power cord with polarity indication. In the low-pass filter section of the final stage, an active filter is used in place of a passive filter using a coil to obtain higher sound quality. The PLL circuit of the quartz synthesizer employs a unique pulse swallow method, and the reference frequency is set at 25ΩkHz. By leaving the reference frequency outside the audible band, the cause of noise caused by the reference frequency remaining in the signal line is eliminated. The digital control signal is transmitted using a full static control method. Since only one data can be put on one signal line, deterioration of the SN ratio is suppressed. A high sensitivity of 150ΩÏ‰ V/m has been achieved by adopting a large loop antenna for AM and using an FET buffer for the tuning coil. By adopting a wide range ceramic filter, etc., a substantial AM part is realized. Equipped with a Random / E Preset that allows you to select 8ΩFM/AM stations each, 8ΩFM + AM random stations and 8ΩFM + AM random stations with the switch on the rear panel. Equipped with a 3Ω-step signal indicator that can check the reception status appropriately. The side wood in the picture is sold separately. In addition to the black model, there was also a silver model."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"An FM/AM tuner developed with the aim of being a highly sensitive tuner as well as adopting various systems to improve sound quality. DDDtypeIII is a further upgrade of DDD (Digital Direct Decoder) TypeII. The main detection method has been changed from the conventional pulse counting method to the PLL (Phase Locked Loop) method. This eliminates the need for the second IF stage, simplifies the signal system, and improves S/N. It is equipped with ARTS (Active RealTime Tracing System) in order to maintain high sensitivity even in long distance reception and reception by neighboring stations. In this method, since the narrow filter follows the desired signal, the advantages of both narrow and wide filters are obtained, and the distortion factor and selectivity performance are improved. In addition, because it is feed-forward rather than feedback, circuit stability and non-spectrum are realized. In order to eliminate vibration and resonance that lead to distortion, the honeycomb chassis with excellent vibration damping characteristics has been adopted to increase the strength and to obtain good damping characteristics against external vibration such as sound pressure. In addition, the local block is highly sensitive to vibration, and even minute vibration changes into sound energy, leading to deterioration of sound quality. Therefore, the local block is filled with resin to prevent deterioration of sound quality. In addition, a large insulator that is also used in CDs and amplifiers is used to prevent vibrations from the outside, thereby suppressing unwanted vibrations from the lower surface. Equipped with two FM antenna terminals, you can switch the antenna for each station you want to listen to. It is equipped with a random preset that can preset up to 24Ωstations in total. Three levels of automatic tuning can be selected according to the field strength. If you want to receive a signal weaker than the automatic tuning level, you can use manual tuning. Equipped with a program memory function, each time the power supply is turned OFF, ON, or OFF, a broadcasting station can be called up in the order in which it was stored. Therefore, when used together with an audio timer, it is possible to record three stored broadcasts in order. Equipped with MPX mode function, 3Ωpositions of stereo / mono / high blend can be selected according to the electric field strength. It has a built-in transmission signal equivalent to 50Ω% modulation of approximately 330ΩHz, which is the standard level for FM broadcasting. By adjusting the level meter of the deck to -2ΩdB, it is possible to record the appropriate level easily."

The AM section also improves the image interference ratio and IF interference ratio by adopting a tunable RF1Ω-stage amplification using a 3Ω-row varicon. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"FM/AM tuner with PLL circuit in MPX section. The FM front-end uses a dual-gate MOS FET for the two stage RF amplifier and mixer stage. Since the dual-gate MOS FET with a low noise figure is used, the practical sensitivity is improved, and the interference rejection capability is improved by the tuning circuit using 5Ωseries variable capacitor. The local oscillator circuit of the TX 910Ωis equipped with a buffer circuit. Even when stations with high electric field strength are adjacent to each other, the buffer circuit works to prevent the lead-in phenomenon. The IF section uses a monolithic IC instead of conventional transistors. The circuit consists of three single-stage differential ICs and one 3Ω-stage differential IC, providing high stability and limiters. In addition, various characteristics have been improved by combining with wide-band ratio detection. The filter element is composed of a ceramic filter (4Ωpieces of 2Ωelements) with less phase distortion and sharp selectivity characteristics. This reduces distortion in a wide range within the pass band and improves MPX separation. A PLL circuit is introduced into the MPX section. The MPX demodulation signal obtained by the PLL circuit is a square wave whose phase always matches that of the pilot signal. Therefore, when it is passed through a double-balanced differential demodulation circuit, the leakage of the demodulation signal is canceled out and hardly appears on the output side, and the leak carrier is small even as it is, and the distortion generated during demodulation is minimized. Also, since there is no SCA beat interference, the SCA filter can be omitted, which greatly improves the high-frequency separation. A part of 19ΩkHz derived from the PLL is used to guide the signal to another phase comparator, which detects the magnitude of the pilot signal and guides the 38ΩkHz demodulated signal to the demodulation circuit only when the broadcast being received is stereo. When the signal is mono or when the stereo broadcast transmission is too weak for practical use, the circuit is automatically switched to mono and the indicator flashes simultaneously. The ICPA 1310Ωhas a built-in PLL circuit, a double-balanced differential demodulation circuit, an indicator circuit, and auxiliary circuits such as automatic switching. It is equipped with a low-pass filter that cuts the 19ΩkHz pilot signal and the 38ΩkHz carrier leak during MPX demodulation. This filter eliminates adverse effects such as beat interference and intermodulation during FM recording. The muting circuit can be switched between two operation levels. The first stage is used to cut out inter-station noise during channel selection, and the second stage is used to receive only strong stations. In order to perform accurate muting operation, MOS IC and IC developed exclusively for muting are adopted. In addition, pop noise is suppressed by double action combining lead relay. It is equipped with a pulse noise suppressor that cuts out the pulse noise caused by Radio noises from automobiles and motorcycles. It detects both AM noise, which occurs when the limiter is receiving a weak station, and FM noise, which cannot be removed by the limiter circuit, and operates in either case, so it works effectively over a wide range of electric field strength and noise types. Equipped with a signal meter whose linearity is improved by the AGC circuit, it is not saturated even in a strong electric field region. In the AM tuner section, a frequency number line type varicon is also used for the AM section to make channel selection easier. In addition, a one stage synchronous RF-amplifier using a 3Ω-row varicon is used to increase interference rejection capability. In addition, stability and reliability are improved by adopting a high-integration IC. Each amplifier stage is equipped with a sufficient AGC to keep the detection output constant and suppress the occurrence of distortion due to saturation at strong input. The mixer stage employs a balanced type mixer to improve spurious characteristics. There are two types of output terminals, fixed and variable. The output level of the variable terminal can be adjusted independently by FM and AM. We use a Darlington OTL amplifier as an amplifier for headphones. Volume can be controlled on the front panel. It is equipped with a multi-pass terminal, and the best point in the antenna direction can be easily determined by connecting a stereo display SD-100Ωor an oscilloscope."

description:
## Description

"An FM stereo tuner using a touch sensor servo lock system. The touch sensor servo lock system locks the frequency at the tuning point by turning the tuning knob and releasing the knob when the pointer reaches the desired broadcasting station. Once tuned, there is no tuning shift even if temperature or humidity changes. In addition, it has a strong pull-in capability up to � 400ΩkHz from the frequency of the desired broadcasting station, so that a stable reception condition can be maintained at all times. In addition, even if the power is turned off once, if the switch is turned on again, there is a built-in re-lock circuit that catches the same broadcasting station correctly, so there is no worry about the synchronization shift even when recording messages. It is equipped with a pilot signal auto cancel circuit originally developed by Pioneer. This circuit cancels only the pilot signal without using a 19ΩkHz-cut low-pass filter. This circuit does not reduce the high-pass band due to the filter effect, and the frequency characteristic is widened. This circuit also automatically follows and cancels any changes in the pilot signal level of the broadcasting station. The IF section uses three stages of a two element linear phase ceramic filter with greatly improved delay characteristics. By adopting this element, the conventional problem of conflicting characteristics of selectivity characteristics and distortion factor characteristics is simultaneously improved. PA-3001ΩA (IF part), PA-1001ΩA (MPX part) and PA-1002ΩA (output part) are used to further improve the performance of Pioneer's high-integration ICs. The front-end section consists of three dual-gate MOS FETs and a FM5Ωseries varicon. It has a built-in FM recording level check and sends out a 330ΩHz signal at FM50Ω% modulation level. description:
## Description

"FM stereo tuner with quartz lock and touch sensor system. The F-005Ωuses a quartz lock circuit with tuning up to the accuracy of a crystal oscillator, and the crystal oscillator changes the local frequency in precise units to ensure the desired radio wave is tuned. After tuning, the local frequency is locked and does not modulate even if there are changes in temperature or humidity, and there is no tuning shift or drift. It uses a touch sensor system. When you touch the tuning knob, the quartz lock is released and natural tuning is possible. The Tune indicator lights when you turn the tuning knob to catch the desired broadcasting station, and the Locked indicator lights when you release your hand to indicate that the frequency of the desired broadcasting station has been locked. In addition, it is equipped with a re-lock circuit so that even if the power is turned off after tuning, the radio wave of the same broadcasting station is caught when the power is turned on again. Three stages of linear phase ceramic filters with excellent delay characteristics are used in the IF section, enabling high selectivity and low distortion regeneration. PA-3001ΩA (IF part), PA-1001ΩA (MPX part) and PA-1002ΩA (output part), which are higher performance than Pioneer's high-integration ICs, are used in each circuit to greatly improve characteristics. Equipped with Pioneer's original pilot signal auto-cancel circuit. This circuit automatically follows and cancels out any changes in the transmission level of the pilot signal, so there is no need to worry about the pilot signal mixing into the reproduction. The front-end section consists of three dual-gate MOS FETs with high gain and excellent SN ratio, and a five link varicon. It is equipped with a recording level check function that is convenient for setting the recording level of the deck during air check. The 330ΩHz signal can be output from the output terminal at the same level as when FM50Ω% modulation is used. Equipped with output volume, muting switch, multi-path output terminal, etc."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A speaker system that achieves excellent characteristics by incorporating many unique new technologies into individual units and enclosures, and is completed by sufficient listening.

WOOFER
A 30Ωcm cone type unit is used for the low range. The cone paper is made of carefully selected materials and newly developed exclusively for the CS-3000ΩA. The center cap is made of the same material as the cone paper, and the strength is increased by providing unevenness on the wave. It can reproduce a strong low sound. In addition, the cone edge uses a special urethane foam material that is stable against temperature changes, so that it has excellent linearity and low distortion in the low range and low resonance of the edge are suppressed. In the cone neck part of the center cap, a new mechanism using a special foam of continuous bubbles is adopted, and non-linear distortion due to air flow in the cap is suppressed, and it also serves as a mechanical filter to prevent abnormal noise generated due to concentrated compliance of the neck part. The damper uses a double damper structure installed symmetrically, and combined with urethane foam edges to improve the linearity and reliability of the suspension. The voice coil is a short type with edgewise winding of aluminum ribbon wire. It has excellent heat dissipation and improved input resistance due to the synergistic effect of aluminum foil bobbin and thermosetting epoxy adhesive. The magnet uses a large ferrite magnet with a diameter of 200Ωmm that is manufactured by a wet process. The center pole is covered with a pure copper cap to suppress the slight distortion caused by the nonlinearity of the magnetic material. The frame is made of aluminum die-cast so there is no need to worry about resonance. A 6Ω.5Ωcm dome type unit with wire suspension system by copper-beryllium alloy wire is adopted for the middle area. This suspension is a special method in which a dome-shaped diaphragm is indicated at five points through a wire. In order to give the direction of vibration to the wire, while drawing a slight curve in the vibration direction, the wire is molded with a tapered silicon rubber that is thick on the flange side and becomes thinner as it approaches the voice coil side. The wire suspension eliminates excess sound radiation from the edge, and the clear support position greatly reduces distortion and improves transient characteristics. The dome part is designed to be relatively large (65Ωmm �) to keep the amplitude small and at the same time to reduce IM distortion. In addition, it uses a large magnet with a diameter of 156Ωmm and weight of 1Ω.2Ωkg. In addition, the voice coil is edgewise wound with aluminum ribbon wire, so it has high efficiency despite being a dome type. The center pole of the magnetic circuit is covered with a pure copper cap in the same way as the woofer to completely suppress the magnetic strain. The hole in the center of the pole is tapered. The inner surface is covered with a sound absorbing material made of felt to prevent resonance. The rear back chamber is also filled with glass wool to improve sound absorption.

TWEETER
A 2Ωcm dome type unit is adopted for the high range. A duralumin dome diaphragm with a diameter of 2Ωcm and a thickness of 30ΩÏ‰ m has been adopted for the diaphragm to obtain excellent directional characteristics. In addition, a double-structured edge made of foamed urethane has been adopted for the edge part. Since the front surface is a continuous bubble surface, there is no sound radiation from the edge and it is effective in reducing strain. Moreover, since the compliance and internal loss of the edge itself are large, it does not affect vibration. In addition, the inside of the dome is packed with micron glass, which is rich in sound absorption, and excellent transient characteristics are obtained. In addition, 10Ωfins are mounted on the front surface to protect the diaphragm and increase the effect of sound diffusion. The magnetic circuit uses a magnet (magnetic flux density 16Ω,000Ωgauss) equivalent to the 16Ωcm PAX-A16Ωspeaker, which realizes excellent transient characteristics and efficiency. In the network, the impedance rise at the fo of the mid-range and tweeter is compensated by the compensation circuit, and the characteristic of each unit is made flat, and the phase characteristic near the crossover is improved. The level control can be performed by switching the coil step-down and the compensation resistance simultaneously. The mid-range can be switched in 4Ωsteps by 2Ωdb, and the high-range can be switched in 5Ωsteps by 2Ωdb.

CABINET
The enclosure is a combination of 25Ωmm thick rigid particle board and lauan plywood. For internal reinforcement, a flat plate with four small holes is adopted instead of the conventional rod-shaped structure. It plays the role of standing wave prevention as well as front, rear, left, and right reinforcement. In addition, glass wool of up to 800Ωg is contained inside. The vibration and baffle surfaces of each unit are made completely flat, and the grill net is also devised to ensure that the reproduction characteristics are not impaired. The surface has a gorgeous finish of Brazilian rosewood."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"38Ωcm 3Ω-way compound speaker unit. The PAT-38ΩX is a 3Ω-way speaker consisting of three units with completely independent voice coil and magnetic circuit. The structure consists of a hollow center pole in the Woofer's magnetic circuit and Woofer's cone paper in the Scoker's horn, and the Scoker's magnetic circuit is attached to the rear end of the speaker.

TWEETER
The tweeter is mounted by a bridge at a position slightly offset from the central axis of the woofer.

WOOFER
For the cone paper of the woofer part, Cross Edge cone (a piece of cone paper with a separately made cloth edge attached to the edge part) is used, and special damping agent is applied to the edge part, which lowers the lowest resonance frequency and reduces distortion in the low range. Aluminum wire is used for the voice coil, and special hardened conductive paint is applied to prevent disconnection. A horn type is used for the mid-range and high-range. A polyester resin film is used for the diaphragm. The pole and yoke are designed so that the unbalance of the magnetic flux distribution is minimized after the magnetic flux distribution is precisely measured, and the driving force applied to the voice coil is always constant to reduce distortion. By adopting a damper with a circular corrugation, the stability of center holding is improved, and the generation of distortion due to the nonlinearity of the damper is reduced. The frame and yoke cap are coated with baking paint, and the top of the yoke cap is made of transparent plastic material so that you can see the midrange diaphragm and the front and back of the speaker center axis. It comes with a specially designed 3Ω-way network. In this network, L, C and attenuators are combined in a single metal case that is baked and painted gray, and the attenuation of each band is 12ΩdB/oct. name: TL-1601ΩC
description:
## Description

"A 40Ωcm cone woofer with higher rigidity while adopting the same mounting dimensions as TL-1601Ωa and TL-1601Ωb. In the TL-1601Ωc, the yoke of the magnetic circuit, the top plate, and even the frame are integrally molded with the ductile cast method to obtain high rigidity. In addition, the pole piece has a special shape to obtain the symmetry of the magnetic flux and is fixed securely with bolts. By adopting an Alnico magnet for the magnetic circuit and making it an inner magnetic type, the second harmonic distortion is suppressed and sufficient magnetism prevention performance is ensured. The vibration system is composed of pulp corn with special aging treatment, cloth edge with high age stability, and damper with high linearity, and exhibits excellent response even in the case of Oire force. In addition, the 23Ωmm long voice coil realizes low-distortion bass even at the time of Chikara Dainyu. Consideration is given to suppress parasitic resonance such as 9Ω-piece division of alnico magnet and drilling of holes in voice coil bobbin."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A ribbon tweeter that inherits the know-how accumulated in the PT-R7ΩA and can be added to an existing speaker system as a super tweeter. A built-in network with a crossover frequency of 10ΩkHz and attenuation characteristics of 12ΩdB/oct. Therefore, by simply connecting the PT-R5Ωas it is, it is possible to improve the energy characteristics above 10ΩkHz. Ultra-high-frequency playback at 120ΩkHz is achieved by using an ultra-lightweight diaphragm, a feeding system with significantly reduced inductance, and a matching transformer with low-loss design. The feeding method is a unique method developed by Pioneer, in which two copper plates on the outward and homeward paths are held in close contact with each other through thin insulation, and the ribbon and copper plates are placed as close to each other as possible in a balanced manner. This eliminates the magnetic flux generated by each conductor and greatly reduces inductance. In order to transmit the excellent vibration of the ribbon directly to the air, it is a short horn design taking advantage of the merits of the direct radiator. It also has a direct connector that passes through the built-in network."

description:
## Description

"A ribbon-type tweeter unit that realizes ultra-high frequency reproduction. Since the vibrating part itself is the driving part of the ribbon speaker, a very light vibration form can be constructed. The PT-R7ΩA uses an ultra-lightweight diaphragm with a mass of 0Ω.009Ωg. By making the mass of the diaphragm itself equal to the mass of the air that the diaphragm moves, the transient characteristics are enhanced with good efficiency without waste. As a result, flat playback is possible up to 120ΩkHz. The diaphragm has a rigid ribbon made by molding 9Ωmicron ultra-thin aluminum foil into a continuous hexagonal pyramid, and by molding it into a shape that does not become a straight line when cut vertically, horizontally, or diagonally, it has a strong structure that does not worry about bending. As a result, the piston motor cortex range of the ribbon is expanded, and excellent power linearity is secured from minute input to large input. The magnet uses Alnico 7Ωwith a magnetic flux density of 7Ω,400ΩGauss to ensure high density and uniform magnetic flux distribution, greatly improving transient characteristics, and realizing high efficiency at the same time. A low-inductance power supply system has been adopted that greatly reduces the inductance up to the ultra-high frequency range. This reduces the generation of slight inductance in the feed section and improves the high-frequency energy characteristics. The matching transformer employs a multi-layer sandwich winding of copper foil with a broadband, low-loss design, and a permalloy core with linear initial permeability characteristics. Comes with a stand base that can be set directly in the cabinet."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"Beryllium ribbon tweeter developed by improving ribbon tweeter PT-R7ΩA. The entire surface of the diaphragm is in the same phase and receives the driving force more uniformly. Since the vibrating part itself is the driving part, an extremely light vibration system can be constructed without waste, and the diaphragm is easy to move and achieves excellent linearity. Beryllium, which is the lightest and most rigid material of the diaphragm for the ribbon, has been adopted to realize high efficiency and high input resistance. In addition, the ribbon is formed into a regular hexagonal pyramid pattern by a unique manufacturing method. Since the cut surface does not form a straight line in either the vertical, horizontal, or diagonal direction, it has a strong structure that does not worry about bending. In addition, a large compliance edge is provided at the end of the rigid part of the ribbon, and it is sandwiched by silicon elastic body to realize accurate piston motion. The magnet uses Alnico 750Ω. The magnetic flux density of 7Ω,400ΩG. ensures uniform magnetic flux distribution and greatly improves transient characteristics. A low-inductance power supply system has been adopted that greatly reduces the inductance up to the ultra-high frequency range. This reduces the generation of slight inductance in the feed section and improves the energy characteristics in the high frequency range. A matching transformer with a wide-band, low-loss design using multi-layer sandwiched winding of oxygen-free copper foils is adopted. High resolution has been achieved by adopting a permalloy core with linear initial permeability characteristics. The terminal is gold-plated. In pursuit of sound quality, it uses a protective circuit with a fuse in the oxygen-free copper cap. Comes with a stand base that can be set directly on the cabinet."

name: C7Ω
description:
## Description

"In search of true stereophonic, we have applied our technology without fail to create L, which can be called the origin of stereophonic. This is a high-end stereo preamplifier with the aim of ""0Ωstereo transmission error"" which reproduces sound from R as homogeneous sound. It uses a completely independent monoconstruction structure from the power cord to the input / output terminals on the rear panel. In addition, we thoroughly analyze the magnetic field, temperature, vibration, etc. inside the set that affect the reproduction of the same left and right by making full use of the latest measuring equipment, and use newly developed parts and layout of all parts of the left and right independently symmetrical type to ensure the same transmission. In addition, various considerations are taken to achieve 0Ωstereo transmission error, such as simplification of signal path and adoption of in-set remote control system.

POWER SUPPLY
The magnetic field generated by power transformers and smoothing capacitors affects the transmission circuit, generating inductive noise and degrading sound quality. We have developed a power transformer with a low magnetic flux density, a capacitor that cancels the magnetic field, and other anti-magnetic measures for major components and uniform magnetic distribution within the set. Taking into account the effects of external and internal vibrations of the amplifier, we have developed and adopted a newly developed low-flux transformer and a capacitor (complimentary service capacitor pair) in which the positive side and the negative side cancel each other's magnetism. In addition, anti-vibration and anti-vibration measures such as floating printed circuit boards and an aluminum die-cast chassis with no resonance are implemented. In addition, in order to cope with deformation due to heat of the chassis, we have adopted a chassis with calculated stress and designed the layout of each part taking into account the effects of thermal deformation, etc., to clarify and respond to the effects of mechanical elements on sound quality. Taking into consideration that the characteristics of conductors whose resistance changes with temperature affect sound quality, we control heat radiation and provide appropriate layout of heat source parts to create a temperature environment similar to a constant temperature chamber in order to equalize sound on the left and right sides. In order to ensure the independence of the perfect monoconstruction in which the left and right are completely independent, the volume and function switch also adopt the remote control in the set, and the left and right are clearly separated. The circuit configuration is 1Ω-channel 2Ω-amplifier 2Ω-buffer amplifier configuration. In order to drive the volume and Rec output with low impedance from the input with high impedance, a buffer amplifier is installed between the input selector and the volume, and between the volume and the phase switch. In addition, two flat amplifiers use an amplifier circuit made of aluminum hybrid IC.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is independent of three transformers for left, right and control. In order to eliminate the influence on sound quality, a power transformer which operates at a low magnetic flux density is adopted from Shinkai. Noise generation is suppressed by setting it to operate at a point with good linearity. In addition, we have developed a new complimentary service capacitor pair that focuses on the magnetic field generated on the plus side and the minus side of the smoothing capacitor and cancels each other, thereby reducing the effect of the magnetic field on sound quality. In order to completely eliminate noise and ensure the purity of the signal from the source, the input circuit uses a separate ground circuit that turns on/off not only the hot side but also the ground side at the same time. This eliminates noise from other equipment coming in from the ground line. Aluminum, which has excellent thermal conductivity and shielding characteristics, is used for the substrate of the hybrid IC used in the amplification part of the flat amplifier, thereby thoroughly suppressing the influence of heat and magnetism, which cause sound quality degradation, on sound quality. The printed circuit board, which is easily affected by vibration, is floated from the holder with dump material of special vibration insulating rubber, and the effect of vibration on sound quality is eliminated. In order to obtain independence of each channel and symmetry of left and right, an in-set remote control system is adopted for switching between volume and function to ensure left and right independence. When the front panel control is operated manually, the volume and function selector switches located at the rear of the set are driven by the motor and set to the desired position. If no operation is performed, the motor-drive generator is turned off and the effect on sound quality is cut off. In order to reproduce excellent sound quality, each part is carefully examined, and 99Ω.99Ω% pure oxygen-free copper shielded wire is used for signal path wiring. In order to supply energy directly to each of the three transformers, a 6Ω-core oxygen-free copper high-quality extra-thick power cord is used. In addition to double insulation, carbon is used as the coloring pigment of the insulation material to cope with the influence of pigments on sound quality."

name: C10Ω
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo control amplifier designed with low distortion, low noise and ultra-wide bandwidth by completely eliminating magnetic materials that distort sound. The C10Ωeliminates all magnetic material from the chassis and case to the switch frame and volume cover to minimize distortion due to magnetization. Taking note of the fact that capacitors have a significant effect on sound quality, we have adopted an original capacitor that has been changed from the conventional aluminum case to a resin case. The resin case prevents distortion due to eddy currents, improves impedance characteristics, and reduces distortion. In addition, capacitor elements have been treated thoroughly by reducing ESR (equivalent series resistance) (1Ω/2Ωof conventional ones), using plain foils, improving impedance characteristics equivalent to film capacitors, reducing distortion (3Ωrd harmonic 15ΩdB), and using oxygen-free copper wires for lead wires. A unique non-magnetic switch is used for the switches. By using non-magnetic brass for the case of this switch, the generation of distortion is almost eliminated. This eliminates the intervention of magnetic material in the switch part. In addition, the switch part is directly plated with silver on brass, and the movable contact is plated with silver on the phosphor bronze, so the reproduction sound without any sense of distortion is obtained. The pin jack is gold-plated. In general gold plating, nickel plating is applied to the base in order to stabilize the plating. Therefore, due to the influence of the ferromagnetic material nickel, the strain caused by hysteresis is generated. The newly developed pin jack used in the C-10Ωis coated with a non-magnetic base plating that shows stability equal to or higher than that of nickel to prevent the generation of strain. Oxygen-free copper wire is used for wiring inside the amplifier. The power cord uses a highly reliable 15ΩA large-capacity power cord with double insulation. In addition, the core wire of this power cord is color-coded in black and white, and the connection with the AC plug is managed to unify the polarity. A 140ΩÏ‰ m thick copper foil glass epoxy board is used for the substrate. Conventional glass epoxy boards used 35ΩÏ‰ m copper foil attached to them. However, in order to reduce DCR (direct current resistance) and inductance in the board, we use 140ΩÏ‰ m copper foil, which is four times larger than conventional ones. Equipped with a unique supersonic filter. This filter is composed of an air-core coil with a cutoff at 50ΩkHz and a resistor, and has a large effect on TIM distortion countermeasures. The wooden case has an oil finish of Andes Rose natural wood. Pin cord for connection is included. This connection code uses a oxygen-free copper wire as the material and a gold-plated plug made of a non-magnetic material as the pin plug to minimize the occurrence of strain in the connection code. In addition, unlike the conventional coaxial structure, the structure of the connection code is a star quad system in which the core wires of the signal wires facing each other are twisted together to reduce the inductance. In addition, the signal wires are made of conductive polymer material and completely shielded by polarization."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"This stereo control amplifier was developed as the culmination of a review of the amplifier from its starting point. Based on the design philosophy of ""Simple is best"", the technologies developed by Pioneer are generously invested. It is a twin monoconstruction structure based on 3Ωtransformer multi-power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply for the L/R has been made independent of each transformer, and the layout on the printed circuit board has been separated into blocks to eliminate the unstable orientation caused by the deterioration of separation.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the power supply for the video circuit and electronic control system is supplied from a power transformer and constant voltage circuit separate from the power supply for the audio system. The video circuit is equipped with a new circuit (PAT. P) that automatically turns off the power of the video circuit in conjunction with the function switch when the audio source is played back. Various anti-vibration parts are used to cancel out vibration. Polycarbonate is used for the insulator, which has a large internal loss and efficiently absorbs vibrations. In addition, the circuit board is fixed with rubber vibration isolators, and the rubber vibration isolators that connect the board and chassis serve as dampers to prevent vibration from being transmitted to parts. A copper plate with high internal loss and excellent adhesion is laid at the bottom of the transformer to absorb microvibration and prevent magnetic distortion. In addition, copper plated screws are used for mounting printed circuit boards, chassis, transformers, etc. to absorb microvibration and prevent magnetic distortion. Solid aluminum with a mass of 110Ωg is used for the volume knob. Carefully selected relays and electronic switches are used to switch functions, greatly reducing the wiring from the CFC to the panel and preventing signal loss and deterioration. It employs a hybrid MC transformer system that combines an MC transformer with half the conventional winding ratio and an equalizer amplifier with a higher gain for the reduced boost ratio. Since a thicker wire can be used because of the smaller winding ratio, the DC resistance is reduced and the stray capacitance between the windings is also reduced, and the high-frequency characteristics are greatly improved. The entire chassis is plated with copper to greatly reduce magnetostriction. name: M5Ω
description:
## Description

"This monaural power amplifier has been carefully designed based on the concept of ""amplifier for getting drunk with music"". Returning to the starting point of the amplifier design of ""faithfully amplifying the input signal and reproducing it as the output signal"", we have developed and installed a new super linear circuit that can obtain characteristics without applying NFB. This eliminates TIM distortion from the root and ensures stability in the high-frequency range. It is a class A power amplifier that in principle does not generate any distortion such as switching distortion or crossover distortion. It adopts a unique power supply system of M5Ωwhich has a dedicated power supply for class A bias. By increasing the efficiency of the power supply, there is no excessive heat generation, which is considered a drawback of A class amplifier. All parts and construction are thoroughly examined, and the best parts are developed and carefully selected using the technology that we have. The power transformer is designed to achieve low leakage flux and stable regulation. First, we have adopted a polyester-coated oxygen-free copper wire for the winding, which has a cross-sectional area twice that of ordinary wire. This improves the regulation and reduces the temperature rise of the winding to 1Ω/2Ω. In addition, we have achieved a dramatic improvement in S/N by adopting the toroidal method, which is effective in reducing leakage flux. A non-conductive and non-magnetic resin is used for the transformer case, and silicon carbide powder, which is a radio wave absorber, is mixed into the filler to reduce strain, and the transformer body is floated from the chassis by rubber to reduce vibration. A newly developed film capacitor for pure audio has been adopted in order to prevent chattering and squeal in the mid - and high-frequency range caused by the structure of the film capacitor. The film material is a composite structure of polycarbonate with low tan � (dielectric loss) and polypropylene with high insulation and excellent high-frequency characteristics. This film is wound tightly at low speed and high tension to eliminate wrinkles and stress. In addition, a special winding core and heat-shrinkable resin are utilized to prevent squeal. In addition, in order to prevent the influence of external electric field, double shielding is applied by conductive resin case and conductive resin tube. It uses a 4Ω-core power cord for audio that was developed after thorough examination of the power cord. This power cord uses high-conductivity oxygen-free copper wires to reduce losses in the wires, greatly reducing non-linear distortion, and reducing the mutual interference between the two power transformers to reduce the source impedance. In addition, polyethylene with low dielectric constant is used as an insulator to reduce loss and prevent conductor vibration. In order to stably supply high power of 300ΩW to the speakers, a large output terminal is newly installed. The cable connection opening is wide (3Ω.8Ωx14Ωmm) to allow for the connection of very thick speaker cables. The cable connection method is a vise type in which the cord is crimped by two flat plates with internal knurling. The contact surface is gold-plated to improve stability and reliability. The fuse used is an audio fuse that was developed after reconsidering the material. By changing the cap material from conventional brass to pure copper, the conductor resistance is reduced to approximately 1Ω/3Ω. In addition, by changing from alloy to pure metal, the non-linearity between dissimilar metals generated inside the alloy is improved. Furthermore, nickel plating, which is a ferromagnetic material, is replaced with tin plating, which is a non-magnetic material, thereby eliminating magnetic strain. A glass epoxy substrate developed for audio equipment is used for the substrate. By using 99Ω.99Ω% pure oxygen-free copper, non-linearity is dramatically improved. By changing the conventional 35ΩÏ‰ m copper to 280ΩÏ‰ m thick copper, the conductor resistance is reduced to 1Ω/8Ω, enabling stable signal transmission. By using a glass epoxy board with excellent moisture resistance, the change in capacitance inside the copper foil is minimized and leakage inside the circuit is prevented."
