description:
## Description

"This monaural power amplifier is designed with the latest of the latest technology, and its performance has been refined to reproduce richer musical quality through repeated trial listening and attention to craftsmanship.

NETWORK
Class A operation without crossover distortion and switching distortion in principle is adopted. In addition, in order to improve drive performance at low load and to suppress generation of distortion, voltage and current amplification circuits are clearly separated. A hybrid IC using an aluminum substrate is adopted for the voltage amplification stage, and high-precision voltage amplification is performed using NFB.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplification stage is 5Ω-stage Darlington to ensure power linearity, the drive transistor is 2Ω-parallel, and the power transistor is 6Ω-parallel push-pull configuration, enabling current amplification with less distortion even though it is a non-feedback amplifier. In addition, the voltage amplifier stage and power amplifier stage are separated from each other in terms of layout to eliminate mutual interference.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In order to prevent adverse effects on sound quality due to counter-electromotive force generated by external pressure applied to the cone paper of the speaker and high-frequency noise such as radio waves and fluorescent lights induced in the speaker cableThe voltage amplification stage and the power amplification stage are completely separated, and a circuit configuration without feedback loop from output to input is adopted. Focusing on the fact that the output signal is obtained by modulating and synthesizing the two power supplies (plus and minus) with the input signal, we have adopted symmetrical construction that equalizes the internal environment and mechanical strength of the chassis, such as the temperature of the plus and minus power supply and the temperature and magnetism of the amplification stage. This reduces distortion not only from the circuit, but also from temperature distribution inside the chassis, magnetic effects, and chassis mechanical strength problems. In addition to the input terminal of the RCA pin jack, a balanced input terminal of the canon-type input jack is mounted on the input terminal.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a large-capacity toroidal transformer that provides low linkage flux and stable regulation. The use of an extremely thick winding improves regulation and reduces temperature rise, contributing to stable temperature balance. In addition, the two transformers are dedicated to the positive and negative power supply respectively, reducing the source impedance, and in combination with the adoption of the double-bridge rectification system, the speaker can be driven more accurately.

POWER AMPLIFIER
It employs a protective circuit that eliminates the relay from the output stage, reducing the effect of the protective circuit on sound quality and minimizing the contact points of the signal path. In order to prevent the deformation of the chassis due to external vibration and internal heat from affecting the sound quality, it uses a strong structure that is hard to be deformed. In addition, thick aluminum material is used lavishly to ensure the strength and eliminate the influence of magnetism that causes distortion. In addition, in order to suppress vibration, we have adopted a floating mount for the power transformer, and have taken thorough measures to prevent vibration and vibration. In order to ensure the realization of the design concept of symmetrical construction, a large heat sink with high heat radiation efficiency is laid out in an appropriate position, and the temperature environment on the positive and negative sides is made uniform. To prevent interference between circuits from affecting sound quality, each circuit section is separated by a shield to eliminate mutual interference. In order to provide a stable power supply to the dedicated positive and negative transformers, a 6Ω-conductor thick oxygen-free copper audio cord with high conductivity is used. It is designed with an emphasis on sound quality such as double insulation, adoption of carefully selected coating material, polarity indication on plug, etc. The speaker terminal is a large vise crimping type speaker terminal that allows for easy connection of very thick speaker cables. In addition, the connection is gold-plated. Starting with parts such as transformers, transistors, ICs, and chassis materials, all parts are carefully selected and selected. In addition, experienced testers listen to each carefully hand-made product, and even the sound quality that does not appear on the instrument is strictly checked. Only products that pass the check are shipped."

description:
## Description

"Non-feedback monaural power amplifier without NFB loop from signal system by super linear circuit. A super linear circuit is used for the voltage amplifier. By canceling the non-linearity of the transistor with the non-linearity of the reverse mode, linear amplification is realized without using NFB, and the problem caused by NFB is solved. An EBT (collective power transistor) with high-speed response is adopted for the output stage. In order to obtain linearity, the current load per 1Ωstone is reduced, and 6Ωunits are used in parallel for pure class A amplification, which improves high-frequency reproduction, which tends to be a problem. In order to achieve DC-stability at the output point, we have adopted double-lock ???? regulators to further improve the reliability of super linear circuits by suppressing fluctuations in mid-point voltage. In addition, the coupling condenser, which causes coloring of sound, is removed and all stages are directly connected.

POWER SUPPLY
Two power transformers are used in the power supply section to reduce the source impedance by equivalent parallel connection, and to further strengthen the power supply drive to the output stage. In order to eliminate the cause of sound quality degradation, we have adopted a glass case electrolytic capacitor in which the case has been changed from aluminum to glass. The inner surface of the glass case is coated with carbon, and the electrode foil has been improved to improve the sound quality. In addition, for the small-capacity capacitor, we have adopted a copper foil styrene capacitor using high-purity oxygen-free copper for the electrodes to improve sound quality. In place of the iron cap for the carbon resistance, a brass cap carbon resistance with brass cap carbon for the drawer part is adopted to suppress the generation of strain. Non-magnetic aluminum material is used for all parts such as chassis and frame, and in addition, special resin coating is applied to the inside to make the shielding effect uniform. These non-magnetic structures greatly reduce biotechnological problems and degradation of characteristics caused by magnetic structures. The printed circuit board is made of glass epoxy, which has high mechanical strength and excellent high-frequency characteristics. In addition, the copper foil has a thickness of 140Ω?, about four times that of the conventional copper foil, reducing DC resistance and inductance. In addition, oxygen-free copper is used for the wiring material of the signal system, and oxygen-free copper is also used for other signal flow areas and connecting fittings. A protection circuit is used to detect overload, midpoint voltage, and abnormal power supply voltage. If the midpoint voltage changes abnormally due to an accident such as a short-circuit of the speaker terminal, the speaker and the power amplifier will be disconnected immediately. It operates as a muting circuit when the power switch is turned on/off. The power indicator on the entire panel uses a microcomputer 20Ω-point LED display indicator. A logarithmic compression circuit is used to indicate the peak value from 0Ω.001ΩW to 100ΩW maximum without range switching. It also has a peak hold function and can read peak values. The power cord uses a double-insulated high-capacity power cord. In addition, since the polarity is unified from the core wire of the power cord to the internal circuit of C-Z1Ωand M-Z1Ω, it is possible to match the polarity with the AC line. The pin plug cord uses a star quad structure made of oxygen-free copper, which reduces cord self-inductance and provides low-loss, high-frequency flat transmission characteristics."

The push-pull circuit of class A operation does not generate notching distortion or transient crossover distortion due to the base accumulation effect of the transistor, and the distortion when NFB is not applied is essentially small. Therefore, there is no sound even at a small output, and it is possible to convey the nuance of the source faithfully. In addition, since the power supply voltage does not fluctuate regardless of the power level, the low-frequency stability and low-frequency transient characteristics are excellent. Since a large current flows even when there is no signal, the temperature of the radiator is kept constant and excellent thermal stability is obtained. Equipped with a peak power meter at the front. POWER SUPPLY

In addition to conventional fast response and reliable protection circuits, this heat-sensitive protection circuit also addresses safety in the event of a fan outage. description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier that achieves high-quality sound in a class-A amplifier circuit. The input stage of the differential amplifier drives the push-pull pre-driver stage and drives the final stage of 8Ωpower transistors (4Ωparallel connection) per channel. A class A push-pull circuit is excellent because it has no notching or crossover distortion. Therefore, there is little distortion when NFB is not applied. Moreover, it has excellent stability and transient characteristics especially in the low frequency range because the power supply does not vary depending on the power. We have developed and used special specifications for each sound quality part, such as condensers such as Mylar, STICON and electrolytic capacitor, and non-inductive wound non-magnetic resistor. While conventional glass epoxy boards were used by attaching 35ΩÏ‰ m copper foil, we have adopted 140ΩÏ‰ m copper foil, which is four times larger than conventional ones, in order to reduce DCR (direct current resistance) and inductance in the board. In order to ensure stable performance and reliability, all input / output terminals and assembly terminals are gold-plated to greatly improve the conduction characteristics. In the past, nickel plating was applied to the base layer in order to stabilize the plating. However, since nickel is ferromagnetic, distortion caused by hysteresis occurred. The newly developed pin jack used in the M4Ωa has been plated on a non-magnetic substrate with stability equal to or better than that of nickel, preventing distortion and obtaining stable contact performance. The connection code structure is different from the conventional coaxial structure in that it uses a star quad system in which opposing core wires of the signal wire are twisted together to reduce inductance. In addition, the signal wire is completely shielded by a conductive polymer material and braiding. As a result, it is possible to transmit high-quality signals with low distortion and low loss. To cope with the heat generated by a class A amplifier, the chassis is configured to form a cooling duct. Two fans installed in the lower part of the cabinet are used for forced-air cooling. In addition, the fan is operated at low voltage and low speed to suppress the rotational noise. In addition to the conventional output point DC potential detection circuit which combines a relay and an electronic circuit, a thermal detector using a positive star and a protective circuit using a thyristor are added."

"A dual-drive amplifier developed in anticipation of the DVD audio age as a culmination of the direct energy MOS FET developed by Pioneer. Equipped with a 4Ω-channel power amplifier, 3Ω-mode speaker drive system can be selected. Equipped with Direct Energy MOS FET developed by Pioneer. Direct Energy MOS FETs have excellent power linearity and low-load drive capability with extremely low energy loss. By increasing the capacity of these power elements and using only selected high-quality products for all channels, operating errors between channels are completely eliminated. In addition, by using a ceramic sheet with extremely low thermal resistance as an insulating material between the large heat sink and the MOS FET, the temperature rise in response to the connection signal input and the instantaneous temperature rise in response to the pulse input are minimized, and the response speed and sound transparency at the time of a large volume input are improved. In addition, a newly developed Z-bias circuit that controls the temperature coefficient of the MOS FET for temperature compensation of the idle current is incorporated, and the drift of the idle current is greatly reduced, and stable sound quality is realized immediately after power is turned on. By further brush-up the wide-range linear circuit which can obtain the necessary gain by the current feedback type one stage amplifier circuit, the complete discrete configuration without using DC-servo or operational amplifier is realized. By keeping the NFB constant from the ultra-low range, clear low-range reproduction is possible. The volume is equipped with a Digital Accurate Control Attenuator that uses ultra-precision resistance elements in the D/A converter to control the volume with high precision. Two input switches and DAC attenuator function allow direct input from a CD player or other device. The DAC attenuator has features such as no linkage error between the left and right channels, no deterioration of SN ratio or separation due to the attenuator position, and no influence of vibration. You can also use the attenuator through function when connected to a preamp.

In addition, by simplifying and shortening the signal path and isolating each block with a shield case, we thoroughly analyze the potential difference inside the chassis, magnetic field inside the set, temperature, vibration, etc., and homogenize the environment. Newly developed thick-walled aluminum extruding material independent on left and right is used for the heat sink. Three brass stays made of solid brass are combined in a hybrid construction to hold heavy objects such as power transformers, electric field capacitors, and heat sinks, thereby increasing component rigidity. In order to protect the input and output terminals from the sound pressure of the speakers, a copper-plated 2Ωmm thick steel plate is used as the rear stabilizer, and solid brass is used as the insulator to control vibration. The chassis, rear panel, shield case, etc. use high conductivity chassis made of copper plated steel plate to suppress high-frequency noise. In addition, each part is carefully selected, and the sound quality is examined by the set mounting.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with a large 355ΩVA super-ring toroidal transformer to improve low-load drive capability. We have also cleared the power source harmonics regulation, which has been considered difficult for large-capacity toroidal transformers."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A flagship AV amplifier that supports THX Surround EX. Compatible with THX Ultra, it can be used anywhere from space-saving to full-fledged home theater (3000Ωft). It is equipped with the THX Surround EX decoder which brings the sound effects of Surround EX, an audio format for theaters, to the living room. This system is a 7Ω.1Ωch surround system with two surround back channels added to the conventional 5Ω.1Ωch surround system, further improving sound continuity and enveloping impact. With the VSA-D10ΩEX, you can connect surround back speakers by adding an external power amplifier. Surround SURROUND EX-compatible sources allow you to enjoy THX Surround EX 7Ω.1Ωch sound, while Dolby Digital 5Ω.1Ωch sources can be played back as 7Ω.1Ωch by THX Surround EX decoding. It is also compatible with DTS-ES. The decoder uses Cirrus Logic's CS 493292Ω- CLEP. This DSP chip is compatible with MPEG-2ΩAAC of BS digital broadcasting, so you can enjoy 5Ω.1Ωch BS digital broadcast movies as they are, or enjoy multi-channel broadcast contents as they are. Equipped with advanced theater mode. This function is a sound field mode unique to Pioneer. You can choose the sound field that best suits the style of the living room and the sound taste of the user while retaining the essence of surround formats such as DTS and Dolby Digital. In 7Ω-D theater mode, 2Ω-channel sources such as Dolby surround sound can be played in 7Ω.1Ωchannel multi-speaker surround sound. Equipped with Midnight listening mode, it can improve the sense of presence that tends to be lacking when enjoying movies or music at low volume such as at night. This mode adjusts the frequency response, balance, dynamic range, and other characteristics of the human auditory sense according to volume changes. Equipped with DSP mode, 7Ωsurround modes can be selected. You can also adjust the effect levels in nine levels for Hall1Ω, Hall2Ω, Jazz, Dance, Theater1Ω, and THeater2Ω. Direct Energy MOS-FET is used for each power amplifier for 5Ωchannels. This element has features such as low power loss due to heat generation, high efficiency signal amplification and excellent power linearity, contributing to accurate speaker drive. By selectively using this direct energy MOS-FET, the operating conditions of all channels are matched to minimize differences in sound quality and tone quality between channels. The heat sink is made of aluminum and has a large wall thickness to suppress resonance, so as to provide sufficient heat protection and high sound quality. In addition, thorough noise control measures are taken, such as a copper shield cover with a diode and a power transformer. The input / output terminals are equipped with D4Ωimage terminal for progressive image, component image terminal and S2Ωimage terminal. In the audio system, in addition to the multi-channel (7Ω.1Ωch) direct input terminal for DVD audio and newly developed large gold-plated speaker terminal for banana plug, the digital input / output terminal is also equipped in abundance. Direct construction is used for internal construction. This system is based on the idea that the signal path should be as simple as possible. It separates different circuits (digital and analog, video and audio), and arranges parts optimally to minimize the signal transmission path, thereby completely eliminating signal interference between circuits.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the copper foil on the circuit board of the power supply unit is 70Ωmicrons, double the normal size, reducing the impedance of the circuit and achieving smoother signal flow. The chassis structure uses a double layered chassis. In this system, the chassis is double-jointed by welding to increase the rigidity of the chassis and reduce distortion. In addition, the chassis and rear panel are copper-plated to reduce impedance and contribute to stabilization of high-frequency potential. Equipped with multi-channel digital noise reduction. Compensates for noise in audio signals from cassette tapes, VTRs, FM/AM tuners, and other devices, making the sound less noisy and easier to listen to. Equipped with an RF demodulator. Each circuit is equipped with a separate and independent local regulator.

POWER SUPPLY
It uses parts such as high-voltage film capacitors for high sound quality, high-ripple electrolytic capacitors, low-noise bridge rectifier diodes, 70Ω-micron copper foil printed circuit board for power supply, and low-resonance large aluminum extruded heat sinks. Gold plated input / output pin jacks and banana plug-compatible screw-type gold plated speaker terminals are used. The display section is equipped with a 4Ω-stage FL dimmer display. It comes with a 4Ω.5Ωinch large liquid crystal touch panel remote controller with back light. This remote control operates according to the GUI displayed on the LCD. It is equipped with a macro function that turns on the power of DVD, TV and VCR continuously just by turning on the system power, a flexible macro that allows up to five commands to be added freely, a system-off macro that turns off all systems with one button, and a lock function that prevents inadvertent operation of the train."

description:
## Description

"AM/FM multi integrated stereo amplifier equipped with automatic switching mechanism of FM mono and stereo. A meter-type tuning instruction by a tuning meter is adopted in the tuner section instead of the conventional magic eye to suppress tuning deviation at the time of tuning. The FM tuner uses a 6ΩAQ8Ωcathode injection self-excited front-end to achieve stable high-frequency amplification.

IF STAGE
In addition, 3Ωstages of intermediate frequency amplification including 1Ωstage of limiter are adopted, and the signal with suppressed noise is sent to the latter stage. A wide-band ratio detection method suitable for stereo reception is adopted. The tuner section is equipped with a newly designed stereo / mono automatic switching mechanism. You can automatically receive FM stereo by setting the selector knob to FM-Auto. The neon tube stereo indicator lights up during stereo reception. Switching system is adopted for the multi-circuit. An SCA filter is added to this multi-circuit. Equipped with FM-AFC (Automatic Frequency Adjustment) circuit. Equipped with a tuning indicator.

POWER AMPLIFIER
A push-pull circuit using 6ΩBM8Ωis adopted for the output stage of the amplifier section. The power supply employs a voltage doubler rectification system using a silicon diode. Equipped with tone control and loudness control. A newly designed lever switch has been adopted for the front panel switches to ensure reliable operation with a light touch.

HEADS
It is equipped with a wide range of input / output terminals such as MAG terminal with RIAA curve equalizer, input terminal for ceramic, aux, tape and line out, output terminal for Tape Rec, headphone, and DIN tape recorder / reconnector jack. Ease of use is improved by integrating the input switching of the tape source into the selector switch."

The power amplifier section employs a single-stage differential amplified pure complimentary service OCL circuit using dual transistors with uniform characteristics in � 2Ωpower supply system.

description:
## Description

"A non-feedback MC head amplifier with an ideal transparent amplifier and a super linear circuit for MC in the circuit. It uses a super linear circuit for MC consisting of a nonlinear absorption circuit and a voltage amplifier. The H-Z1Ωemploys a low-noise FET in order to greatly improve the SN ratio. By driving the current push-pull, the second power characteristic (non-linearity) of the FET is canceled, and excellent linearity without distortion is obtained. A silicon carbide shielded power transformer is used for the power transformer. In this transformer, high-purity oxygen-free copper wire is used for the winding, and by using a balanced winding, the voltage value after commutation is made uniform and stable regulation is obtained. In addition, by using a toroidal core, leakage flux is reduced. This prevents the transformer from affecting other parts and eliminates sound quality degradation caused by induction hum. In addition, porous silicon carbide ceramic is used for the transformer case to prevent distortion due to electromagnetic induction from the outside. Aluminum electrolytic capacitor Non-inductive electrolytic capacitor is adopted. Unlike ordinary electrolytic capacitors, this capacitor employs a method in which all the electrode foils of the capacitor are made into electrodes by special welding, thereby realizing a significant reduction in inductance. A resin case coated with a special conductive material is used inside the case to shield the elements from external magnetic fields.

POWER SUPPLY
We have adopted newly developed film capacitors for audio equipment as small-capacity capacitors. The film is made of a composite structure consisting of polycarbonate with low tan � (dielectric loss) and polypropylene with high insulation and excellent high-frequency characteristics. This is rolled up hard at low speed and high tension to eliminate wrinkles and mechanical stress that often occur in the past and to prevent intermodulation distortion caused by squeal. In addition, the device is double-shielded with a conductive film coating and a special case to prevent the effects of external electrolysis. Uses a glass case electrolytic capacitor in which the case is replaced with glass to prevent the generation of eddy current. When signal current flows, electromagnetic waves are generated and leaked from electronic components, and interactions between channels and electromagnetic waves are reflected by metal objects, causing distortion of the signal current itself and causing deterioration of sound quality. To prevent this, a special electromagnetic wave absorber is used in the H-Z1Ω. This is a multi-layer carbon-containing urethane foam sheet that prevents the induction of electromagnetic waves inside and outside the amplifier. In addition, the top plate is made of glass coated with highly reliable silicon carbide as an electromagnetic wave shield. This improves the audibility that does not appear in the specifications. The printed circuit board uses glass epoxy, which has excellent mechanical strength and electrical high-frequency characteristics. The copper foil is made of 99Ω.99Ω% pure oxygen-free copper with a thickness of 280ΩÏ‰ m, about eight times that of conventional copper foil. This reduces DC resistance to 1Ω/8Ωof conventional copper foil and greatly reduces inductance. The fuse is an audio fuse that uses pure copper for the base material instead of conventional brass. This not only improves the conductor resistance by nearly 30Ω%, but also prevents the occurrence of non-linear distortion between different metals inside the alloy by switching from alloy to pure metal. In addition, tin, a non-magnetic material, is used instead of nickel, a magnetic material, for the plating material of the electrode. We are also working to improve the quality of the power cord. We have adopted oxygen-free copper as the conductive material, and by improving the conductivity, loss in the wire is reduced and non-linear distortion is greatly reduced. The insulation covering the conductor is made of polyethylene with low conductivity for low loss, low loss, low capacity and low distortion. In addition, the double insulation structure covered with polyvinyl chloride of 1Ω.6Ωmm thickness prevents conductor vibration such as cord noise generated when current flows. In addition, the polarity of the plug is indicated, and the polarity is controlled from the core wire of the power cord to the wiring inside the body to improve the sound quality. We have developed and adopted a fast recovery diode with high high-speed response for the rectifier diode. This reduces power supply noise. In order to solve the problem of non-linearity between dissimilar metals, copper-containing solder is used. In addition, oxygen-free copper wire with 99Ω.99Ω% purity is used from the inlet to the outlet. Equipped with a gain switching function that can be switched in two stages and a 4Ω-position cartridge load."

It is equipped with a Y/C separation circuit that separates luminance and color signals from the composite signal of devices that do not have S-video output. It is also equipped with a Y/C separate memory function that can store the on/off status of the Y/C separation circuit according to the connected device for each input selector. In addition to input switching and power on/off, it comes with a system remote controller that enables control amplifier C7Ωvolume, function switch switching and power on/off. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"In order to faithfully pick up the limits of high-fidelity reproduction by delving into basic issues such as low mass, broadband, high trackability, high rigidity, and no resonance in order to faithfully pick up the music signal inscribed on the disc. The left and right channels of the magnetic circuit are independent, and each channel is composed of 3Ωpoles and 2Ωmagnets. The magnets are opposed to each other in the same polarity across the center yoke so that the magnetic flux is concentrated in the center yoke. By this, a larger magnetic flux is generated with a small magnet, and efficient power generation is achieved. The magnet uses samarium-cobalt, which has a large energy product, and is designed to obtain high magnetic flux density in spite of the wide gap. As a result, high magnetic flux density of 10Ω,000ΩGauss maximum can be obtained, and linear and efficient power generation is possible from large amplitude of low sound range to small amplitude of high sound range. The total weight of the magnetic circuit for both channels is only 0Ω.9Ωg, which is about 1Ω/4Ωof that of a conventional MC cartridge, making it possible to make a low-mass cartridge. Micro coils are arranged to correspond to magnets independently on the left and right. The coils have a coreless and bobbinless structure with 99Ω.99Ω% pure oxygen-free copper wires wound in multiple layers. The impedance characteristics are almost constant up to around 100ΩkHz, and the sound quality is not affected by changes in the impedance characteristics, so a flat playback sound can be obtained. Both the magnet and the coil are structurally separated into the left and right channels, respectively, so that interference between the left and right signals is suppressed and excellent channel separation is obtained. Beryllium is used as a material for the cantilever, and the tapered pipe cantilever is completed by the vacuum deposition method utilizing Pioneer's proprietary precision processing technology. This is different from the one in which thin plates are rounded and joined together. It is directly molded in the shape of a pipe, so that rigidity is increased and effective mass is reduced, mechanical impedance is extremely low, and reliable tracing is possible. The PC-70ΩMC uses a one point support system with a clear vibration support point. The rear end of the cantilever is supported by a suspension wire, a damper is provided to clarify the vibration support point, and a damper is provided to clarify the vibration support point. The vibration in the front-back direction that occurs during tracing is reliably suppressed and stable braking is provided. In addition, taking advantage of the low mass design, the viscous damping of the damper material is set to a minimum to further improve the traceability. In designing the frame, we have developed a method for measuring dynamic mass using data obtained by directly exciting the cartridge body using computer analysis technology, and based on the know-how obtained through this method, we have implemented a non-resonance design. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A direct-drive phono motor developed by applying the Hall element developed by Pioneer. By adopting a direct drive system in which the rotation of the motor itself is the same as the number of revolutions of the record, there is no reduction mechanism that causes uneven rotation, and the generation of vibration that increases in proportion to the number of revolutions is reduced. In addition, we have adopted a DC drive Hall motor that applies a Hall element to detect the magnetic field of the switching mechanism. Compared with a mechanical switching mechanism motor using a brush, vibration is less and S/N and durability are improved. The Hall element is a magnetic-to-electric conversion element with a structure in which a potential difference is generated at the output terminal when a current is passed through the input terminal and a perpendicular magnetic field is applied to the input terminal. This is called the Hall effect. An alloy of N-type InSb is evaporated on a cross-shaped substrate, and four input / output lines are provided there. This is a type of semiconductor molded with synthetic resin material. Pioneer has developed a vacuum deposition method and succeeded in rationalizing the production process and increasing the thickness of the ultra-thin film from 30Ω-50ΩÏ‰ m to 0Ω.8ΩÏ‰ m. Moreover, uniform quality improves the performance of Hall elements. In the MU-3000Ω, three Hall elements are placed at the bottom of the stator core for sequential switching. The MU of the MU 3000Ωconsists of a rotor magnet magnetized to 20Ωpoles and a 3Ω-phase wave-wound stator with two pairs of 60Ω-slot windings. Three Hall elements are arranged on a part of the stator side. The Hall elements generate signals to activate the transistor circuit by magnetic field lines in sequence with the rotation of the magnet rotor magnetized with 20Ωpoles. The transistor circuit changes the current supply to each winding in sequence according to the signals to generate rotational driving force.

MOTOR
A DC servo mechanism has been adopted in order to obtain more precise accuracy of constant speed. This servomechanism uses the back electromotive force generated in the coil by the rotation of the magnet rotor to control the rotation. Since the back electromotive force increases and decreases in proportion to the rotation, this change is detected and the electronic circuit accurately controls the drive current.33Ω1Ω/3Ω, 45Ωrpm speed switching uses a purely electronic circuit. In addition, there is a speed fine adjustment knob that can be adjusted independently for each rotational speed, and it can be freely controlled within � 2Ω%. Since it uses a DC motor, it can be used regardless of the power frequency of 50ΩHz/60ΩHz."

name: P3ΩA
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo player system based on Exclusive P3Ωthat aims for higher quality playback by changing the arm and details.

MOTOR
For the phono motor and bearing structure, we have adopted a quartz PLL control system for the linear torque type DD motor with slotless and coreless structure. In addition, we have adopted the SHR (Stable Hanging Rotor) bearing structure with the center of gravity of the rotating shaft set low. As a result, we have achieved rotational performance with rotational unevenness of 0Ω.003Ω% or less and rotational speed accuracy of 0Ω.001Ω%, which is impossible with conventional measurement methods. In the SHR system, the bearing structure is designed to be the reverse structure of the conventional system. First, the supporting point is moved closer to the center of gravity and the conventional bearing section is changed to the rotating side, so that inertia is generated in the bearing section during rotation and lateral pressure is not applied to the shaft. To prevent rattling, the clearance of the bearing is kept to a minimum, and sufficient torque and turntable inertia are set for the load of the cartridge applied to the outer circumference of the turntable.

MOTOR
The high torque motor with dual rotor structure using anisotropic ferrite magnet with strong magnetic force realizes high torque (10Ωkg-cm) similar to record cutting equipment. In addition, an inertial mass of 700Ωkg-cm. In combination with the turntable and servo circuit with excellent transient characteristics, excellent starting characteristics (constant speed rotation in 0Ω.3Ωseconds after the switch is turned on) and load resistance characteristics (equivalent to needle pressure of 1Ω.5Ωkg) are realized, and stable and high precision rotational characteristics are obtained.

TONE ARM
The tone arm is equipped with a mass concentration system that concentrates the mass on the rotating shaft and an oil dump adjustment mechanism, in addition to the light equivalent mass of the tone arm. By applying a highly reliable silicone oil brake on the arm shaft, the volume in the low range and the reduction of cross modulation distortion are realized. In addition, the amount of oil dump brake can be controlled according to the characteristics of the cartridge, and the dump can be turned off. The tone arm is made of DRA & alumina ceramics in pursuit of no resonance. It is equipped with a new mechanism, Dynamic Resonance Absorber (DRA), which was developed based on computer analysis technology such as FFT analyzer to understand the vibration characteristics of the tone arm that degrade sound quality. The DRA is equipped with a sub-resonance body composed of a damper with moderate spring properties and a weight, and absorbs vibrations that are opposite to the resonance of the arm. This vibration neutralization function prevents the needle tip from picking up excess components other than the sound groove, and more accurate reproduced sound is obtained. Alumina ceramic is used for the arm material. This material has approximately 3Ωtimes the specific rigidity compared to conventional aluminum and reduces resonance. Equipped with a quick stop mechanism that combines an electronic brake that uses an electronic circuit to apply the force of a motor and reverse rotation, and a mechanical brake that uses a plunger to stop the rotation of the rotor. The motor and tone arm are fixed to a 12Ωkg weight base made of laminated aluminum and barium sulfate of high density material. In addition, the base is completely floated from the cabinet to prevent sound pressure from the speakers and vibration from the floor. adopting a coaxial suspension system. In order to enable a high howling margin, a triple structure insulator has been adopted. The 25Ωkg body is supported by an oil dump type piston structure using a 62Ωmm spring, and special rubber is used to absorb surging of the spring. In addition, since the natural frequency of the insulator is set to 5ΩHz or less, which is lower than the natural frequency of the tone arm, a high howling margin is obtained by combining with the vibration isolation structure of the coaxial suspension.

CABINET

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"In pursuit of sound quality, this record player system takes advantage of the excellent unit design just like high-end machines. The tone arm uses a shell-integrated carbon graphite straight arm. Through vibration analysis using a computer, the shape and balance with the least resonance can be determined theoretically, and through repeated measurement and listening, a tone arm that enables more faithful transmission has been realized. In order to suppress low-frequency resonance caused by warping or eccentricity of the record, a silicon oil braking system (on-off capable) is adopted. By pressing the damping knob on the upper part of the arm shaft, the silicon braking fin injected into the oil cup sinks and applies viscous braking to the arm. In addition, by cutting the tip of the braking fin (ring shape) at 45Ωdegrees, it is designed to apply braking suitable for both horizontal and vertical directions simultaneously. This suppresses harmful low-frequency resonance and reduces intermodulation distortion. It uses silicon oil, which is excellent as a braking oil and has little viscosity change with time or temperature. In addition, this silicon oil is stored in an oil cup made with high precision to prevent oil from oozing out and improve reliability.

TONE ARM
A heavy weight arm base made of die cast with a stabilizer effect is used for the arm base. The drive section is equipped with an SH-rotor type coreless motor. We have succeeded in greatly reducing the wow flutter by moving the rotor bearing, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, just below the turntable, and by adopting a coreless structure that does not cause cogging in principle. Starting torque is 1Ω.3Ωkg-cm and further 330Ωkg-cm.

TURNTABLE
By combining a turntable with an inertial mass (including a turntable seat), stability without load fluctuation is realized even with a load of 200Ωg corresponding to 100Ωtone arms with a needle pressure of 2Ω.0Ωg. In addition, three highly reliable Hall elements developed by Pioneer are used in the magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor. In addition, fine noise is eliminated by requiring micron-order machining order of microns down to fine parts. Adopts a silent lift-up mechanism that achieves quiet and accurate operation. First of all, the arm is moved up and down using a moving coil system that applies the operation principle of a speaker and operates without contact with DC voltage. In addition, to detect the end position of the recording sound groove, a method of non-contact detection using a Hall element mounted inside the arm shaft and a magnet mounted opposite the Hall element is adopted, which realizes stable operation without impairing the performance of the arm. Equipped with a pure electronic quick stop mechanism that operates in conjunction with a silent lift-up mechanism and stops the turntable instantly. We have adopted a high-density cabinet that effectively controls the shaking of the cabinet due to the anti-energy effect of the rotational moment of the turntable with high inertia and high torque. In addition, by adopting a large insulator with a unique low center of gravity structure, the structure is resistant to external vibration. By using a damping adjustment adapter (sold separately), it is possible to adjust the oil braking at a level of 0Ωto 5Ωas in the case of the advanced model PL-70ΩLII and PL-50ΩLII. Includes an S-shaped replacement arm pipe (with large weight) for easy replacement of the head shell. Also, carbon graphite shell integrated straight arm pipe is sold separately."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A record player whose sound quality has been improved by reflecting the sound quality improvement technology obtained with a high-grade machine. The tone arm employs a double-structure head-shell integrated straight arm composed of carbon graphite and high-rigidity aluminum base, which are lightweight, highly rigid and have excellent damping characteristics. While examining the material itself, the complex split-resonance phenomenon is eliminated by computer vibration analysis. The strength of the head shell part and the connector part at the root is also sufficiently high to eliminate the adverse effect of resonance. To eliminate low-frequency resonance and achieve high sensitivity at the same time, a variable level silicon oil braking system is adopted. This is designed to apply damping by sinking a damping fin (ring shape) into the silicon oil injected into the oil cup at the upper part of the arm shaft. By appropriately matching the equivalent mass of various cartridges and the arm, the applicable range of the arm is expanded. In addition, by cutting the tip of the fin at 45Ωdegrees, the structure reduces the Q (resonance sharpness) of low-frequency resonance by applying appropriate braking simultaneously in both horizontal and vertical directions. In addition, cross-modulation distortion is greatly improved by the synergistic effect of mass concentration concentration system that brings the main weight of the arm closer to the rotating shaft. The arm base uses a heavy weight die cast arm base with a stabilizing effect. By fixing the arm firmly and suppressing partial resonance, it realizes low-frequency reproduction with higher resolution. In order to improve rotational accuracy, we have adopted a coreless structure that does not cause cogging in principle. In addition, we have achieved excellent rotational characteristics by adopting the SH rotor system in which the rotor fulcrum (bearing) located at the bottom of the motor is moved just below the turntable. The SH rotor system fundamentally eliminates the reverse conical motion of the motor shaft caused by the slight clearance between the motor shaft and the bearing, which could not be prevented by the conventional structure.

MOTOR
A coreless quartz PLL DC servo hole motor with a starting torque of 1Ω.6Ωkg-cm is used to eliminate the load fluctuation caused by the resistance which the needle tip receives from the recording sound groove, and a 330Ωkg-cm ring motor is used to eliminate the load fluctuation.2ΩBy adopting a 31Ωcm diameter turntable with an inertial mass of 1Ωg, the stability that does not cause rotational speed fluctuation even under the load of 200Ωg needle pressure is realized. In addition, three Hall elements developed by Pioneer are used in the magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor, and fine noise is eliminated by seeking processing accuracy in the order of microns even to other fine parts. Equipped with a silent lift-up mechanism that does not produce mechanical sounds. This is a moving coil system that applies the operation principle of a speaker to the elevation mechanism that moves the arm up and down. It is designed to operate without contact with DC voltage. In addition, the end position of the sound groove of the record is detected by non-contact detection using the Hall element inside the arm shaft and magnet, so that no side pressure is generated and the sensitivity of the arm is not impaired. In addition, a pure electronic quick stop mechanism is adopted.

CABINET
The cabinet uses a high-density cabinet (marble ebony finish) with laminated solid boards to effectively prevent the cabinet from shaking due to the reaction of the rotational moment of the high torque motor. In addition, a unique low center of gravity insulator is used as the supporting insulator to ensure stability against external vibrations such as howling. Oxygen-free copper wires with low transmission loss are used for the tone arm lead wires and PU cord. Equipped with an S-shaped universal arm pipe (with large weight) that allows easy replacement of the head shell, any cartridge can be enjoyed by the twin pipe replacement system. In addition, carbon graphite shell integrated straight arm pipe is also sold separately. Straight arms are arranged as many as the number of cartridges, and you can enjoy easily changing cartridges."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A high-precision player system that realizes incommensurable stability by pursuing high precision and looks at the essence of the player to the ultimate. For the drive part, we reviewed the bare characteristics of the rotation before applying servo, and developed and installed the SH rotor (Stable Hanging Rotor) method rotor) method to achieve rotational accuracy of orders of magnitude. The SH-rotor system adopts a unique structure in which the rotor support point, which was previously located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable. By this, the center of gravity of the turntable and the support point are almost matched. This is achieved by a structure opposite to the conventional one in which a motor shaft is fixed, a ball bearing is mounted on it, and a rotor is rotated. This eliminates the unstable inverted cone motion caused by the coincidence of the supporting points. The motor has a diameter of 31Ωcm and an inertial mass of 480Ωkg-cm.2ΩEquipped with a 2Ωkg-cm high-torque DC servo motor that rotates the turntable at a constant speed within 1Ω/3Ωrotation (approximately 1Ωsecond), it achieves excellent stability. The turntable uses a low-pressure casting method different from the conventional turntable manufacturing method in order to obtain more stable rotation and excellent acoustic characteristics. This is a hand-made method in which metal is slowly poured into an extremely precisely molded mold and cooled naturally over a long period of time. Since the inside of the mold is kept uniform with less soot and bubbles, it achieves higher density and better dynamic balance than conventional methods. In addition, in order to deaden the resonance of the turntable itself, a special anti-vibration agent is applied to the back surface to prevent squealing which adversely affects the sound quality. The magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor uses a Hall element non-contact switching method developed by Pioneer. The SH-rotor drive eliminates the fine noise that has been generated between the motor shaft and the bearing, and the special anti-vibration processing inside the phono motor unit realizes a high S / N ratio. The arm base uses a 1Ωkg heavy weight arm base made of hand-made solid brass cut one by one. In addition, the support part that fixes the arm shaft uses a chucking joint system in which 8Ωmetal blades clamp and tighten the entire face of the arm shaft evenly. Unlike the general support system in which one point or several points are fixed with screws, this system eliminates play and prevents partial resonance. In addition, the chucking joint system is also adopted for the mounting part of the head shell to pursue sound quality by thoroughly eliminating resonance. A newly developed realize high sensitivity while suppressing low-frequency resonance caused by eccentricity and warpage of commercially available records, a newly developed level variable oil braking system is adopted. Silicone oil is injected into an oil cup installed in the arm bearing. A ring-shaped braking fin with the tip cut at 45Ωdegrees is pinched to apply damping. The braking amount suitable for both vertical and horizontal directions can be applied at one point. This reduces the low-frequency resonance Q and flattens the mechanical impedance. The level adjustment ring is free when the scale is 0Ω, and the braking amount increases as the scale increases from 1Ωto 5Ω. This design allows for a wide range of applications from the MC type, which has a relatively low compliance type, to the MM type, which has a high compliance. The level adjustment ring uses a helicoid type with a highly accurate lapping process to prevent partial resonance. The tone arm part adopts a mass concentration system in which the main weight is brought closer to the arm shaft and the equivalent mass of the needle tip is reduced. By reducing the moment of inertia of the tone arm, basic performance before oil braking is also improved. The bearing part of the tone arm utilizes Pioneer's precision pioneer's precision processing technology which boasts of micron order, and adopts stability support in which the pivot is stored in the pivot holder and supported by spring.

TONE ARM
The tone arm is a long type design with an effective length of 282Ωmm using a high-rigidity aluminum pipe, and is equipped with a light-mass, high-rigidity carbon fiber head shell as standard. The cabinet is a 8Ω.5Ωkg heavy weight cabinet. This cabinet has a strong design consisting of four layers of conifer solid boards with high rigidity, high density and high internal loss, which were selected after trial manufacture and study of various materials. In addition, the newly developed low-center-of-gravity insulator with spring support is used for the insulator, with the center of gravity of the player system and the supporting point of the insulator at approximately the same height. Low-capacitance oxygen-free copper wires and gold-plated terminals are used to minimize transmission loss at the tone arm leads, power cords and their contacts. It uses a purely electronic start / stop button.5Ωmm thick smoke-degree acrylic hood made by hand craft is equipped as standard. Uses a turntable sheet with excellent acoustic characteristics."

description:
## Description

"This record player system is based on the concept of the PL-70Ωthat directly addresses the essence of the player. It uses the latest technology for the tone arm and motor. It also features a silent lift-up function. The arm is made of originally developed carbon graphite with high internal loss and high rigidity. By combining it with the base of high-purity aluminum pipe, it realizes a low-mass, high-rigidity arm that is resistant to resonance. In addition, the arm pipe is of a straight type that is advantageous in weight and provides high strength. In addition, the arm pipe is of a tapered shape that increases in second moment of area as it approaches the center of the arm. Thus, the rigidity is increased while reducing the low-mass. In addition, brass with high Young's modulus is used for the connector at the base of the arm to obtain sufficient strength. The head shell is also made of a lightweight, highly rigid carbon fiber composite material. In addition to the excellent material, the shape is ribbed to increase the strength. Vibration analysis theory is applied to determine the shape of the tone arm. In this method, the entire resonance of the arm is grasped in real time by a computer modal analyzer, the overall balance is controlled, and the vibration characteristics are made flat. In the measurement method, sensors are attached to each part of the tone arm, and the vibration distribution is expanded to about 1000Ωtimes the actual vibration displacement by a computer, and it is observed as an animation. It employs a level variable oil braking system that realizes high sensitivity while suppressing harmful low-frequency resonance caused by warping or eccentricity of records. Silicone oil is injected into the oil cup located at the upper part of the arm shaft, and the damping is applied by sinking the ring-shaped braking fin with the tip cut at 45Ωdegrees. Since the amount of braking suitable for both vertical and horizontal directions can be applied at one point, the Q of low-frequency resonance is lowered. By this, the suppression of con-modulation distortion, which makes the reproduced sound muddy, is improved by 9ΩdB. In addition, the brake oil uses silicon oil, which has less viscosity change with time and temperature. In addition, this silicon oil is stored in a high-precision molded oil cup to prevent oil bleeding and improve reliability. The level adjustment ring of the level variable oil braking system is free when the scale is 0Ω, and the braking amount increases as the scale increases from 1Ωto 5Ω. This level adjustment ring uses a helicoid type with high precision lapping processing to prevent partial resonance. The tone arm part adopts a mass concentration system in which the main weight is brought closer to the arm shaft and the equivalent mass of the needle tip is reduced. By reducing the moment of inertia of the tone arm, the basic performance before oil accuracy is also improved.

TRANSPORT
It employs a simple contactless end detection system using a Hall element and magnet, and a silent lift-up mechanism using a moving coil drive system arm elevation without any operating noise. In addition, it is equipped with a pure electronic quick stop mechanism in which the arm gently rises when the performance ends and the turntable automatically stops. In principle, the drive motor uses a coreless quartz PLL DC servo motor that does not cause cogging, which is the cause of uneven rotation. This motor uses a flat coil to generate a magnetic field instead of an air-core for the drive coil, thereby eliminating the strength and weakness of a partial magnetic field and preventing cogging. In addition, the SH rotor (Stable Hanging Rotor) system has been adopted in order to improve the bare characteristics before the servo system. This system has a structure in which the rotor support point, which was previously located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable. By this structure, the center of gravity of the turntable and the support point almost coincide with each other. In addition, the lateral pressure applied to the bearing, which is the heart of the rotating system, is reduced to improve the stability of the turntable. The turntable uses a low-pressure casting method that is different from the conventional method. This is a hand-made method in which metal is slowly poured into an extremely precise mold and cooled naturally over a long period of time. Since the inside of the mold is kept uniform with less soot and bubbles, it achieves higher density and better dynamic balance than the conventional method. In addition, in order to deaden the resonance of the turntable itself, a special anti-vibration material is applied to the back surface to prevent squealing which adversely affects the sound quality. The cabinet is a 8Ω.5Ωkg heavy weight cabinet designed by laminating conifer solid boards selected after trial manufacture and examination of various materials. We have also adopted a newly developed low-center-of-gravity structure insulator with the center of gravity of the player system and the supporting point of the insulator at approximately the same height. As shown in the as shown in the structure diagram. Low-capacitance oxygen-free copper wires and gold-plated terminals are used to minimize transmission loss at the tone arm leads, power cords and their contacts. It is equipped with a 5Ωmm thick smoke door clear hood made by hand craft one by one as standard. Uses a turntable sheet with excellent acoustic characteristics. Equipped with S-shaped replacement arm pipe for easy replacement of head shell (with large weight)In addition, carbon graphite shell integrated straight arm is also sold separately, and straight arm pipes are prepared for the number of cartridges to be used, and the cartridge can be easily replaced."

description:
## Description

"A full auto player that uses an SH rotor type coreless motor. With a full-auto mechanism, you can place a record on a turntable and press the start button to auto-lead-in. In addition, it auto-returns when the record finishes playing, auto-cut and auto-repeat can be performed with one button operation. We also do quick play. The control buttons are laid out on the front of the cabinet and can be operated with the dust cover closed.

MOTOR
An SH rotor type coreless motor is used as the drive motor. In the SH-rotor system, the rotor support point, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable so that the center of gravity of the turntable almost coincides with the support point. This eliminates from the root the reverse cone motion and the rotational slippage caused by the lubricating oil used between the shaft and the bearing. In addition, the bare nature of the motor before the servo was applied is improved, and the rotation of the turntable is stabilized. In addition, parts such as shafts and bearings are also improved in accuracy of micron order or less by utilizing Pioneer's precision processing technology, and reliability and durability are improved.

MOTOR
The SH rotor type coreless motor realizes smooth rotational torque without cogging by using a coreless structure in which a driving coil is an empty core and a flat coil is used to generate a magnetic field without using a core. In addition, the diameter of the coil for generating the magnetic field is increased, a thin flat coil is used for the coil, and the power efficiency required for torque generation is improved by using Pioneer's original new IC, and high torque is realized. The tone arm uses a static balance S-shaped tone arm. Mass concentration system is adopted for this arm to reduce the moment of inertia which affects the traceability of the tone arm by moving the main weight closer to the fulcrum (arm shaft). The cartridge is equipped with a high power MC cartridge that can be used in the MM position. This cartridge uses Pioneer's independently developed 6Ω-pole 4Ω-magnet configuration for the left and right sides. Samarium-cobalt magnets with high energy product (BHmax) are placed opposite to each other in the same pole. As a result, a high magnetic flux of up to 10Ω,000ΩGauss can be obtained, and power is efficiently generated linearly from small amplitude to large amplitude. In addition, as the left and right sides are independently generated, there is essentially no interference between channels, and excellent separation characteristics are obtained. In this MC cartridge, the magnetic circuit and needle are separated and independent, so the needle exchange can be done as easily as MM type. The cabinet uses a coaxial suspension. In this system, the motor and tone arm are fixed to a single underboard, and the whole underboard is spring supported, preventing harmful resonance and suppressing howling. In addition, by adopting a thin design of 96Ωmm, the area that receives sound pressure is reduced and excellent howling resistance is realized. Rotational speed can be finely adjusted."

The central part of the PL-380Ωfull-auto mechanism is computerized, and the reliability and durability are enhanced by integrating logic circuits equivalent to 5000Ωtransistors into two Pioneer original ICs. In order to realize accurate return operation without losing the sensitivity of the tone arm, an optical electronic return position detection mechanism is mounted. This mechanism is completely contactless by combining an LED and a phototransistor to prevent excessive lateral pressure on the tone arm. Equipped with a quick play mechanism, the turntable starts rotating when you move the tone arm to the record board with your fingertips. It also has a Klix/Kluk? top mechanism that stops rotating when returned to the arm rest. The tone arm itself uses a mass concentration system in which the main weight is close to the rotating shaft to reduce the moment of inertia which adversely affects the traceability. All operation buttons except for the record size selector are arranged on the front, and operation can be performed while the acrylic cover is closed. Equipped with MM type cartridge. Uses a quartz lock indicator."

description:
## Description

"A full auto player that uses an SH rotor type coreless motor. PL 470Ωis a full auto player that can perform auto lead in, Oatley turn, auto cut and auto repeat without touching the tone arm.

MOTOR
An SH rotor type coreless motor is used as the drive motor. In the SH-rotor system, the rotor support point, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable so that the center of gravity of the turntable almost coincides with the support point. This eliminates from the root the reverse cone motion and the rotational slippage caused by the lubricating oil used between the shaft and the bearing. In addition, the bare nature of the motor before the servo was applied is improved, and the rotation of the turntable is stabilized. In addition, parts such as shafts and bearings are also improved in accuracy of micron order or less by utilizing Pioneer's precision processing technology, and reliability and durability are improved.

MOTOR
The SH rotor type coreless motor realizes smooth rotational torque without cogging by using a coreless structure in which a driving coil is an empty core and a flat coil is used to generate a magnetic field without using a core. In addition, the diameter of the coil for generating the magnetic field is increased, a thin flat coil is used for the coil, and the power efficiency required for torque generation is improved by using Pioneer's original new IC, and high torque is realized. The servo circuit uses a quartz PLL system that controls the phase difference by comparing the reference signal of the crystal oscillator with the speed detection signal of the motor. In order to improve the accuracy and reliability of the PL 470Ω, a sample-and-hold type high-gain F-V converter, which is highly stable against ripple (erroneous signal), has been developed as a single-chip IC, and is used in the frequency control circuit and phase control circuit. The speed detection mechanism of the motor itself uses an all-round integration method. In this method, the AC signal obtained by the pole magnetized at equal intervals over the whole circumference of the lower surface of the rotor magnet and the print pattern coil with the same number of poles attached opposite to each other is integrated over the whole circumference to improve reliability. In addition, a special large magnet is used, and by doubling the magnetized magnetic pulse from the conventional 200Ωpole to 400Ωpole, it is possible to quickly apply servo against load fluctuation, and dynamic load characteristics are greatly improved. We have also adopted a brushless motor pole switching circuit that uses a Hall element developed by Pioneer. A straight arm using carbon graphite is adopted for the tone arm. This arm realizes high rigidity, low mass and no resonance by forming carbon graphite into a straight pipe with high mechanical stability and combining it with aluminum base. Carbon fiber composite material is used for the head shell to increase strength and reduce weight. High-purity oxygen-free copper wires are used in the signal transmission system to improve sound quality. The cartridge is equipped with a high power MC cartridge that can be used in the MM position. This cartridge uses Pioneer's independently developed 6Ω-pole 4Ω-magnet configuration for the left and right sides. Samarium-cobalt magnets with high energy product (BHmax) are placed opposite to each other in the same pole. As a result, a high magnetic flux of up to 10Ω,000ΩGauss can be obtained, and power is efficiently generated linearly from small amplitude to large amplitude. In addition, as the left and right sides are independently generated, there is essentially no interference between channels, and excellent separation characteristics are obtained. In this MC cartridge, the magnetic circuit and needle are separated and independent, so the needle exchange can be done as easily as MM type. The cabinet uses a coaxial suspension. In this system, the motor and tone arm are fixed to a single underboard, and the whole underboard is spring supported, preventing harmful resonance and suppressing howling. The operation buttons are all front operation type located on the front panel for improved operability. Equipped with a quick play mechanism that starts rotating the turntable when the tone arm is moved onto the record board, and with a quick stop climate that stops rotating when the tone arm is returned to the arm rest. Since the arm lifter is operated by a dedicated DC motor during manual operation, smooth and highly reliable elevation operation is possible. The exterior is finished in champagne gold."

description:
## Description

"Linear tracking player equipped with linear DD arm. It is equipped with a linear DD arm that combines the basic performance of the linear tracking system with proprietary technology. While the conventional linear tracking method has advantages such as 0Ωtracking error, it has a disadvantage that the SN ratio is poor and the playback sound is muddy. This is because the direct driving force of the arm is mechanically obtained from a rotary motor through a gear or belt. The vibration of the motor and the delay in the response speed of the power transmission part cause deterioration in sound quality.

MOTOR
In the linear DD arm, a linear DD type motor is used, and electrical energy is directly extracted as linear energy without any mechanical conversion mechanism. This eliminates mechanical contact and eliminates vibration and other problems that cause sound quality degradation.

TRANSPORT
In addition, the combination with an electronic full auto mechanism realizes a quiet and highly accurate arm drive. The cartridge is equipped with an MC cartridge with a new structure developed by Pioneer. This cartridge has a high output of 1Ω.5ΩmV thanks to its efficient power generation mechanism, so it does not need a dedicated amplifier or head amplifier and can be connected directly to the MM position of the amplifier. In addition, this new structure has been thoroughly simplified, making it easy to replace needles, which was difficult with conventional MC cartridges.

MOTOR
An SH rotor type coreless motor is used as the drive motor. By using a coreless motor without cogging and an SH rotor system with improved rotational accuracy, the bare characteristics of the motor are dramatically improved and excellent characteristics are realized. In addition, a quartz PLL is used in the servo circuit to improve stability and load resistance. Carbon graphite, which is lightweight and highly rigid, is used for the arm pipe. Carbon fiber is also used for the head shell, and a low mass tone arm with almost no resonance is realized. In addition, the theory of mass concentration is applied to the arm structure, and excellent traceability is exhibited. Oxygen-free copper wires are used for internal lead wires to improve sound quality. This is the first linear player in this class to be equipped with a universal tone arm, and most commercially available cartridges can be mounted. A high-precision electronic full auto mechanism is adopted, and a newly developed microcomputer controls linear tracking operation and rotation / stop / rotation speed switching of the phono motor."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A record player that uses a brushless DC servo motor and carbon fiber reinforced arm.

MOTOR
The drive motor is a brushless DC servo D. D. motor using a Hall element.

MOTOR
The motor used in the PL 1800Ωis a brushless type. Three hall elements detect the position of magnetic signals magnetized on the inner surface of the rotor in a contactless manner. Changes in magnetic field due to rotation are reliably converted into changes in current. In addition, since it is a high-torque type with a starting torque of 1Ωkg-cm, start-up time is fast. The servo circuit uses a magnetic pulse detection type. In this system, a magnetic pulse for velocity detection is magnetized on the lower surface of the rotor, and a printed circuit board with a pulse pattern is installed on the lower surface facing the magnetic pulse. The frequency generated by the rotation of the rotor is detected and an AC signal is sent to the servo circuit. This system has extremely low impedance of the signal source and high stability against changes in temperature and humidity.

TURNTABLE
The turntable has a dynamically balanced inertial mass of 280Ωkg-cm. Turntable is adopted. This turntable, shaft and bearing are carefully polished by an automatic precision machine to obtain high accuracy. The strobe lights on the periphery of the turntable are lit by a waveform shaping circuit, and are easier to see than conventional strobe lights.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply to the drive circuit is from a stable circuit with a large current capacity, and stability is improved by providing sufficient temperature compensation. Stable values for temperature drift and time drift are also obtained. The tone arm uses a reinforced pipe made of carbon fiber. By weaving long carbon fiber into a mesh, we have succeeded in increasing the strength against twisting and reducing the effective mass. This reduces the moment of inertia of the arm to a very small value, increases the ability to follow the sound groove, and also improves the partial resonance that occurs in the middle range. The head shell also uses carbon fiber to reduce the moment of inertia. A special angular contact bearing has been adopted for the horizontal and vertical rotating part of the arm. This reduces friction and improves tracing capability. In addition, milling and precision polishing are applied to the finish to prevent the degradation of mid-range characteristics caused by the rattling of the bearing part. In addition, the anti-skating mechanism uses a lever type that uses two angular contact bearings, and it is processed without losing horizontal sensitivity. This mechanism has the advantages of simple structure, high stability during use, and no aging. The cabinet uses a rigid fiberboard (MDF) that extracts only the hardest fiber (cellulose) of all wood and compresses it into a 20Ω-mm-thick plate. This plate is used and reinforced effectively to reduce howling. Uses an insulator that combines specially shaped rubber and aluminum die-cast. The height of this insulator is adjustable. The height and vertical tracking angle of the arm can be adjusted. Fine speed adjustment is possible within � 6Ω%. Equipped with pin jack output terminal for easy attachment and detachment of output cord. Also comes with a low-capacity cord (50Ωpf or less / 1Ωm)."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"An armless player with a brushless DC servo direct drive hole motor. The motor is a direct drive phono motor that uses a Hall element. In place of the brush, which was indispensable for conventional DC motors, we applied the hole stopping method developed by Pioneer to the magnetic field detection of the switching mechanism. This reduces vibration compared with DC motors with mechanical switching mechanism, and improves S/N and durability. In addition, the motor rotates at 33Ω1Ω/3ΩÏ‰ 45Ωrpm, which is the same as the number of revolutions of the record. Since the direct drive system directly drives the turntable, there is no intermediate reduction mechanism that causes uneven rotation, and excellent characteristics are obtained. The Hall element is a kind of semiconductor. It is a cross-shaped thin film metal made of N-type Insb alloy. It uses the ""Hall effect"" in which a voltage is generated between two terminals when an electric current flows through two terminals and a magnetic force is applied at a right angle to the other two terminals to convert magnetism into electricity. Pioneer has developed a new manufacturing method called the vacuum deposition method, and has reduced the thickness from the previous limit of 30Ω-50ΩÏ‰ m to 0Ω.8ΩÏ‰ m, realizing a low-cost and small-size Hall element. Equipped with a DC servo mechanism to control the rotation accurately at all times. In this control circuit, the rotation is automatically controlled by a capacitor-type oscillator that is not affected by changes in the ambient temperature or by the magnetic force of the rotor magnet, thus maintaining a stable rotational speed. Equipped with a brake mechanism that instantly stops the turntable when the power switch is turned off. A purely electronic system is used for changing the rotational speed, and the speed can be finely adjusted within a range of � 4Ω% while watching the strobe light carved on the outer circumference of the turntable. The flash lamp is equipped with a flashing switch so that it can be turned off when it is unnecessary.

CABINET
The cabinet is a double-walled 30Ωmm-thick cabinet with a combination of plywood and metal base with a rosewood natural wood wood finish. A large insulator is used to reduce howling and external vibration. In addition, the height can be freely adjusted, and the level can be adjusted while looking at the level of the panel. You can attach any tone arm to the attached panel and use it. If you remove the dust cover, you can use up to 16Ωtype arm. This board is a detachable type that can be easily removed with 6Ωscrews, and you can easily exchange many kinds of arms by using sub panel sold separately."

"The development and installation of the Linear D. D> arm solves the problem that had been a bottleneck until now. The Linear D. D. Arm developed by Pioneer Shinkai is mounted in order to move the strong arm base horizontally precisely and quietly. By this, factors that cause harmful noise and vibration are completely eliminated. The Linear D. D. arm is structurally very simple because the magnetic repulsion force generated by electrical energy can be directly converted into linear motion. Unlike conventional systems, the arm base can be directly driven without any transmission mechanism such as a rotary motor, gears, belts, or strings.

TONE ARM
Record sound In order to ensure that the arm base follows the movement of the needle tip that traces the groove, we have adopted a contactless arm shift detection mechanism that combines a cds and a lamp at the arm mounting part. By adding this detection output to a differential amplifier, we constitute a servo system that supplies the required amount of current. Moreover, since this arm shift detection angle is a small angle of 0Ω.2Ωdegrees, quick correction is possible. Moreover, since the arm shift detection mechanism makes accurate response correction not only in the inner circumferential direction of the record but also in the outer circumferential direction, there is no need to worry about unnecessary lateral pressure on the needle tip even if a record with eccentricity is traced, and high traceability is achieved. In the linear D. D. arm, a two way servo system is activated by the output voltage of the generator linked to the rotary arm feed section to enable smooth arm feed. All you need to do is to lightly touch the arm feed knob and turn it. The arm moves according to the direction and speed of rotation, and the feel of the fingertip becomes the arm action. This allows you to drop the needle from the middle of the middle of the record and start playing freely. The arm feed mechanism is designed to be safe so that it does not work during the performance of the record, so there is no risk of accidentally damaging the needle tip or the record. In addition, by moving the arm left and right by holding the finger of the arm, the arm shift detection mechanism and the two way servo automatically work to move the arm base, making it possible to perform the same operation with the same feeling as manual player. Uses a symmetrical straight arm. Since it is a short type with a short effective length, the inertia mass of the arm is reduced and the equivalent mass is also reduced to improve traceability. The material is a strong aluminum alloy, and since it is not subjected to bending process, the strain inside the pipe is reduced and harmful resonance is suppressed. A dynamic balance method is used for needle pressure application. In addition, it is a universal arm, and various cartridges from all over the world can be attached. A 1Ω.4Ωkg arm base with sufficient strength is used for the arm base. Arm height adjustment mechanism is adopted, and suitable vertical tracking angle can be obtained according to the cartridge to be used.

TURNTABLE
The SH rotor (Stable Hanging Rotor) system, in which the rotor support point (bearing) is moved just below the turntable, is used for the drive part. As a result, the center of gravity and the position of the supporting point almost coincide with each other, and the fluctuation of the turntable is suppressed. The motor has an inertial mass of 380Ωkg-cm.2ΩIt employs a high-torque brushless DC servo motor that drives the turntable at a constant speed within 1Ω/4Ωrotation (approximately 1Ωsecond). It is designed so that the rotational speed does not vary even under the load of approximately 150Ωtone arms with a needle pressure of 1Ω.5Ωg.

CABINET
High-density conifer particleboard with howling protection is used for the cabinet, and a large insulator with height adjustable up to 6Ωmm is used for the insulator. It uses an electronic arm elevation mechanism that uses a dedicated DC motor, allowing the arm to move up and down smoothly. In addition, it is equipped with an electronic auto-up mechanism that lifts the arm from the board immediately after the end of the recording performance, and the turntable stops as soon as the arm auto-up. No extra lateral pressure is applied to the needle tip as it is non-contact type. High-conductivity oxygen-free copper wires are used for all cables for signal transmission systems. The output jacks and terminal pins are gold-plated. It is equipped with 5Ωmm thick acrylic cover. It comes with a 7Ω.7Ωx7Ω.7Ωhigh precision large level that can level the cabinet."
