description:
## Description

"A record player with a quartz PLL. Quartz PLL system is adopted for servo circuit. In this system, pulses from a power generator mounted on the motor's rotating shaft are compared with pulses from a crystal oscillator, and the phase difference is detected to maintain the motor rotation speed. In order to improve the reliability of the circuit itself, we have been making efforts to convert it into an IC. Bipolar ICs are used for the drive circuit and MOS ICs are used for the control circuit. Since the XL-1550Ωdrive circuit operates in the forward and reverse directions, the motor rotation speed is increased and the electric brake is applied in the reverse direction, enabling quick response. The strobe is equipped with a waveform shaping circuit. In this circuit, the strobe is turned on after dividing the oscillation frequency (3Ωmhz band) of the crystal oscillator by a power circuit. This circuit is not affected by the power supply frequency. In addition, by changing the dividing ratio when changing the number of revolutions, adjustment with one stripe is possible. In addition, the flash current is pulse-lit by a waveform shaping circuit so that the flash inscribed on the turntable periphery can be clearly read. The servo circuit has a built-in CR oscillator, and the PLL (phase control) works even when the quartz is turned off, so that excellent load resistance and drift characteristics can be obtained even during fine adjustment.

MOTOR
The drive motor uses a high-torque brushless DC servo hole motor with a diameter of 32Ω.4Ωcm and inertial mass of 340Ωkg Ï‰ cm.2ΩRotate the large aluminum die-cast turntable at a constant speed within 2Ω/3Ωrevolutions. The starting torque of this motor is 1Ωkg-cm. The switching mechanism uses three independently developed Hall elements to achieve high S/N and durability.

TONE ARM
S-shaped pipe arm is used for the tone arm. In addition to reducing the effective mass, this arm uses a high-precision angular contact bearing in the vertical and horizontal rotating parts to reduce friction and obtain high sensitivity. In addition, a 6Ωt aluminum panel is used for the arm mounting base, and steel plate (thickness 6Ωmm, weight 700Ωg) is reinforced from the inside of the cabinet to protect the tone arm from howling during ultra-low frequency playback. The head shell uses a non-resonant type made of aluminum alloy to reduce the weight. The MM type PC 330Ω/ II cartridge is used. The cantilever of this cartridge is made of titanium pipe with special heat treatment, and since it is light at 0Ω.45Ωmg and has little deflection, mechanical impedance is kept low and tracing capability is improved.

CABINET
The cabinet uses a combination of particle boards. Equipped with an arm height adjustment mechanism that can be adjusted at a height of � 5Ωmm from the reference position. Equipped with an anti-skating mechanism. Butyl rubber is used for the turntable seat. Uses an insulator that combines special rubber and die-cast solid. The level of this insulator can be adjusted, and it can be changed by 0Ω.5Ωmm per one rotation of the insulator."

## Description

"A record player that added a quick stop mechanism to the XL 1550Ω. The XL-1551Ωhas a quick stop (brake) mechanism. Turning the control lever to OFF stops the turntable and allows quick change to the next record. In addition, the exterior is finished with metallic star tone. Quartz PLL system is adopted for servo circuit. In this method, the phase difference is detected by comparing pulses from a power generator attached to the motor's rotating shaft with pulses from a crystal oscillator to maintain the motor's rotational speed. In order to improve the reliability of the circuit itself, we have been making efforts to convert it into an IC. Bipolar ICs are used for the drive circuit and MOS ICs are used for the control circuit. A bi-directional a bi-directional drive circuit that operates in the forward and reverse directions. As a result, even when the motor speed increases, the electric brake is applied in the reverse direction, enabling quick response. As a result, even when the rotational speed is changed, constant speed rotation is achieved immediately. High-precision control circuits, high-torque direct drive motors, precision-machined shafts, bearings, turntables, and other devices provide excellent performance. The strobe uses an easy-to-adjust single-stripe strobe and a waveform circuit that makes it easy to see the stripes. Conventional speed adjustment strobes generally use the frequency of a home AC power supply for irradiation. For this reason, four stripes are required for each power supply frequency and rotation speed. On top of that, general power supplies for prizes have a frequency fluctuation of about 0Ω.1Ω%, making it difficult to make precise adjustments. The XL XL-1551Ω, the oscillation frequency of the crystal oscillator (3ΩMHz band) is divided by an electronic circuit and is turned on to eliminate the influence of fluctuations in the power supply frequency. In addition, the frequency division ratio (33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm : 55Ω.5ΩHz, 45Ωrpm : 75ΩHz) can be changed when the rotation speed is changed to enable adjustment with one stripe. In addition, since the flash current is pulse-lit by the waveform shaping circuit, the flash inscribed on the turntable periphery can be clearly read. The servo circuit has a built-in CR oscillator, so that even when the quartz is turned off, the PLL (phase control) works, and excellent load resistance and drift characteristics can be obtained even during fine adjustment.

MOTOR

The starting torque of this motor is 1Ωkg-cm. The switching mechanism uses three independently developed Hall elements to achieve high S/N and durability.

TONE ARM
S-shaped pipe arm is used for the tone arm. In addition to reducing the effective mass of this arm, a high-precision angular contact bearing is used for the vertical and horizontal rotating parts to reduce friction and obtain high sensitivity. In addition, a 6Ωt aluminum panel is used for the arm mounting base, and steel plate (thickness 6Ωmm, weight 700Ωg) is reinforced from the inside of the cabinet to protect the tone arm from howling during ultra-low frequency reproduction. The head shell uses a non-resonant type made of aluminum alloy to reduce the weight. The MM type PC 330Ω/ II cartridge is used. The cantilever of this cartridge is made of titanium pipe with special heat treatment. It is light at 0Ω.45Ωmg and has little deflection, so it keeps the mechanical impedance low and increases the tracing capability.

CABINET
The cabinet uses a combination of particle boards. Equipped with an arm height adjustment mechanism that can be adjusted at a height of � 5Ωmm from the reference position. Equipped with an anti-skating mechanism. Butyl rubber is used for the turntable seat. Uses an insulator that combines special rubber and die-cast solid. The level of this insulator can be adjusted, and it can be changed by 0Ω.5Ωmm per one rotation of the insulator."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"Armless player that adopts quartz PLL system. Universal type arm mounting board is adopted, and domestic and overseas tone arms except for 16Ωinch long arm can be used. The mounting board uses laminated plywood with a metallic finish for easy drilling. The turntable uses a direct drive system, and the motor shaft directly drives the turntable without passing through a transmission mechanism.

MOTOR
A high-torque brushless DC servo hole motor is used hole motor.

MOTOR
The magnetic pole switching (switching circuit), which greatly influences the performance of the DD motor itself, adopts a brushless type using three Hall elements developed by Pioneer's original manufacturing method, and realizes high S/N and reliability. The XLC 1850Ωuses a quartz PLL system for the servo circuit with high detection accuracy. By comparing the output pulse of the generator attached to the rotating shaft of the motor with the pulse of the reference signal using a crystal, not only the frequency difference between the two is detected, but also the phase difference (time difference between lead and lag) is detected and the rotation speed is controlled. This enables accurate detection of long and weak speed changes that were considered difficult to detect with conventional methods, and always maintains the correct rotation speed. In place of the conventional strobe, a direct-reading pitch indicator is used to indicate the rotational speed during fine adjustment of speed. Since the deviation from the exact number of revolutions can be read directly in numerical values, it is easy to compare and play records at the same pitch and to confirm when the pitch of a record matches the pitch of an instrument. When the Quartz Lock is ON, this indicator is synchronized with the correct rotation speed with the word ""Quartz"" lit. When the brake is applied by an external force, the lamp goes out. When the Quartz Lock is OFF, the memory of the pitch indicator lights. The rotation speed of the turntable is measured by a combination of a Schmidt circuit and an integrating circuit for driving the meter, and the rotation speed can be displayed in analog form. The volume for fine adjustment has a special resistance curve so that it can turn in the same sense as the indicated angle of the meter at the time of adjustment, taking usability into consideration. Equipped with quick stop mechanism for electronic devices. In this system, when the stop button is pressed, the control circuit switches to generate torque to rotate the motor in the opposite direction and applies the brake rapidly. When the rotation is almost stopped, the power is turned off and the turntable stops. This drive circuit responds quickly when the motor speed is increased by electronic braking, and when the speed is changed from 45Ωrpm to 33Ω1Ω/3Ωrpm, servo is also activated and constant speed rotation is achieved immediately. By integrating the control circuit and drive circuit into an IC, unstable elements that cause performance degradation are eliminated. A bipolar IC is used for the drive circuit and a MOS IC is used for the control circuit.

CABINET
The cabinet is made of aluminum die cast with a thickness of 4Ωmm and a weight of 4Ω.7Ωkg, and has a structure to prevent howling by analyzing resonance mode. The cabinet has a box structure with 24Ωribs around it. In addition, a new material with low Q (low resonance) is used for the bottom cover. In addition, an insulator made of a combination of special rubber and die-cast solid is directly attached to the cabinet body howling margin by 3Ωdb. A cut-core transformer is used for the power supply. The cut-core transformer has low leakage flux and excellent regulation. By floating mounting the transformer on the cabinet board, the effect of noise on sound quality is suppressed. A push type is used for the operation part. Concentrated layout on a single die-cast panel enables one touch operation. A removable transparent acrylic dust cover is used for the dust cover. Comes with one touch universal arm rest. Installation is one touch type and can be installed in any position by adhesive tape at the bottom.

## Description

"A series center speaker developed with the theme of home theater and home concert hall. Two 16Ωcm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range. The cone uses Kevlar fiber. description:
## Description

"Center speaker with thin design.

WOOFER
A 12Ωcm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. This unit adopts a midship drive system. In this system, a small magnetic circuit using a neodymium magnet is placed in front of a cone type diaphragm, making it much thinner than conventional units. In addition, the drive point, support point and center of gravity are close to each other, making it easier to move and less likely to induce unnecessary movement. In addition, by eliminating the damper, the driving force is transmitted directly to the diaphragm, increasing the initial motion sensitivity and eliminating the distortion and noise caused by the damper. A 2Ω.5Ωcm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range. This unit uses a neodymium magnet in the magnetic circuit, and high-frequency playback is available up to 60ΩkHz.

CABINET

There are two color variations : white (S-MT5Ω-C-W) and black (S-MT5Ω-C-K)."

"Powered subwoofer for DVD audio. The unit is equipped with 30Ωcm cone type woofer. This unit uses a magnetic circuit with a 156Ωmm diameter magnet. The unit is fixed to the cross legs, and the four peripheral parts of the speaker are inserted into the baffle and fixed, and also contributes to the reinforcement of the base plate. The exterior has a real wood finish. Speaker input and RCA pin are used as input terminals. It also has a line-out connector for connecting two or more powered sub-woofers."

"A surround system consisting of a subwoofer and two satellite speakers.

WOOFER
The subwoofer uses a double-duct drive system for compact size and low sound reproduction. It has two ducts, one in front of the woofer unit and the other in the upper part of the inner baffle inside the enclosure. Sound from the front of the woofer comes out from the duct in front of the unit, and sound from the back passes through the sound path from the duct in the upper part of the inner baffle and is guided to the duct in front of the unit and radiated outside. In this way, the low range is expanded by applying back load which is effective for bass enhancement. The satellite speaker is a coaxial two way type that combines a 10Ωcm cone type and a 2Ω.5Ωcm cone type. A base unit is included for the setting free type satellite speaker. This base unit is designed to fit the R-shape of satellite speakers. When placed on a shelf, it is installed as it is when placed vertically, and when placed horizontally, it is installed by placing the base unit. In addition, the accuracy can be changed such as front facing or upward facing. When mounting the speaker on a wall, fix the speaker and base unit with the supplied screws, and then mount the base unit on the wall. There was a set of 3Ωsatellite speakers sold separately."

name: S5Ω
description:
## Description

"A speaker system that uses a unit that inherits the design philosophy of Technical Aucio Devices (TAD) and adopts a vertical twin system as a system that draws out the potential of this unit. The S5Ωuses a vertical twin system with a horn at the center and a woofer at the top and bottom. In this system, the acoustic energy of the two woofers is concentrated in the center and coincides with the horn axis, so that the range from low to high frequencies becomes a virtual co-axis centered on the horn, improving the sense of sound localization. In addition, it has excellent horizontal directivity, and the quick response of the woofer gives a crisp low sound. Two newly developed 25Ωcm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range. By combining a magnetic circuit using an alnico magnet with a lightweight vibration system, we have ensured linearity that does not lose balance from low volume to high input. In addition, by thoroughly increasing the initial motion sensitivity of the vibration support system, we have improved the balance at low volume, which was considered difficult in the past. In addition, by combining a special aging cone and a vibration system with good linearity, it is designed to resist changes over time.

TWEETER
A horn type tweeter combining a driver unit and a wooden horn is mounted in the high range. The driver unit uses a powerful alnico magnetic circuit with a magnetic flux density of 18Ω,000Ωgauss and a lightweight, high-hardness beryllium diaphragm with a diameter of 4Ω.8Ωcm. The horn uses a newly developed wood horn to bring out the wide-band characteristics of the driver unit. It is made of Painted maple with excellent sound quality and is finished by hand. It solves the problems of high sensitivity and directional control in the wide band. The connection between the network and the unit is directly connected by crimping without using terminals. In particular, the Woofer unit is crimped even to the Kinshi line without using solder. Furthermore, the dedicated circuit is used for each woofer to prevent back-electromotive force interference between the woofers. In addition, oxygen-free copper wires are used for the choke coil and wire cord, and vibration countermeasures are applied to each material and cord to control resonance and noise. In addition, the wiring is also taken into consideration so that crosstalk between elements and wire cords does not adversely affect the wiring. The input to the network is directly and uniformly transmitted by radial power supply system. Particular attention has been paid to the material of the enclosure as well.

CABINET
The top plate and baffle plate upper part are made of Birds Eye Maple (maple), the other parts are made of walnut, and oil stain finish is applied. The structure is a tall boy type floor type. The baffle plate has an elliptic curve round baffle with a large arc to reduce sound reflection and diffraction phenomena. In addition, in order to prevent the vibration of each unit from interfering with each other by the baffle and making the sound muddy, all units are firmly fixed by the midship mount. In addition, a shield frame and a floating top are provided to eliminate resonance.

POWER SUPPLY
The speaker terminal supports a bi-wired connection that separates the high-frequency and low-frequency circuits for independent power supply, and is equipped with a short bar so that it can be used as a single speaker terminal. The emblem is made of natural precious wood with laser processing."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier developed with new elements and new circuits to realize the ""Magniwide power range"" concept of full power reproduction at low distortion rate over an ultra-wide band. The A-0012Ωuses a group transistor RET with superior high-frequency switching characteristics. This device is made by combining hundreds of small transistors with superior high-frequency characteristics in parallel. It has high breakdown strength and can produce high output at high frequencies with low distortion.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In addition, a DC amplifier configuration has been adopted to improve the low-frequency characteristics, extending the frequency characteristics to the ultra-low frequency range and improving the phase characteristics in the mid-low frequency range. The power supply consists of a large left and right independent transformer with an emphasis on dynamic characteristics and a 18Ω,000ΩÏ‰ Fx4Ωcapacitor. In addition, the power section through which a large current flows and the speaker terminals are wired on extremely thick Line 14Ωwith a resistance value that is 1Ω/4Ωof the conventional thick line.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, pure copper is used for the ground line of the power capacitor, and at the same time, the copper foil on the printed circuit board of each circuit is doubled to 70ΩÏ‰ thick, making for a thorough low-impedance design. It uses class AB operation and operates up to 3ΩW, which accounts for most of the music signal, at class A, which has an established reputation for sound quality, with essentially no switching distortion or crossover distortion. In addition, since the power utilization factor is high efficiency close to that of general class B amplifiers, it is possible to obtain a dynamic range of up to 120ΩW during peak playback. It has a 4Ωdc configuration consisting of an MC head amplifier, an equalizer amplifier, a flat amplifier, and a power amplifier. If a buffer amplifier is included, it can be called a 5Ωdc amplifier.

POWER SUPPLY
Since all amplification stages are DC, there is no capacitor that causes phase distortion in the NFB loop of the amplifier circuit, and it has flat phase characteristics over a wide band and stable operation. It also improves transient response characteristics including the damping of back electromotive force from the speaker.

EQUALIZER
In the equalizer amplifier section, a low-noise dual FET with excellent noise characteristics is used in the first stage differential section. In the dual FET, the entire element has a high SN ratio, and at the same time, a higher SN ratio is obtained by suppressing the voltage between the drain and gate of the FET by cascade connection to prevent generation of noise. The whole MC head amplifier section is divided into two systems. description:
## Description

"This is a pre-main amplifier that inherits the technology of high-end machines. The chassis layout has a symmetrical twin monaural structure. In addition to the symmetrical layout of the internal circuit and structure represented by the twin transformer, the A-05Ωhas a fully symmetrical structure including the front panel, rear panel, and volume, so that the environment such as current, magnetic field, temperature distribution, and mechanical stress distribution can be made uniform. This minimizes the characteristic error of L/R caused by parts. In addition, all compromises have been made to simplify the circuit, and the signal path has been straightened to achieve higher quality playback. Wide-range linear circuit ver. 5Ωis adopted to improve the time axis characteristics of the transmission system. Conventional amplifier circuits are equipped with choke coils for the speaker output terminals, capacitors for each input terminal, and phase compensation capacitors to ensure stability against high frequencies. However, these parts prevent the simplification of the circuit and the amplification of pure sound. The choke coil adversely affects the output impedance in the high frequency range, and the phase compensation capacitor adversely affects the sound quality. In order to solve this problem, the wide-range linear circuit is designed to obtain the necessary gain by one stage amplification using a current feedback circuit, and the damping factor is made flat over a wide range to obtain excellent speaker drive power. Dedicated tuning parts such as custom-designed volume and original organic semiconductor condenser are adopted. The power transformer uses a toroidal transformer with an oriented core. The core section without corners suppresses the generation of beat and improves the S/N feeling. It is equipped with a gain selector to cut off the excess gain and increase the purity of the sound when playing at a small volume. There are two selector positions, 40ΩdB and 26ΩdB. The 40ΩdB position gives you more power, and the 26ΩdB position gives you more natural music playback.

EQUALIZER
The phono equalizer uses a single-chip dual FET as its input circuit. An OFC power cord is used for the power cable, and external noise is eliminated by drawing the power cord from directly under the power transformer. Uses gold-plated input / output terminals. A large vise type speaker terminal with low transmission loss is adopted."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"Pioneer engineers have kept the idea of ""If we can express our will to the maximum in the fixed condition of pre-main amplifier"" warm for 6Ωyears. It uses simple circuit design for ""straight sound"". In addition, it is the highest quality pre-main amplifier which was born by incorporating all the technologies such as Exclusive C7Ωphilosophy and technology. Symmetrical twin monaural structure is adopted.

POWER SUPPLY
A shield box with a large current circuit power block on the left and right sides and a small signal input block in the rear center is placed around the central power supply section. The symmetrical structure with independent left and right channel circuits provides excellent separation. In addition to the length of the left and right signal paths and the configuration of parts, the temperature, magnetic field distribution, and vibration environment inside the main body that affect the operation of elements and circuits are made uniform, and the occurrence of left and right electrical and mechanical characteristic errors is suppressed. A pre-power isolated structure has been adopted to achieve the purpose of a separate amplifier, in which circuits with different roles of voltage amplification and current amplification operate properly, while maintaining the advantages of a pre-main amplifier, in which excellent balance and compactness can be obtained by connecting two amplifiers directly. The preamp circuit (from the input terminal to the voltage amplification stage) including the volume is shielded by a non-magnetic aluminum box. Moreover, this box is supported by a chassis through vibration control rubber. It adopts a floating structure.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is also separated from the rectifier circuit by making the pre-section and the power section independent of each other. This realizes complete separation. As a result, delicate input signals are isolated electrically and physically so as not to cause deterioration of sound quality due to circuit interference from the power section, fluctuation of the power section and vibration of the power section. This structure can be called a separate amplifier in a set. It is equipped with advanced direct construction which is a further development of direct construction which makes the signal path as short as possible. The signal switching relay and volume unit are controlled from the front panel right after the input terminal. The input block is located at the rear. In addition, the 16Ωpower transistors of the power block are also located at the rear so that the shortest length is realized. The signal is routed directly from the input block to the power amplifier and processed at once at the rear of the amplifier. As a result, the paths between pre-power and power speaker terminals, which tend to be noise sources, are greatly shortened. In the input circuit, a signal switching relay is placed immediately after the input terminal to greatly improve crosstalk between each source. In addition, the buffer amplifier mounted on the same substrate as the relay drives low impedance, thereby realizing excellent channel separation by reducing impedance of the circuit.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section is operated in pure class A operation. By expanding the exclusive super linear circuit developed by Pioneer to the final stage of large current, the low distortion of 0Ω.05Ω% is achieved despite the final stage non-feedback configuration, and the high damping factor of 200Ωis also achieved. The newly developed high-precision, integrally molded silent chassis is used for the chassis. Through in-depth research, we have developed a special resin material that is resistant to changes over time and has excellent anti-torsional and anti-shock properties. It supports the main body securely and at the same time, it has a shape that matches each block and efficiently disperses and absorbs internal and external vibrations. Since it is non-magnetic, electromagnetic induction noise and magnetic distortion are greatly suppressed.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a stack type electrolytic capacitor with low flux noise developed like a pure A-class amplifier, and a power transformer with low magnetic flux density, sufficient capacity, and excellent regulation characteristics to keep flux noise low. The volume uses a hand-made attenuator type with the same basic structure as the one used for Exclusive C7Ω. Each step consists of carefully selected carbon resistance and high-precision contact points. Unlike conventional sliding resistance devices, which change the sound volume, it is less affected by temperature and humidity. It eliminates the sound quality change due to contact resistance and the level difference between left and right, enabling stable control. In order to maintain the design with the highest priority on sound quality, the attached functions such as tone control, balance, and loudness are omitted, and the speaker output is also single-system. This reduces the subtle influence of circuits and switches, and minimizes the effect of wiring steps and signal paths. In addition, the earth side of each input source is also switched simultaneously, and a separate earth design is adopted to eliminate signal interference between connected devices from the earth side.

EQUALIZER
The Phono equalizer has a single-chip dual FET input configuration. One balanced input is mounted on the input terminal, and highly reliable gold-plated terminals are used for all terminals. The speaker terminal is a large vise type. It uses a large-capacity extra-thick type OFC power cord that suppresses the influence of external noise by drawing it from directly under the power transformer. It uses a high-grade type pure aluminum machined rotary knob and carefully selected resistors and capacitors. The concentrated arrangement of power transistors separates the part that absorbs the generated heat from the part that effectively diffuses it, and adopts a new heat radiation structure that takes into consideration the position and shape of the heat sink and the air flow path. The aluminum heat sink uses a new type that reduces resonance by changing the length of the fin."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"This is a pre-main amplifier that focuses on the operability that allows you to enjoy music while focusing on sound quality. In the amplifier with remote control, distortion is generated by the semiconductor switch used.

MOTOR
In order to eliminate this, a motor-driven rotary switch is adopted for the function switching. In addition, in order to suppress the deterioration of sound quality caused by the microcomputer for remote control, the transformer and power supply are separated for the microcomputer, and even the board is dedicated for the microcomputer. This prevents the control signal of the remote control from flowing into the audio part and suppresses noise generation. In addition, the operation of the microcomputer is stopped when the remote control is not operated.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section employs a super linear circuit that cancels out the nonlinear distortion of the transistors used in the amplifier section by combining transistors with completely opposite characteristics. This reduces signal degradation and distortion. In order to prevent noise from entering from the power supply, the power transformer is isolated from the chassis, and a clean ground system is adopted in which noise generated from the transformer flows to an independent ground system. Since the noise current generated from the transformer core does not flow into the signal system, the SN ratio in the sense of hearing, which does not appear in the specification, is improved.

POWER SUPPLY
The smoothing capacitor in the power supply section is a pair of complimentary service capacitors that take into consideration the effect of the magnetic field generated on the plus side and the minus side on sound quality, to reduce noise. Direct Construction II is used to prevent unnecessary wiring and reduce signal degradation and interference. The function switch is laid out in the signal input section to suppress degradation caused by the signal passing through the contact when the direct switch is ON. In addition, the REC selector is laid out close to the signal input section, so that the signal path is designed to be shortest even when recording to tape. In addition, the function switch, volume, direct switch and power amplifier are laid out on the same board, reducing the wiring and shortening the time. The switch between speakers A and B is also a relay switch with a protection function, and the path of the output signal is shortened thoroughly. Honeycomb chassis and honeycomb heat sink are used to prevent vibration and resonance. A low-load drive design that increases the drive capability of the speakers at low load, coupled with a discrete configuration, delivers high-quality, power-rich sound. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"The EX series stereo prestereo pre-main amplifier with built-in D/A converter and improved internal construction to eliminate factors that cause noise and distortion. Digital input / output is equipped with two optical input systems and one optical output system. In order to prevent the pulse width from changing when the optical fiber is bent or vibrated, an optical transmission distortion correction circuit is mounted on the input side and output side respectively to reduce noise. In the DAC section, the phase difference is eliminated by mounting a D/A converter for each L/R, and the separation is improved by separating the L/R. This D/A converter employs a specially developed glitch less IC that minimizes the occurrence of glitches. This eliminates the analog switch called a digricher, thereby improving performance and sound quality. Furthermore, by adding an MSB error correction circuit to each IC, the linearity at the 0Ωcross point is greatly improved. In addition, in order to prevent degradation of sound quality due to jitter (fluctuation of the clock edge), a PLL with an extremely high jitter suppression effect is adopted for the PLL that generates the clock, and the oscillation circuit is bonded with special resin in order to avoid the effect of vibration. When the D/A converter operates, only one master clock system is used, and the generation of unnecessary beat components is suppressed by eliminating other asynchronous clocks (such as microcomputer clocks). The digital filter over-samples by a factor of four to push unwanted high-frequency components into higher bands and eliminate aliasing noise. The digital filter uses a high-performance IC to achieve an in-band ripple within � 0Ω.0001ΩdB and an attenuation error of 100ΩdB. The low-pass filter consists of a 5Ωth-order Butterworth low-pass filter with excellent phase characteristics, which is composed of FDNR discrete circuits to reduce phase distortion as well as smooth characteristics. We are also working to improve sound quality by using high-quality parts and grounding with oxygen-free copper bus bars. Equipped with a digital recording selector that allows you to record a digital signal on the DAT that is independent of the sound coming from the speakers (this function is only available when watching analog sources). Digital circuits such as data demodulation, PLL, and digital filter are separated from analog sections such as D/A converter and analog low-pass filter by a separate board, and the digital section is shielded.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, by separating the power supply for the digital circuit and microcomputer from the power supply for the analog system from the transformer, we prevent interference with the analog system, which causes deterioration of sound quality. It uses direct construction to minimize the signal path and ensure proper positioning. First, the digital part and analog part are separated, and the signal path after the analog signal becomes the shortest like other analog sources. In addition, each input block is separated and the input / output block is shielded to prevent internal signal degradation and interference. In the input block, the input and recording selector can be controlled electrically, and the main volume can be controlled mechanically. Thus, the signal path can be minimized. Input sources other than the Adapt/Tape2Ωjacks can be directly transferred to the main volume by turning ON the Source Direct Switch, so that you can enjoy more pure sound.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier block is laid out along the signal flow and guides the output of the power stage directly to the speaker selector. Again, the wiring distance from the power supply is minimized. In the speaker selector block, the terminals are directly attached to the board on which the relay is attached. In order to minimize the number of terminals, and to give priority to terminal A, the terminal A is placed on the board with terminal A as opposed to the conventional terminal position. In order to minimize vibration, we have adopted a unique honeycomb shape for the frame chassis. In order to prevent vibration and resonance of the power transformer, the honeycomb formed by drawing is used for the transformer frame and frame chassis, and the honeycomb formed by punching is used for the bottom plate and bonnet case. In addition, to effectively suppress vibration and resonance of the power transistor, the extruded aluminum honeycomb of the chimney type is used as a heat sink. To suppress external vibration, four large honeycomb insulators made by resin molding are used. In addition, a fifth insulator made of cast iron is used to support the heavy transformer. In addition, cast iron is used for the transformer case, and pitch material with good thermal conductivity is filled between the cast iron case and the transformer body, and heat radiation fins are provided to prevent the internal resistance of the transformer winding from increasing due to temperature rise. In addition, it uses a newly developed large-capacity sealed capacitor that is less susceptible to electromagnetic induction. For the volume, a method of balancing the weight in both directions around the bearing of the rotary knob is adopted. In order to prevent any mechanical stress from being applied to the volume body, and in order to minimize the effect of the vibration of the amplifier, the shield cover supporting the volume substrate is floated from the body part with special paper, and harmful resonance of 2Ω-4ΩkHz is absorbed. Non-switching circuit TypeIII is adopted, in which switching distortion does not occur in principle. In addition to stabilizing the idle current, which has been drifting due to changes in the outside air temperature or when a large signal is input or just after the power switch is turned on, the voltage and power stages are clearly separated to improve the speaker drive performance under low load conditions. It uses a newly developed sealed capacitor in which the cathode of the aluminum electrolytic capacitor and the aluminum case are connected more securely, and the capacitor element is strongly shielded. This eliminates noise and noise from the capacitor itself, resulting in a high S/N. The Phono equalizer automatically turns OFF when you do not listen to a record, preventing unwanted noise and improving the sound quality of other sources. The recording selector also has an ON/OFF function. It operates only when the TONE direct switch is turned ON, and then the clock stops.

POWER SUPPLY
EQUALIZER
A hybrid MC transformer is used for the Phono equalizer circuit. Copper plating is used for rear panel, bottom plate, transformer frame, speaker terminal and block shield case in order to eliminate electro-striction and reduce vibration. Uses an extra-thick power cord with OFC polarity display. In addition, high-quality parts such as audio fuses, rotary knobs made of pure aluminum, gold-plated input / output terminals, and large-size vise terminals are introduced."

description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier was developed with the theme of high quality and dynamic range of the amplifier itself.

POWER SUPPLY
By adopting dynamic power supply system and non-switching circuit, the concept of real dynamism is reflected in the overall to realize high power with high quality. A dynamic power supply system is used for the power supply part in order to cope with a wide dynamic range of the source and to make the speaker sound as much as possible even at large input.

POWER SUPPLY
In this system, low voltage section (VL) and high voltage section (VHThe power supply circuit drives only the low-voltage part at the normal signal level and drives only the high-voltage part at the time of Tsutomu Dainyu. This greatly reduces the loss at the output-stage and enables high power. In addition, the high voltage section always follows the signal waveform with a constant voltage value, so that no waveform loss occurs. In addition, when a large signal repeatedly enters over a wide area, the high-voltage section remains locked as long as the signal continues. This design prevents waveform loss due to delay. The transformer employs a large toroidal transformer characterized by low flux leakage and high regulation. Eight electrolytic capacitors are installed for a total capacitance of 176Ω,000ΩÏ‰ F. We have achieved a low impedance. In addition, we use non-magnetic parts such as copper lead wires and oxygen-free copper wires in the power supply to eliminate harmful magnetic distortion. The power section is equipped with an established non-switching circuit that realizes 0Ωswitching distortion. Pioneer's proprietary high-speed bias servo circuit controls the bias current according to the input signal to keep the transistor in operation at all times. As a result, music contamination caused by switching distortion is fundamentally suppressed. An FET buffer circuit is adopted between the voltage and power amplifiers to completely separate the voltage and power amplifiers, greatly improving the bare characteristics before applying NFB. The input impedance of the FET is close to infinity, and even if the power amplifier receives load impedance fluctuations due to its nature, the effects do not appear on the input side. Moreover, the operation of the voltage amplifier is stable and the power amplifier can be driven with low output impedance (constant voltage drive). Therefore, the generation of distortion due to the nonlinearity of the power amplifier is suppressed, the effect of reaction signal from the speaker is eliminated, and the distortion factor of the power unit is further reduced. The MC head amplifier has a push-pull configuration from the input to the output. In addition, the input is parallel push-pull with ultra-low-noise FET.

POWER SUPPLY
The feedback point of the DC servo is not the first stage but the second stage bias power supply so that the servo circuit does not affect the SN ratio. As a result, the S / N ratio is 74ΩdB, which is close to the theoretical limit of 76ΩdB due to the thermal noise of transistors in this circuit system. DC servo circuits are used for each of the MC head amplifier, equalizer amplifier, and power amplifier. As a result, all coupling capacitors from the MC input to the speaker output have been removed, and all stages have been switched to non-coupling capacitors. This eliminates the need to worry about the coloring of sound caused by capacitors, and realizes high-resolution sound quality. It is equipped with a line straight switch which can obtain high quality sound by directly connecting an equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier. Passes tone controls, modes, and balance volumes to simplify the signal path. Non-magnetic parts are used to suppress the magnetic distortion that adversely affects the sound quality and to obtain more pure sound quality. Copper lead wires are used for all semiconductors used in each amplifier stage, and copper is also used for lead wires and caps for main resistors such as emitter resistors. We also use copper-based lead wires for main capacitors and oxygen-free copper wires for main wiring materials. The chassis is plated with copper and has an H-shaped structure to prevent frame noise. In addition, the Lch and Rch of the power amplifier are independent, the large signal system and small signal system are separated, and the equalizer amplifier and MC head amplifier are all structurally cut off to prevent mutual interference. An extremely thick power cord with double insulation structure is used for the power cord. We also pay attention to the fact that sound changes depending on the polarity of the AC line, and thoroughly control the winding method of the transformer and the polarity of the power cord."

## Description

"Pre-main amplifier with non-switching circuit.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section uses a non-switching circuit, a circuit technology unique to Pioneer. A high-speed bias servo circuit controls the bias current according to the input signal. This is a unique method that keeps the transistor in an always operating state. By this method, the transistor does not switch in principle, so the switching distortion, which is common with class B amplifiers, is suppressed to 0Ω.

NETWORK
In addition, crossover distortion is thoroughly pursued, and a power transistor with excellent pair characteristics is adopted, and the optimum point of the transistor is set to realize input / output characteristics with high linearity. Random access parts such as function switches and speaker selector switches are crystal brown self-illuminated and use one touch push buttons. It is equipped with a Rec selector which expands the function of the amplifier such as air check of FM broadcasting while listening to the record. The function switch, REC selector and speaker switch are equipped with an upper priority circuit to prevent operation failure caused by pressing several switches simultaneously.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power section has a DC amplifier configuration that eliminates capacitors that adversely affect sound quality, thereby suppressing the degradation of damping caused by capacitors, phase shift in the middle and low frequencies, and transient intermodulation distortion. With the aim of improving the sound quality of the overalls, each part is carefully selected. In particular, the power section uses Super Linear RET (Ring Emitter Transistor), a group transistor with excellent linearity in the high-frequency range, which enhances the performance of non-switching circuits. The radiator uses a T-shaped skive fin with more than 50Ω% increased heat radiation effect to achieve stable sound quality even for continuous high-power playback.

EQUALIZER
The Phono input uses an ICL type FET differential input circuit. An ICL type FET differential input circuit is also used in the flat amplifier section. Equipped with an MC position to which an MC cartridge can be directly connected. The gain can be changed by switching the switch. The tone control uses a center defeat method that jumps the tone circuit at the center position to obtain a flat characteristic. It is equipped with a subsonic filter that cuts out unwanted ultra-low frequency components (15ΩHz or less) caused by record warping, etc. Equipped with a loudness contour that is convenient for low volume."

"A pre-main amplifier that inherits the design concept of A-838Ωand adopts a non-vibration and non-resonance design such as a clean ground system and direct construction II. It uses a clean ground system to prevent harmful noise currents generated by power transformers and heat sinks. Power transformer and heatsink isolated from chassis and installed Noise is prevented from entering the signal path, and a special bypass is provided to return the noise current to the noise source to prevent noise from entering the music signal. It is equipped with Direct Construction II which realized the shortest signal path length of 85Ωcm by further developing the direct construction which achieved the signal path length of 120Ωcm. The input block is designed to mechanically remotely control the input selector and main volume. In addition, the source direct switch is turned ON to prevent input signals from flowing to the front panel. In addition, by laying out the volume substrate on the power amplifier, the routing of excess wiring is extremely shortened compared to conventional ones.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In addition, the power amplifier block is arranged along the signal path to direct the output of the power stage directly to the speaker selector block to minimize the distance from the power supply. In the speaker selector block, the speaker terminals are directly attached to the circuit board on which the relay is attached, eliminating the waste of wiring. In order to ensure no vibration and no resonance, the honeycomb shape with high rigidity and excellent vibration damping is adopted for main parts such as chassis and heat sink to keep vibration strain low. In addition, the heat radiation effect is improved by adopting the chimney type honeycomb heat sink. The volume uses a balanced volume shaft that reduces mechanical stress. It is also equipped with a large honeycomb insulator that disperses and attenuates external vibration in various directions. Non-switching circuit type II is adopted to improve switching distortion, thermal distortion, and nonlinear distortion of the output stage. The NF-CR type is used for the Phono equalizer. Considering the influence of external noise, oxygen-free copper wire power cord with polarity display is adopted, and nickel phosphorus plating which reduces non-linear strain is used for the power plug. We have also adopted a vice type speaker terminal to supply current with less loss. It uses an audio fuse with an emphasis on sound quality and a rotary knob made of machined aluminum material. It has S jacks for input Route 3Ωand output Route 3Ω, and a built-in video selector that enables mutual dubbing between the S jacks. In addition, in order to maintain the design philosophy of giving top priority to sound quality, we have separated the circuit and ground for audio and video systems and installed a dedicated transformer to prevent interference with audio systems. description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier was developed as the culmination of a fundamental review of the circuit, construction and physical properties, which are the origins of the amplifier, in order to respond to digital sources. The design philosophy of this amplifier is roughly divided into three points. First, each signal block is appropriately arranged in order to make the signal path the shortest distance. Second, thorough anti-vibration and anti-resonance measures are taken. Third, the drive performance of the speaker is improved at low load. We are solving various problems by investing various technologies in these areas. First, a structure called direct construction is adopted in order to make the signal path the shortest distance. By separating each circuit block and shielding the I/O block, adverse effects such as internal signal degradation and interference between signals can be prevented. The input block allows remote mechanical control of the Input & Recording Selector and the main volume to minimize signal routing. The input signal selected by the Input Selector does not flow to the front panel when the Source Direct Switch is turned ON, so you can enjoy even more pure sound.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier block is laid out along the signal flow and guides the output of the power stage directly to the speaker selector. Again, the distance from the power supply is the shortest. In the speaker selector block, the speaker terminals are directly attached to the circuit board on which the relay is attached so that the shortest speaker terminal A is given priority and the terminal A is placed on the lower side. In order to completely eliminate vibration and resonance, a resonance free construction method is adopted. Four types of honeycomb shapes are adopted, and vibration and resonance are totally reduced by combining the transformer part and volume system. Honeycomb made by punching is used for bottom plates and bonnet cases. For extruded aluminum honeycomb heat sinks to effectively suppress vibration and resonance of power transistors. Honeycomb made by resin molding is used for large honeycomb insulators to suppress external vibration. The transformer case is made of cast iron with high shielding effect, high rigidity, high internal loss, excellent vibration damping characteristics, and almost no resonance frequency. Pitch material with high thermal conductivity is filled between the case and the transformer body, and a heat radiation fan is installed to prevent the internal resistance of the transformer winding from increasing due to temperature rise. In addition, it uses a newly developed large-capacity sealed capacitor that is less susceptible to electromagnetic induction. Since sound quality is adversely affected by a structure in which a load is applied to the axis of the volume or vibration is generated, we have adopted a method of balancing the weight in both directions centering on the bearing of the rotary knob of the volume to prevent mechanical stress from being applied to the volume body. In addition, in order to minimize the effect of the vibration of the amplifier, the shield cover supporting the volume base is floated from the body part with special paper to absorb the resonance of 2Ωto 4ΩkHz which is harmful to sound quality. Non-switching circuit type III is adopted. This circuit is an upgraded version of Type II, in which switching distortion does not occur in principle, and has succeeded in suppressing thermal distortion by instantaneously stabilizing the idle current that drifts when the power switch is turned on, when a large signal is input, or when the outside temperature changes. In addition, detection and correction of input / output signal difference of the power stage is improved to reduce non-linear distortion. Furthermore, voltage amplification stage and power amplification stage are clearly separated. Since the power amplification stage concentrates on the speaker drive, there is no influence on the voltage amplification stage even at large output, and speaker drive performance at low load is improved. It uses a newly developed sealed capacitor in which the cathode of the aluminum electrolytic capacitor and the aluminum case are connected more securely. By strongly shielding the capacitor element, noise from the capacitor itself is eliminated, and high S/N is achieved. The Phono equalizer can be turned off when you do not listen to a record to prevent unwanted noise. In addition, the recording selector also has an OFF function, and the sound purity is enhanced by a simple circuit configuration.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer uses a unique NF-CR type circuit to stabilize the operation in the mid - and high-frequency range, and uses low-noise Hi-gm FET to improve S/N. Copper plated parts are used for the rear panel and bottom plate to prevent electro-striction and vibration. The power cord is a thick oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity indication. This cord is made of insulating material with low dielectric constant to reduce the capacitance of the power cord, thus reducing the influence of external noise. In addition, the polarity of transformer windings is controlled to minimize noise coming through the cord. Uses parts that emphasize sound quality such as fuse for audio. Machined pure aluminum is used for rotary knobs and other parts."

description:
## Description

"Pre-main amplifier with super linear circuit. Semiconductor amplification devices such as transistors have inherent non-linearity (distortion). In order to eliminate this non-linear distortion, we have adopted a super linear circuit at the first stage of the power section. In this method, the non-linearity of the transistor and the non-linearity of the reverse mode are paired and canceled. This makes it possible to make the non-linearity of the transistor almost linear. As a result, we succeeded in reducing NFB to about 1Ω/1000Ωof the conventional one because of improved bare characteristics, and solved the unstable factors such as TIM strain caused by NFB. In a class B amplifier, the transistor amplifier is switched in principle. In order to resolve this switching distortion and obtain high-purity sound quality, a non-switching circuit is installed in the power amplifier. This method uses a high-speed bias servo circuit to control the bias current according to the input signal to keep the transistor in an operating state at all times. As a result, the transistor does not switch and switching distortion is essentially 0Ω. We also pursue 0Ωcrossover distortion, carefully select transistors with high pair characteristics, and set the operating point to the optimum point to achieve input / output characteristics with high linearity and close to 0Ωcrossover distortion.

POWER AMPLIFIER
MOTOR
A DC servo circuit is used in the power amplifier section to cut out the unnecessary ultra-low frequencies that degrade sound quality without using a capacitor. This DC servo realizes a circuit configuration that does not use any coupling capacitor from the AUX or Tuner input to the SP output, eliminating the coloring of sound by the coupling capacitor. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier is designed with no vibration and no resonance and incorporates new technologies such as a clean ground system.

POWER SUPPLY
A clean ground system is used to shut out harmful noise current generated in the power supply and large current section from the electric circuit. The power transformer and heat sink, which are sources of noise, are isolated from the chassis to prevent noise from entering the signal path. In addition, the contact points between the circuit and the chassis are connected at appropriate points to provide a bypass for returning noise current to the noise source so that noise does not enter the signal current. Direct Construction II is used to shorten the signal path and prevent signal degradation and interference. While inheriting the conventional direct construction technology, the power amplifier board and the main volume board are integrated to greatly reduce the number of wiring steps and realize a signal path length of 85Ωcm. The input block has a structure in which the input selector and main volume are mechanically controlled remotely to minimize the signal path. In addition, by turning on the source direct switch, the input signal does not flow to the front panel at all, so you can enjoy a purer sound.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier block is laid out along the signal flow so that the output of the power stage is directed straight to the speaker block and the distance from the power supply is minimized. In order to minimize the length of the speaker block, the speaker terminals are directly attached to the circuit board on which the relay is attached. In order to eliminate vibration and resonance, we are focusing on the elucidation of the vibration transmission mechanism by making full use of modal analysis by computer. Based on the results, double-sided PVC steel plates with further improved vibration damping characteristics are used for the structural materials of the shield case, bottom plate and bonnet case. In addition, single-sided PVC steel plates are used for chassis such as rear panel, panel stay, and transformer frame to eliminate resonance of parts. We have improved rigidity and vibration damping characteristics by using press-drawn honeycomb for the frame chassis, extruded aluminum honeycomb for the heat sink to suppress vibration and resonance of the power transistor, and large-sized honeycomb insulator filled with resin molding for the bottom. The transformer case is made of cast iron which has excellent shielding effect and vibration damping characteristics and has almost no resonance frequency. In addition, pitch material with good thermal conductivity is filled between the case and the transformer body, and heat radiation fins are installed to prevent resistance from increasing due to temperature rise. In addition, a balanced volume shaft that minimizes the effect of vibration is used, and a system that balances the weight in both directions around the bearing of the rotary knob of the volume prevents mechanical stress from being applied to the volume body. In addition to the non-switching circuit type II, in which switching distortion does not occur in principle, it is equipped with the non-switching circuit type III, in which the power amplifier stage and power amplifier stage are clearly separated, improving the speaker drive performance under low load. In addition, it stabilizes the idle current that has drifted due to temperature changes immediately after the power switch is turned on or when a large signal is input, and suppresses thermal distortion. The Phono EQ uses a unique NF-CR type that combines the wide dynamic range of the NF type with the excellent frequency characteristics of the CR type.

EQUALIZER
By using the Phono equalizer switch, you can turn off the circuit when you are not listening to a record, thus reducing the generation of unwanted noise. Also equipped with a V function OFF switch that turns off the power of the video system while the audio source is being played back. Uses a oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity display that takes into consideration the effect of external noise, and uses nickel phosphorus plating for the power plug that reduces non-linear strain. In addition, the input / output terminals are gold-plated, and the speaker terminals are of a vise type capable of supplying low-loss current. The rotary knob uses solid aluminum shavings. The video system is equipped with an input Route 3Ωand an output Route 3Ω, allowing mutual dubbing.

POWER SUPPLY
To prevent the video system from adversely affecting the audio system, a dedicated power transformer is installed for the video system and the circuit and ground are separated."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier that employs a super-linear circuit to cancel out non-linear distortion of transistors. Taking note of the inherent nonlinearity (distortion) of semiconductors, we have adopted a super linear circuit in the first stage of the power section. The Super Linear Circuit, which is Pioneer's original technology, is a circuit that eliminates the non-linearity (distortion) of transistors without relying only on NFB (negative feedback) like conventional amplifiers. It is a circuit that sets a transistor with a reverse mode non-linearity in the non-linearity of the transistor and cancels the non-linearity by using a current mirror circuit to obtain an equivalent excellent linearity. As a result, the fundamental characteristics (bare characteristics) are improved, so that a large amount of negative feedback (NFB) does not need to be applied as in conventional systems, and it is reduced to about 10ΩdB, 1Ω/1000Ωof the conventional level. As a result, the NFB-induced TIM distortion, degradation of frequency characteristics during phase correction, and instability in the high-frequency range are eliminated, and the inherent advantage of NFB, which produces output signals similar in shape to input signals, can be utilized. The power stage and driver stage are equipped with non-switching circuits in order to ensure sound quality without distortion. This method is based on Pioneer's proprietary high-speed bias servo circuit. By controlling the bias current according to the input signal, the transistor is always kept in an operating state. By this method, the transistor does not switch in principle, and switching distortion is essentially 0Ω.

NETWORK
We also pursue 0Ωcrossover distortion and carefully select the transistors to be adopted. By using transistors with high pair characteristics and setting the operating point to the optimum point, input / output characteristics with output characteristics with higher linearity.

MOTOR
A clean servo regulator is used to supply power to the first stage of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier. Compared with the conventional serial control type, it is a parallel control type with a smaller output current loop.

POWER SUPPLY
The impedance of the power supply becomes 0Ωequivalently, and the influence on other signal circuits is suppressed. As a result, crosstalk, such as signal leakage, is eliminated, resulting in higher sound quality. DC servo circuits are used for both the equalizer amplifier and the power amplifier. As a result, all coupling capacitors in the signal system from the MC input terminal to the SP output terminal are removed, and non-coupling capacitors are used in all stages. This suppresses the generation of phase shift and transient intermodulation distortion. It is equipped with a line straight switch in order to obtain more refined sound quality. MC cartridge can be used and MC/MM can be switched. In addition, MM / load capacity and MC / load resistance can be switched to bring out the performance of the cartridge. It is equipped with a subsonic indicator that notifies mixing of unnecessary ultra-low frequency (20ΩHz) by light. It is equipped with a Rec Out selector and an indicator to let you know at a glance which terminal of Rec1Ωor Rec2Ωoutputs the recording output."

name: Exclusive
description:
## Description

"A professional studio monitor and speaker system based on the model2251Ωwith the smallest possible enclosure. The same unit as model2251Ωis used.

WOOFER
A 25Ωcm cone woofer TAD TL-1102Ωis mounted in the low range. The diaphragm is a composite cone made of natural pulp, which has undergone an aging process, laminated with a special film, and coated with a special damping paint. In addition, the magnetic circuit uses an internal magnetic type with an Alnico magnet that can reduce the second harmonic distortion in principle. By designing with a margin for the magnet operating point, the sensitivity drop due to demagnetization at high power is also kept low. Furthermore, in order to stabilize the transmission of driving force, the yoke and plate of the magnetic circuit are integrally molded by a special casting method, and the center pole is also screwed to the yoke. This improves the synthesis of the magnetic circuit by approximately four times. The driver unit TAD TD-2002Ωand the compact design horn TAD TH-2002Ωare mounted in the high range. The TD 2002Ωuses a lightweight and highly rigid 4Ω.8Ωcm beryllium diaphragm and an alnico magnet with a magnetic flux density of approximately 20Ω,000ΩGauss to achieve excellent linearity. In addition, the phasing plug, which prevents phase disturbance of sound waves, uses an annular slit type that facilitates phase matching in ultra-high frequencies.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section has been reviewed and the terminal on the diaphragm assay is now a direct power supply terminal that directly goes out of the back cover. This reduces the influence of internal AC magnetic flux and sound pressure and provides clear sound quality. The TH-2002Ωis a horn whose directivity is controlled by wave-front control technology. The directivity angle is set to 60Ω� horizontally and 30Ω� vertically in consideration of small-capacity monitor rooms. In addition, by adopting an asymmetric vertical horn based on the Asymmetrical Pattern, Axis & Level (APAXIAL) method, smooth output-sound pressure characteristics are obtained, and directivity control in the vertical direction is actively performed. This reduces the influence of reflection from the top of the enclosure or from the ceiling and provides clear orientation. In addition, by adopting AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) to suppress the resonance characteristic of the horn, the sound is absorbed by the acoustic tube installed in the upper part of the horn, and the back and forth movement of sound image due to pitch (sound height) is eliminated, and the articulation of reproduced sound is improved."

name: Exclusive
description:
## Description

"Based on the results and data of the model2402Ω, this studio monitor speaker system was developed by putting in the latest TAD systemization technology cultivated in the development of the model2251Ω.

WOOFER
TAD TL-1601Ωc which is 40Ωcm cone type woofer is mounted in the low range. The TL-1601Ωc uses a special casting process to integrally mold the yoke, plate, and frame, which were previously separate parts. In addition, the center pole is screwed to the yoke to increase the rigidity of the unit. The magnetic circuit uses an Alnico magnet to suppress second harmonic distortion and achieve a strong magnetic flux density. In addition, by applying a special aging process to the diaphragm, a tough and durable cone has been realized. The high-frequency band is equipped with a unit that combines a driver TAD TD 4003Ωand a horn TAD TH 4003Ω. The TD 4003Ωis a newly designed compression driver equipped with an aluminum annular slit on a phasing plug to prevent phase disturbance of sound waves. The vibration system uses a lightweight and highly rigid 10Ωcm beryllium diaphragm, and the magnetic circuit uses a neodymium magnet with a high magnetic flux density of 20000Ωof Gauss. This realizes wide-band reproduction and excellent linearity. In addition, the throat diameter is set at 39Ωmm in consideration of diffusion in the high-frequency range, thereby reducing the influence of AC magnetic flux and sound pressure inside the direct feeding terminal. The TH-4003Ωuses the APAXIAL (Asymmetrical Pattern, Axis & Level) method and wave-front control technology to create an asymmetrical horn shape. The directional angle is set at 80Ωdegrees horizontally and 30Ωdegrees vertically to obtain smooth output sound pressure characteristics. In addition, directional control in the vertical direction is actively performed. This reduces reflection in the low frequency range, eliminates fins, and makes it possible to make the sound source position near the top and bottom of the woofer. In addition, AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) is adopted in the upper part of the horn, and the resonance peculiar to the horn is absorbed by the acoustic tube, and the backward and forward movement of the sound image due to the pitch (sound height) is eliminated. The network part of the model2404Ωwas sold separately, and a dedicated network unit DN 2404Ωfor bi-wiring was sold. The DN-2404Ωrealizes smooth phase characteristics as a system by adjusting the phase characteristics of the unit with high precision, and adopts CGR (Capacitive Gap Reduction) system to reduce unnecessary current due to parasitic capacitance. The DN 2404Ωuses an external system so that it is not affected by magnetic flux and sound pressure inside the enclosure."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"This speaker system was completed as a natural phase system based on Pioneer's original wave front control technology and networkless technology. The Natural Phase System has three key points : ""an enclosure that matches the sound sources of a woofer and a tweeter for theoretical phase matching,"" ""smooth electrical phase characteristics using networkless technology,"" and ""a shape that prevents wavefront diffraction and fully draws out the performance of each speaker unit."" By implementing these three points, uniform sound spread and smooth phase characteristics are achieved.

WOOFER
A 16Ωcm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The shape and material of all suspension systems, including the edge shape, are examined one by one to enhance the ability to follow minute input. In addition, by directly connecting without a network using networkless technology, the deterioration factor of the input signal is eliminated as much as possible. A 3Ω.5Ωcm semi-dome type tweeter is used for the high range. This tweeter is a newly developed HSDOM (Harmonized Synthetic Diaphragm Optimum Method) tweeter using ceramic graphite. It is designed to maximize each function and performance by using the finite element method with computer for the material, shape, edge, etc. of the diaphragm. Alginic acid fiber is made from alginic acid extracted from seaweed into filament fiber. This fiber is used as a binder for high rigidity material and pulp, and by increasing the bonding force, high rigidity and high internal loss are improved. In addition, the voice coil adopts an edgewise winding with ribbon wire, and the coil occupancy rate in the magnetic gap is high, so the driving force of the cone is improved by approximately 10Ω% compared to conventional products. An alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and a copper short ring is added to prevent magnetic materials such as poles and plates in the vicinity from being magnetized, thereby suppressing distortion. In addition, the top of the center cap is equipped with a CRA (Cap Resonance Absorber) made by Exenes to reduce surface noise on the center cap surface. The frame is made of zinc die-cast, which has a specific gravity 2Ω.6Ωtimes that of aluminum, to reduce unnecessary vibration.

(wave front) director developed from wave front control technology. This W. F. director is made by Painted maple laminate carving which is also used in Exclusive S5Ω. By adjusting the time axis with the woofer and controlling the directivity by the horn shape, the wave front of the sound at the listening position of the listener is matched. The enclosure is a vertical twin system in which two woofers are arranged vertically with a tweeter at the center. Wave-front control technology was introduced in the design. By strictly controlling the energy time of the woofer and the tweeter on the time axis, controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter, controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter, matching the electrical phase of the network, and controlling the wave-front diffraction by the shape of the baffle, we aim to realize a more ideal speaker system. A midship mount system is used to fix the unit. Both the woofer and tweeter are fixed to the inner baffle inside the enclosure to reduce unnecessary vibration. In addition, a floating top and shield frame are used to eliminate resonance. Artificial leather is applied to the baffle surface to improve the S/N feeling of sound quality. The rear duct is used to avoid unnecessary radiation sound in the middle region from the duct.

CABINET

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"A vertical twin type speaker system that employs an all-crystalline diamond diaphragm.

WOOFER
A 20Ωcm cone type woofer with an ALCC (alginate composite cone) diaphragm, which was developed in Shinkai over a period of four years, is used for the low range. This diaphragm consists of a composite diaphragm made by mixing pulp with aramid fiber, and mixed with alginic acid fiber, which is made from alginic acid extracted from seaweed into threads and made into fibers. The alginic acid fiber functions just as a binder between pulp and aramid fiber, increasing the bonding strength between pulp and aramid fiber and improving rigidity. The magnetic circuit employs a high-linearity magnetic circuit with 2Ω.5Ωtimes the plate thickness of the conventional one. The voice coil is made into a short voice coil that fits perfectly in the magnetic gap, and the decrease in magnetic flux density is suppressed even when the voice coil is large in amplitude. In addition, the Alnico magnet with high magnetic flux density and low harmonic distortion is adopted. In addition, the frame is made of zinc die-cast, which has a specific gravity 2Ω.6Ωtimes that of aluminum, and the shape is designed to reduce air resistance to the diaphragm while reducing unnecessary vibration due to higher rigidity. The surface of the Woofer gasket is treated with bristles to reduce the reflection of sound from cones and edges. In addition, the gasket itself has a damping effect and produces a reproduced sound with less noise turbidity.

TWEETER
A 3Ω-cm dome type tweeter with a full crystalline diamond diaphragm is used for the high range. This diaphragm is made of 100Ω% polycrystalline diamond instead of conventional materials such as titanium coated with diamond. This diaphragm takes advantage of the characteristics of diamond that are close to the ideal diaphragm. As a result, the sound velocity is approximately 3Ω.3Ωtimes that of titanium, the reproduction frequency band is approximately 3Ω.4Ωtimes that of titanium, and the internal loss is approximately 3Ωto 5Ωtimes that of titanium. In addition, a new W. F. (Wave Front) director utilizing wave front control technology is adopted for the front of the tweeter. The director is made of Painted maple laminated material with high rigidity and excellent acoustic characteristics. In order to match the energy response with the woofer, the mounting position of the diaphragm is adjusted, and in order to improve the range of orientation in the vertical direction, the horn shape of the director is incorporated. In addition, an alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and zinc die-cast, which has 2Ω.6Ωtimes the specific gravity of aluminum, is also used for the flange of the tweeter. In addition, the surface of the zinc die-cast is treated with hair transplantation to suppress excess resonance. The unit array is a vertical twin system using wave surface control technology, and all band sound is radiated around the tweeter. In addition, by using a small-diameter twin woofer, voluminous low sound reproduction is realized. The wave surface control technology scientifically clarifies how the wave surface of the sound emitted from each unit spreads and reaches the listener's ear. It is strictly controlled in four points : ""adjusting the energy time response of the woofer and the tweeter on the time axis,"" ""controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter in all frequency bands,"" ""matching the electrical phase of the network, etc.,"" and ""controlling the wave surface diffraction by the baffle shape.""A full midship mounting system is adopted to prevent unwanted vibration from each unit from being transmitted to the baffle. The woofer is fixed to the inner baffle inside the enclosure, and the tweeter is fixed from the back side of the baffle through a hair-implanted layer. By mounting the unit outside of the baffle surface, unnecessary vibration of the baffle is reduced. In addition, a floating top that suppresses unnecessary vibration of the top plate and a shield frame that blocks vibration from the frame are adopted. Each unit circuit is also separated in the network mount. In particular, the tweeter circuit is covered with felt from below to eliminate unnecessary vibration from the enclosure. The woofer circuit and the tweeter circuit are separated independently, and the signal transmission loss is reduced by crimping wiring. Each element is mounted with careful anti-vibration measures and is laid out so as not to be affected by crosstalk.

NETWORK
For input to the network, a radial power supply system is adopted to enable direct and uniform signal transmission. The enclosure is plated with high quality walnut real wood and takes advantage of the grain of natural precious wood. In addition, compared to the usual oil finish, the number of polishing is increased and the smoothness is improved. In addition, wool with high sound absorption and excellent sound quality is used as sound absorbing material to reduce unnecessary standing waves in the enclosure. It uses a bi-wiring connection terminal that can separately feed the low and high sound circuits."

## Description

"This speaker system was developed as a new-generation reference for high-definition media such as DVD audio by applying the technology and experience accumulated in the past. This speaker uses AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) technology. By using an acoustic tube in the enclosure and in the horn opening, it suppresses unnecessary box ringing by absorbing standing waves and resonance sound, and eliminates unstable back and forth movement of sound image due to fluctuation of pitch (sound height), thus enhancing clear reproducibility.

WOOFER
A 25Ωcm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The diaphragm is made of cone paper equivalent to the TAD unit which is well known as a studio monitor speaker.
