A ribbon-type super-tweeter has been newly developed and installed in order to reproduce the ultra-high frequency range that DVD audio enables. It is also equipped with switching terminals for bi-wiring connection, bi-amplifier connection and multi-amplifier drive. Equipped with 3Ω-position switching type level control for tweeter. It is designed in pursuit of the ideal speaker system of ""the enclosure does not sound but only the diaphragm"". First of all, strength is improved by adopting a trapezoidal structure, and in addition, unnecessary resonance is suppressed by a three layer structure sandwiching special damping material. In addition, acoustic tubes based on AFAST technology, a further development of Pioneer's TAD professional studio monitor technology, are placed inside the enclosure to significantly reduce the amount of sound absorbing material and eliminate the generation of standing waves, which has been considered a weak point of the tall boy type (patent pending). Two 25Ωcm cone type woofers with ALCC (alginate composite cone) diaphragm are used for the low range. This diaphragm is made of a mixture of alginic acid fiber to increase the bonding strength between high-strength polyarylate fiber and pulp. Alginic acid fiber extracted from seaweed such as kelp works as a binder for both, improving the bonding strength and obtaining high rigidity and internal loss. The magnetic circuit uses a double anti-magnetic magnet with a canceling magnet and drives at a magnetic flux density of 14Ω,300ΩGauss. This is the same system as the Technical Audio Devices (TAD) unit and Exclusive S5Ω. The sound guided by the fading plug adjacent to the diaphragm is collected at the center of the outlet and emitted from the horn at once. This rear type has excellent phase and high-frequency characteristics because the length of the sound path is the same for each sound path. The diaphragm is made of highly responsive 3Ωcm diameter titanium, and the back cover is made of aluminum die cast. In addition, the horn section uses a newly designed slant angle oval wave horn that is integrally molded with the front port. In addition, the horn has an oval shape with a soft curved surface, so that it has a wide horizontal directivity and a wider listening area for stereo playback. The horn is made of aluminum die-cast with high rigidity and high molding accuracy to ensure vibration control so that the horn itself does not generate excessive vibration. The network is distributed specifically for the unit for sound quality, and the network board is floating from the enclosure to avoid vibration. A full midship mount is adopted to prevent vibration of the unit from being transmitted to the baffle. Both the woofer and tweeter are firmly secured inside the enclosure to prevent unwanted vibration of the baffle. The enclosure takes advantage of the bass reflex effect for higher efficiency and has ports on the front and rear baffles. name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"This speaker system was developed with the concept of high sensitivity and high efficiency, inheriting the design philosophy of TAD (Technical Audio Devices) and Exclusive S5Ωin search of the reality of the original sound.

WOOFER
Two 25Ωcm cone type woofer using ALCC (alginic acid composite cone) diaphragm is used for the low range. This ALCC diaphragm is made by mixing alginic acid fiber and papermaking in order to increase the bonding force between high strength polyarylate fiber and pulp. Alginic acid fiber extracted from kelp and other seaweeds acts as a binder to increase the bonding force. In addition, the magnetic circuit uses a double magnet magnetic circuit with a canceling magnet, and achieves a high magnetic flux density of 14Ω,300Ωgauss. In addition, a T-shaped pole is used to obtain a uniform magnetic flux density from front to back, improving the linearity of amplitude against input. In addition, in order to improve response at the time of Oire force and Dainyu force, we have adopted a butterfly-type damper with a revised shape.

TWEETER
A horn type tweeter is used for the high range. The horn driver is equipped with a rear-type compression driver that provides high resolution and excellent linearity. This compression driver uses the same method as TAD and Exclusive S5Ω. The sound emitted from the diaphragm is guided to the center by a fading plug designed based on fluid dynamics research. The sound is compressed and radiated from the horn. In particular, since the diaphragm is a rear type with the sound generating direction on the rear side, the length of the sound path of the fading plug is the same. There is no phase disturbance of the sound from each slit, and the high-frequency characteristics are excellent. The diaphragm of this driver is made of 3Ωcm titanium nitride, and a back cover made of aluminum die-cast with excellent vibration resistance is attached to the back of the diaphragm to prevent unnecessary vibration. The horn section is equipped with a large oval wave horn designed with a flared shape to send out spherical waves, thereby realizing a natural sound spread close to a point source. In addition, by rounding the horn opening, the reflection of sound is reduced and the sound is smoothly connected to the outside. The horn shape is oval-shaped, so the horizontal directivity is wide and natural sound can be obtained in a wide range of listening points. For the material of this horn, aluminum die-cast with high molding accuracy and excellent vibration control is adopted. In addition, AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning), a new technology introduced in TAD, has been introduced, and a resonator is installed in the upper part of the horn. This makes it possible to smooth out changes in phase and to obtain more precise sound localization and reproduction sound. In the network section, only elements with a low distortion factor are carefully selected and distributed to each unit to prevent temporal interference between units. In addition, the network board is floated from the enclosure to isolate vibration from each unit. In order to prevent unwanted vibration of the baffle from adversely affecting playback sound, the tweeter woofer is fixed by Pioneer's unique midship mounting method. By fixing the unit inside instead of the baffle, unnecessary vibration of the baffle is reduced. The enclosure has two ports on the front to take advantage of the bass reflex effect that enhances the low range. Compared to a single port of the same area, there is less mid-range leakage from the enclosure and less noise turbidity due to interference from the unit. In addition, since the opening uses a special R-shaped elastic body, there is little wind noise and sound waves are emitted smoothly.

CABINET
Furthermore, in order to improve the low-frequency characteristics, it is a large-capacity enclosure with an internal volume of 100ΩL, and the extremely thick baffle is used as a round baffle to prevent the sound diffraction phenomenon. In addition, the material is acoustically examined high-density particle board, and the finish is a flower-like finish in Redish dark brown color. There is an attenuator that can adjust the high-frequency level at the bottom of the input terminal. It can be adjusted according to the condition of the room with 2Ωpositions of Normal/Decrease."

description:
## Description

"UK series 2Ω-way speaker system with networkless technology. By introducing a natural phase system based on wavefront control technology and reversing the positions of the 18Ωcm woofer and the 2Ω.5Ωcm tweeter, the sound source at the listening point is adjusted on the time axis.

WOOFER
The woofer uses pulp corn and a diffuser is installed in the center part to achieve clear sound quality. Equipped with a screw-type input terminal for banana plug."

name: Pioneer
description:
## Description

"John Bamford, who was writing as an audio critic in the UK, joined Pioneer High Fidelity LTD. and developed a high-class speaker system designed to pursue more authentic music playback among the UK series.

WOOFER
The low range is equipped with a 14Ωcm cone shaped woofer which uses conifer pulp produced in Northern Europe for corn. Our unique network-less technology eliminates the network by allowing the frequency response to decay smoothly as it goes to the higher range. A 2Ω.5Ωcm soft dome type tweeter with catenary curve for high rigidity is installed in the high range.

CABINET
The enclosure is fully mirror-finished and has an internal volume of 18Ω.0ΩL. Uses a large gold plated input terminal."
